```{r morton et al. cleaning}
make_rank_mats_from_taxonomy <- function(
  Y,
  taxonomy,
  feature_col = "Feature ID",
  ranks = c("Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species", "Feature ID"),
  unassigned_prefix = "Unassigned_"
) {
  Y <- as.matrix(Y)
  storage.mode(Y) <- "numeric"
  if (is.null(rownames(Y))) stop("Y must have rownames = feature IDs.")
  if (is.null(colnames(Y))) stop("Y must have colnames = sample IDs.")
  taxonomy <- as.data.frame(taxonomy, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (!feature_col %in% names(taxonomy)) stop("taxonomy missing column: ", feature_col)
  taxonomy[[feature_col]] <- trimws(as.character(taxonomy[[feature_col]]))
  idx <- match(rownames(Y), taxonomy[[feature_col]])
  unmapped_idx <- which(is.na(idx))
  n_unmapped <- length(unmapped_idx)
  unmapped_ids <- rownames(Y)[unmapped_idx]
  tax2 <- taxonomy[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  out <- list()
  ranks <- unique(ranks)
  for (rk in ranks) {
    if (rk == feature_col) {
      out[[rk]] <- Y
      next
    }
    if (!rk %in% names(tax2)) next
    lab <- trimws(as.character(tax2[[rk]]))
    lab[lab %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")] <- NA_character_
    bad_lab <- is.na(lab) | lab == "" | lab %in% c("d__", "p__", "c__", "o__", "f__", "g__", "s__")
    group <- ifelse(!bad_lab, lab, paste0(unassigned_prefix, rownames(Y)))
    if (n_unmapped > 0) {
      group[unmapped_idx] <- paste0(unassigned_prefix, rownames(Y)[unmapped_idx])
    }
    M <- rowsum(Y, group = group, reorder = TRUE)
    keep <- rowSums(M != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
    out[[rk]] <- M[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  list(
    mats = out,
    mapping = list(
      n_features = nrow(Y),
      n_mapped = nrow(Y) - n_unmapped,
      n_unmapped = n_unmapped,
      unmapped_ids = unmapped_ids
    )
  )
}
```

```{r meta analysis cleaning, https://journals.asm.org/doi/10.1128/spectrum.00331-22}
library(dada2)
library(tools)

rds_dir <- "C:/Users/biowz/Documents/Documents/PhD/silvermanlab/mlscale-autism/"
pattern <- "_dada2_counts.rds$"
files <- list.files(rds_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
gg2_train_fasta <- "gg2_2024_09_toGenus_trainset.fa.gz"
cache_dir <- file.path(rds_dir, "classified_gg")
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

is_valid_dna <- function(x, min_len = 50) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  grepl("^[ACGTN]+$", x) & nchar(x) >= min_len
}
detect_asv_in_cols <- function(counts, min_len = 50) {
  cn <- colnames(counts)
  rn <- rownames(counts)
  p_col <- if (!is.null(cn)) mean(is_valid_dna(cn, min_len = min_len)) else 0
  p_row <- if (!is.null(rn)) mean(is_valid_dna(rn, min_len = min_len)) else 0
  if (p_col == 0 && p_row == 0) {
    stop("Could not find any DNA-like ASVs in rownames or colnames.")
  }
  p_col >= p_row
}
make_full_tax_df <- function(all_asvs, tax_mat) {
  ranks <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
  out <- data.frame(matrix(NA_character_, nrow = length(all_asvs), ncol = length(ranks)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  colnames(out) <- ranks
  rownames(out) <- all_asvs
  if (!is.null(tax_mat) && nrow(tax_mat) > 0) {
    shared <- intersect(rownames(tax_mat), all_asvs)
    out[shared, intersect(colnames(tax_mat), ranks)] <- tax_mat[shared, intersect(colnames(tax_mat), ranks), drop = FALSE]
  }
  out
}

for (f in files) {
  base <- basename(f)
  proj <- sub("_dada2_counts\\.rds$", "", base)
  counts_name <- make.names(paste0(proj, "_counts"))
  taxa_name <- make.names(paste0(proj, "_taxa"))
  meta_name <- make.names(paste0(proj, "_meta"))
  counts <- as.data.frame(readRDS(f), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  asv_in_cols <- detect_asv_in_cols(counts, min_len = 50)
  all_asvs <- if (asv_in_cols) colnames(counts) else rownames(counts)
  if (is.null(all_asvs)) stop("Counts matrix missing rownames/colnames needed to identify ASVs.")
  all_asvs <- as.character(all_asvs)
  keep_dna <- is_valid_dna(all_asvs, min_len = 50)
  asvs_dna <- all_asvs[keep_dna]
  cache_file <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0(proj, "_gg2_taxonomy.rds"))
  tax_cached <- NULL
  if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
    tax_cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
    tax_cached <- as.data.frame(tax_cached, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  cached_ids <- if (!is.null(tax_cached)) rownames(tax_cached) else character(0)
  to_classify <- setdiff(asvs_dna, cached_ids)
  tax_new <- NULL
  if (length(to_classify) > 0) {
    tax_new <- dada2::assignTaxonomy(
      seqs = to_classify,
      refFasta = gg2_train_fasta,
      tryRC = TRUE,
      multithread = TRUE
    )
    tax_new <- as.data.frame(tax_new, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    tax_new <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = 0))
  }
  if (is.null(tax_cached)) {
    tax_merged <- tax_new
  } else if (nrow(tax_new) == 0) {
    tax_merged <- tax_cached
  } else {
    common_cols <- union(colnames(tax_cached), colnames(tax_new))
    tax_cached2 <- tax_cached
    tax_new2 <- tax_new
    for (cc in setdiff(common_cols, colnames(tax_cached2))) tax_cached2[[cc]] <- NA_character_
    for (cc in setdiff(common_cols, colnames(tax_new2))) tax_new2[[cc]] <- NA_character_
    tax_merged <- rbind(
      tax_cached2[, common_cols, drop = FALSE],
      tax_new2[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
    )
  }
  saveRDS(tax_merged, cache_file)
  tax_df <- make_full_tax_df(all_asvs, tax_merged)
  meta_file <- file.path(rds_dir, paste0(proj, ".csv"))
  if (!file.exists(meta_file)) {
    warning("Missing metadata CSV for ", proj, " (expected: ", meta_file, ")")
    next
  }
  meta <- read.csv(meta_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  assign(counts_name, counts, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(taxa_name, tax_df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(meta_name, meta, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  cat(
    "Processed:", proj,
    "| ASVs:", length(all_asvs),
    "| DNA>=50:", length(asvs_dna),
    "| newly classified:", length(to_classify),
    "| cache rows:", if (!is.null(tax_merged)) nrow(tax_merged) else 0,
    "| ASV axis:", if (asv_in_cols) "cols" else "rows",
    "\n"
  )
}

status_from_string <- function(x) {
  x_low <- tolower(x)
  x_low[is.na(x_low)] <- ""
  case_when(
    str_detect(x_low, "autism|asd|case") ~ "autism",
    str_detect(x_low, "control|healthy|hc|\\btd\\b|tdc|csv|nc|nt|dd|ctrl|neuro") ~ "control",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

clean_status_for_project <- function(proj) {
  obj_name <- paste0(proj, "_meta")
  obj_name_design <- paste0(proj, "_design")
  if (!exists(obj_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    warning("Missing metadata object: ", obj_name)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  df <- get(obj_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  df$status <- NA
  design <- NULL

  if (proj == "PRJEB27306") {
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$host_disease_status)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$host_sex <- factor(df$host_sex)
    df$Host_Age <- as.numeric(df$Host_Age)
    df$host_body_mass_index <- as.numeric(df$host_body_mass_index)
    df$ID <- df$Run
    df$Host_Age[!is.finite(df$Host_Age) | df$Host_Age <= 0] <- NA
    design <- ~ status + Age + Sex + host_body_mass_index
  } else if (proj == "PRJEB29421") {
    df$status <- ifelse(grepl("C", df$`Sample_name`, fixed = TRUE), "control", "autism")
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    design <- ~status
  } else if (proj == "PRJEB45948") {
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$Submitter_Id)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    design <- ~status
  } else if (proj == "PRJNA453621") {
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$diagnosis)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    design <- ~ status + Age + Sex
  } else if (proj %in% c("PRJNA578223")) {
    metazou <- readxl::read_excel("PRJNA578223.xlsx")
    df <- merge(df, metazou[, c("Seq.No.", "Height (cm)", "Weight（kg）")], by.x = "Library.Name", by.y = "Seq.No.", all.x = TRUE)
    df$BMI <- df$`Weight（kg）` / ((df$`Height (cm)` / 100)^2)
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$Library.Name)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    design <- ~ status + Age + Sex
  } else if (proj %in% c("PRJNA813424")) {
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$Library.Name)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    df$ID_2 <- df$Library.Name
    design <- ~status
  } else if (proj == "PRJNA589343") {
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$Sample.Name)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    df$ID_2 <- df$Library.Name
    design <- ~status
  } else if (proj == "PRJNA624252") {
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$Sample.Name)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df$tmp <- as.numeric(df$tmp)
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    df$ID_2 <- df$Library.Name
    design <- ~ status + tmp
  } else if (proj == "PRJNA769228") {
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$Sample.Name)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    df$ID_2 <- df$Library.Name
    design <- ~status
  } else if (proj == "PRJNA282013") {
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$Host_disease)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    design <- ~ status + Age + Sex + (1 | Match_IDs)
  } else if (proj == "PRJNA644763") {
    df <- subset(df, host_life_stage == "child")
    df$Run <- df$file_name
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$diagnosis)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    design <- ~ status + Age + Sex
  } else if (proj == "PRJEB12607") {
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$Health_status)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    design <- ~ status + age
  } else if (proj == "PRJEB15418") {
    df$status <- status_from_string(df$Health_status)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$Constipation <- factor(df$Constipation)
    df$Constipation <- relevel(df$Constipation, ref = "no")
    df$`Calprotectin..ug.g.` <- as.numeric(df$`Calprotectin..ug.g.`)
    df$ID <- df$Run
    design <- ~ status + Constipation + `Calprotectin..ug.g.`
  } else if (proj == "PRJNA168470") {
    metalevel <- read.csv("PRJNA168470_meta.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    dup_names <- setdiff(intersect(names(df), names(metalevel)), "ID")
    metalevel <- metalevel[, setdiff(names(metalevel), dup_names), drop = FALSE]
    df <- merge(x = df, y = metalevel, by.x = "Sample.Name", by.y = "ID", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
    df$status <- ifelse(grepl("N", df$`Sample.Name`, fixed = TRUE), "control", "autism")
    df$status <- ifelse(df$`Sample.Name` == "A-excl", NA, df$status)
    df$status <- factor(df$status)
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
    df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))
    df$ID <- df$Run
    design <- ~ status + Age + Gender + `Pro.Biotics................Average.consumption.frequences.per.week.` + `Nutritional.supplement` + `Current.medications` + `GS.Index.total`
  } else {
    warning("No rule or error for: ", proj)
  }

  df$status <- factor(df$status)
  if ("control" %in% levels(df$status)) {
    df$status <- relevel(df$status, ref = "control")
  } else {
    warning("Level 'control' not found for: ", proj)
  }
  df <- data.frame(as(df, "data.frame"))

  df$Study <- gsub("\\s+et al\\.\\s+", "", df$Study)
  df$Study <- gsub("\\s+", "", df$Study)

  assign(obj_name, df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(obj_name_design, design, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  out <- setNames(
    list(list(
      counts   = NULL,
      metadata = df,
      design   = design
    )),
    df$Study[1]
  )

  return(out)
}

tss_scale <- function(X, logComp, gamma = 1) {
  P <- nrow(X)
  nsample <- dim(logComp)[3]
  LambdaScale <- matrix(rnorm(P * nsample, mean = 0, sd = gamma),
    nrow = P, ncol = nsample
  )
  logScale <- t(X) %*% LambdaScale
  return(logScale)
}
na_if_blank <- function(x, ...) {
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  dplyr::na_if(x, "")
}
find_col <- function(df, patterns) {
  nms <- names(df)
  for (p in patterns) {
    idx <- which(str_detect(tolower(nms), tolower(p)))
    if (length(idx) > 0) {
      return(nms[idx[1]])
    }
  }
  NULL
}
coalesce_chr <- function(df, cols) {
  if (length(cols) == 1 && cols %in% names(df)) cols <- cols
  cols <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols) == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_character_, nrow(df)))
  }
  out <- as.character(df[[cols[1]]])
  if (length(cols) > 1) {
    for (cc in cols[-1]) out <- dplyr::coalesce(out, as.character(df[[cc]]))
  }
  out
}
coalesce_num <- function(df, cols) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(coalesce_chr(df, cols)))
}
norm_status <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_lower(na_if_blank(x))
  case_when(
    x %in% c("control", "ctrl", "td", "typical", "typical_development", "typical development", "t", "s") ~ "Control",
    x %in% c("autism", "asd", "case", "a") ~ "Autism",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}
norm_sex <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_lower(na_if_blank(x))
  case_when(
    x %in% c("m", "male") ~ "male",
    x %in% c("f", "female") ~ "female",
    x %in% c("unknown", "unk", "u") ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}
norm_region <- function(x) {
  x <- str_replace_all(as.character(x), "–", "-")
  x <- na_if_blank(x)
  ifelse(
    !is.na(x) & str_detect(x, "^V\\d-?V\\d$"),
    str_replace_all(x, "V(\\d)-?V(\\d)", "V\\1\\2"),
    x
  )
}
cohort_from_study <- function(study) {
  s <- na_if_blank(study)
  s <- str_replace_all(s, regex("\\bet\\s+al\\.?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE), "")
  s <- str_squish(s)
  s <- str_replace(s, "^([A-Za-z]+)\\s+(\\d{4}).*$", "\\1\\2")
  s <- str_replace_all(s, "[^A-Za-z0-9]", "")
  na_if_blank(s)
}
strip_fastq_ext <- function(x) {
  x <- na_if_blank(x)
  x <- str_replace(x, "\\.(fastq|fq)(\\.gz)?$", "")
  na_if_blank(x)
}
lookup_study_info <- function(proj, what = c("Study", "SeqRegion")) {
  what <- match.arg(what)
  if (!exists("study_info", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  si <- get("study_info", envir = .GlobalEnv)
  if (!all(c("Bioproject", "Study", "SeqRegion") %in% names(si))) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  row <- si[si$Bioproject == proj, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  as.character(row[[what]][1])
}
standardize_project_meta <- function(proj) {
  obj <- paste0(proj, "_meta")
  if (!exists(obj, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    warning("Missing: ", obj)
    return(NULL)
  }

  df <- get(obj, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  df <- as.data.frame(df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  run_col <- find_col(df, c("^run$", "run_accession", "sra_accession", "file_name", "sampleid", "sample_id"))
  if (is.null(run_col)) stop("No Run-like column found in ", obj)
  sampleid <- strip_fastq_ext(df[[run_col]])
  status_col <- find_col(df, c("^status$", "diagnosis", "host_disease", "host_disease_status"))
  Status <- if (!is.null(status_col)) norm_status(df[[status_col]]) else NA_character_
  age_cols <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "age")]
  age_weeks_cols <- age_cols[str_detect(tolower(age_cols), "week")]
  age_years_cols <- setdiff(age_cols, age_weeks_cols)
  age_weeks <- coalesce_num(df, age_weeks_cols)
  age_years <- coalesce_num(df, age_years_cols)
  Age <- dplyr::coalesce(age_years, age_weeks / 52)
  sex_cols <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "sex|gender")]
  Sex <- norm_sex(coalesce_chr(df, sex_cols))
  country_cols <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "geo_loc_name_country|country|geo_loc_name")]
  Subjects_Location <- coalesce_chr(df, country_cols)
  Subjects_Location <- ifelse(str_trim(Subjects_Location) == "US", "USA", Subjects_Location)
  Subjects_Location <- na_if_blank(Subjects_Location)
  study_col <- find_col(df, c("^study$", "paper", "publication"))
  Study <- if (!is.null(study_col)) coalesce_chr(df, study_col) else lookup_study_info(proj, "Study")
  seq_col <- find_col(df, c("^seqregion$", "seq_region", "variable_region", "region"))
  SeqRegion <- if (!is.null(seq_col)) coalesce_chr(df, seq_col) else lookup_study_info(proj, "SeqRegion")
  Cohort <- cohort_from_study(Study)
  Cohort <- ifelse(is.na(Cohort) | Cohort == "", proj, Cohort)
  Variable_Region <- norm_region(SeqRegion)
  tibble::tibble(
    sampleid = sampleid,
    Age = Age,
    Sex = Sex,
    Status = Status,
    Control_Type = NA_character_,
    Cohort = Cohort,
    Subjects_Location = Subjects_Location,
    Variable_Region = Variable_Region,
    Match_IDs = NA_character_
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(sampleid) & sampleid != "")
}

drop_all_zero_taxa <- function(X) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  keep <- rowSums(X != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  X[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

check_totals_preserved <- function(counts, G) {
  counts <- as.matrix(counts)
  storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric"
  orig <- rowSums(counts, na.rm = TRUE)
  new <- colSums(G, na.rm = TRUE)
  new <- new[rownames(counts)]
  list(
    same = isTRUE(all.equal(orig, new)),
    max_abs_diff = max(abs(orig - new), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

to_rank_matrix_nomunge <- function(counts, taxa,
                                   rank = "Genus",
                                   drop_unassigned = TRUE,
                                   unassigned_label = NULL) {
  counts <- as.matrix(counts)
  storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric"
  if (is.null(rownames(counts))) stop("counts must have rownames = sample IDs")
  if (is.null(colnames(counts))) stop("counts must have colnames = ASV IDs")
  if (is.null(rownames(taxa))) stop("taxa must have rownames = ASV IDs")
  feats <- colnames(counts)
  hit <- feats %in% rownames(taxa)
  if (!any(hit)) stop("No overlap between colnames(counts) and rownames(taxa).")
  if (!(rank %in% colnames(taxa))) stop("taxa is missing the rank column: ", rank)
  feats_use <- feats[hit]
  lab <- taxa[match(feats_use, rownames(taxa)), rank, drop = TRUE]
  lab <- trimws(as.character(lab))
  lab[lab %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")] <- NA_character_
  prefix_map <- c(
    Domain = "d__", Kingdom = "k__", Phylum = "p__", Class = "c__",
    Order = "o__", Family = "f__", Genus = "g__", Species = "s__"
  )
  pref <- if (!is.null(prefix_map[[rank]])) prefix_map[[rank]] else paste0(rank, "__")
  has_pref <- !is.na(lab) & grepl(paste0("^", gsub("([\\^\\$\\.|\\(\\)\\[\\]\\*\\+\\?\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", pref)), lab)
  lab2 <- lab
  lab2[!is.na(lab2) & !has_pref] <- paste0(pref, lab2[!is.na(lab2) & !has_pref])
  group <- lab2
  if (drop_unassigned) {
    keep <- !is.na(group)
    counts2 <- counts[, feats_use[keep], drop = FALSE]
    group2 <- group[keep]
  } else {
    if (is.null(unassigned_label)) unassigned_label <- paste0(pref, "Unassigned")
    group[is.na(group)] <- unassigned_label
    counts2 <- counts[, feats_use, drop = FALSE]
    group2 <- group
  }
  out <- rowsum(t(counts2), group = group2, reorder = TRUE)
  out <- drop_all_zero_taxa(out)
  out
}

make_rank_mats_from_taxa_df <- function(
  counts,
  taxa,
  ranks = c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus"),
  drop_unassigned = FALSE
) {
  out <- list()
  for (rk in ranks) {
    if (!rk %in% colnames(taxa)) next
    out[[rk]] <- to_rank_matrix_nomunge(
      counts = counts,
      taxa = taxa,
      rank = rk,
      drop_unassigned = drop_unassigned
    )
  }
  out
}

fix_cols_all_ranks <- function(mats_by_rank, pattern, replacement) {
  if (is.null(mats_by_rank) || !is.list(mats_by_rank)) {
    return(mats_by_rank)
  }
  lapply(mats_by_rank, function(M) {
    if (is.null(M)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    M <- as.matrix(M)
    colnames(M) <- sub(pattern, replacement, colnames(M))
    M
  })
}

for (p in projects) {
  counts_name <- paste0(p, "_counts")
  taxa_name <- paste0(p, "_taxa")
  if (!exists(counts_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    warning("Missing: ", counts_name)
    next
  }
  if (!exists(taxa_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    warning("Missing: ", taxa_name)
    next
  }
  counts_obj <- get(counts_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  taxa_obj <- get(taxa_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  if (is.null(rownames(taxa_obj))) stop(p, ": taxa has no rownames. They must be ASV IDs.")
  mats_by_rank <- make_rank_mats_from_taxa_df(
    counts = counts_obj,
    taxa = taxa_obj,
    ranks = c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus"),
    drop_unassigned = FALSE
  )
  assign(paste0(p, "_counts_by_rank"), mats_by_rank, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste0(p, "_counts_genus"), mats_by_rank[["Genus"]], envir = .GlobalEnv)
  chk <- check_totals_preserved(counts_obj, mats_by_rank[["Genus"]])
  if (!isTRUE(chk$same)) {
    warning(p, ": genus collapse changed sample totals (max_abs_diff=", chk$max_abs_diff, ").")
  }
}

col_totals <- function(M) {
  M <- as.matrix(M)
  storage.mode(M) <- "numeric"
  if (is.null(colnames(M))) stop("Matrix has no colnames (sample IDs).")
  colSums(M, na.rm = TRUE)
}

compare_col_totals <- function(A, B, nameA = "A", nameB = "B", tol = 0, show = 10) {
  if (is.null(A) || is.null(B)) stop("A or B is NULL.")
  ta <- col_totals(A)
  tb <- col_totals(B)

  shared <- intersect(names(ta), names(tb))
  onlyA <- setdiff(names(ta), names(tb))
  onlyB <- setdiff(names(tb), names(ta))

  d <- ta[shared] - tb[shared]
  bad <- which(abs(d) > tol)

  out <- list(
    nameA = nameA,
    nameB = nameB,
    nA = length(ta),
    nB = length(tb),
    n_shared = length(shared),
    n_onlyA = length(onlyA),
    n_onlyB = length(onlyB),
    max_abs_diff_shared = if (length(shared)) max(abs(d), na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    n_diff_gt_tol = length(bad)
  )

  if (length(bad)) {
    ord <- order(abs(d[bad]), decreasing = TRUE)
    top_idx <- bad[ord][seq_len(min(show, length(bad)))]
    out$top_diffs <- data.frame(
      sample = shared[top_idx],
      total_A = ta[shared][top_idx],
      total_B = tb[shared][top_idx],
      diff_A_minus_B = d[top_idx],
      row.names = NULL
    )
  } else {
    out$top_diffs <- data.frame()
  }

  out
}

merge_taxa_by_sample_prefer <- function(A, B,
                                        prefer = c("A", "B"),
                                        check_overlap = c("warn", "stop", "none"),
                                        tol = 0) {
  prefer <- match.arg(prefer)
  check_overlap <- match.arg(check_overlap)
  if (is.null(A) && is.null(B)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (is.null(A)) {
    return(as.matrix(B))
  }
  if (is.null(B)) {
    return(as.matrix(A))
  }
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  B <- as.matrix(B)
  storage.mode(A) <- "numeric"
  storage.mode(B) <- "numeric"
  if (is.null(rownames(A)) || is.null(colnames(A))) stop("A must have rownames=taxa and colnames=samples")
  if (is.null(rownames(B)) || is.null(colnames(B))) stop("B must have rownames=taxa and colnames=samples")
  if (anyDuplicated(colnames(A))) stop("A has duplicated sample columns")
  if (anyDuplicated(colnames(B))) stop("B has duplicated sample columns")
  if (anyDuplicated(rownames(A))) stop("A has duplicated taxa rows")
  if (anyDuplicated(rownames(B))) stop("B has duplicated taxa rows")
  taxa_all <- union(rownames(A), rownames(B))
  samp_all <- union(colnames(A), colnames(B))
  A2 <- matrix(0,
    nrow = length(taxa_all), ncol = ncol(A),
    dimnames = list(taxa_all, colnames(A))
  )
  B2 <- matrix(0,
    nrow = length(taxa_all), ncol = ncol(B),
    dimnames = list(taxa_all, colnames(B))
  )
  A2[match(rownames(A), taxa_all), ] <- A
  B2[match(rownames(B), taxa_all), ] <- B
  overlap_samps <- intersect(colnames(A2), colnames(B2))
  if (length(overlap_samps) > 0 && check_overlap != "none") {
    diffs <- abs(A2[, overlap_samps, drop = FALSE] - B2[, overlap_samps, drop = FALSE])
    max_diff <- max(diffs, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (max_diff > tol) {
      msg <- paste0("Overlapping samples differ (max abs diff = ", max_diff, ").")
      if (check_overlap == "stop") stop(msg) else warning(msg)
    }
  }
  out <- matrix(0,
    nrow = length(taxa_all), ncol = length(samp_all),
    dimnames = list(taxa_all, samp_all)
  )
  out[, colnames(A2)] <- out[, colnames(A2)] + A2
  b_only <- setdiff(colnames(B2), colnames(A2))
  if (length(b_only)) out[, b_only] <- out[, b_only] + B2[, b_only, drop = FALSE]
  if (length(overlap_samps)) {
    if (prefer == "A") {
      out[, overlap_samps] <- A2[, overlap_samps, drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      out[, overlap_samps] <- B2[, overlap_samps, drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
  out
}

is_missing <- function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x)) x <- as.character(x)
  if (is.character(x)) {
    return(is.na(x) | trimws(x) == "")
  }
  is.na(x)
}

for (nm in names(genus_level_studies)) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      X <- genus_level_studies[[nm]]

      if (is.null(X)) {
        cat("SKIP nm (counts is NULL):", nm, "\n")
      } else {
        samps <- trimws(as.character(colnames(X)))
        if (!nm %in% names(out) || is.null(out[[nm]])) {
          out[[nm]] <- list(counts = NULL, metadata = NULL, design = NULL)
        }
        if (!is.null(out[[nm]]$metadata) && is.data.frame(out[[nm]]$metadata)) {
          meta_nm <- out[[nm]]$metadata
          if (!("sampleid" %in% names(meta_nm))) {
            if ("ID" %in% names(meta_nm)) {
              meta_nm$sampleid <- meta_nm$ID
            } else if (!is.null(rownames(meta_nm)) && all(nzchar(rownames(meta_nm)))) {
              meta_nm$sampleid <- rownames(meta_nm)
            } else {
              meta_nm$sampleid <- NA_character_
            }
          }
          meta_nm$sampleid <- trimws(as.character(meta_nm$sampleid))
          if (anyDuplicated(meta_nm$sampleid) > 0) {
            meta_nm <- meta_nm[!duplicated(meta_nm$sampleid), , drop = FALSE]
          }
          meta_nm <- meta_nm[match(samps, meta_nm$sampleid), , drop = FALSE]
          meta_nm$sampleid <- samps
        } else {
          meta_nm <- data.frame(sampleid = samps, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        }
        meta_nm$ID <- samps
        idx_amp <- match(paste0(nm, "||", samps), meta_all$.key)
        amp_nm <- meta_all[idx_amp, , drop = FALSE]
        amp_nm$sampleid <- samps

        if (".key" %in% names(amp_nm)) amp_nm$.key <- NULL
        if (!all(is.na(idx_amp))) {
          amp_nm <- amp_nm[match(meta_nm$sampleid, amp_nm$sampleid), , drop = FALSE]
          shared <- intersect(names(meta_nm), names(amp_nm))
          shared <- setdiff(shared, c("sampleid", "ID"))
          for (cc in shared) {
            miss <- is_missing(meta_nm[[cc]])
            if (any(miss)) meta_nm[[cc]][miss] <- amp_nm[[cc]][miss]
          }
          new_cols <- setdiff(names(amp_nm), names(meta_nm))
          new_cols <- setdiff(new_cols, "sampleid")
          if (length(new_cols)) {
            meta_nm <- cbind(meta_nm, amp_nm[, new_cols, drop = FALSE])
          }
        }
        meta_nm <- meta_nm[match(samps, meta_nm$sampleid), , drop = FALSE]
        meta_nm$sampleid <- samps
        meta_nm$ID <- samps

        if (nrow(meta_nm) != length(samps)) stop("meta_nm row count mismatch")
        out[[nm]]$metadata <- meta_nm
      }
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat("FAILED nm:", nm, "\n")
      message(e)
      NULL
    }
  )
}

col_is_empty <- function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x)) x <- as.character(x)
  if (is.character(x)) x <- trimws(x)
  all(is.na(x) | x == "")
}

factor_is_usable <- function(x, min_levels = 2L) {
  if (col_is_empty(x)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  if (is.factor(x)) x <- as.character(x)
  if (is.character(x)) x <- trimws(x)
  x <- x[!(is.na(x) | x == "")]
  length(unique(x)) >= min_levels
}

numeric_is_usable <- function(x, min_unique = 2L) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) >= min_unique
}

studies <- c("Huang2021", "Berding2020", "David2021", "Fasano2020", "Fouquier2021", "Zurita2019", "Evans2022")
for (nm in intersect(studies, names(out))) {
  meta <- out[[nm]]$metadata
  if (!is.data.frame(meta)) meta <- as.data.frame(meta)
  if ("Status" %in% names(meta) && !"status" %in% names(meta)) {
    names(meta)[names(meta) == "Status"] <- "status"
  }
  if ("Status" %in% names(meta) && "status" %in% names(meta)) {
    meta$Status <- NULL
  }
  if ("sex" %in% names(meta) && !"Sex" %in% names(meta)) names(meta)[names(meta) == "sex"] <- "Sex"
  if ("age" %in% names(meta) && !"Age" %in% names(meta)) names(meta)[names(meta) == "age"] <- "Age"
  for (v in intersect(c("status", "Sex", "Match_IDs"), names(meta))) {
    if (is.factor(meta[[v]])) meta[[v]] <- as.character(meta[[v]])
    if (is.character(meta[[v]])) meta[[v]][trimws(meta[[v]]) == ""] <- NA
  }
  if ("status" %in% names(meta)) {
    z <- trimws(as.character(meta$status))
    z[z %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")] <- NA
    z[tolower(z) == "asd"] <- "autism"
    z[tolower(z) %in% c("control", "controls")] <- "control"
    meta$status <- factor(z)
    if ("control" %in% levels(meta$status)) meta$status <- stats::relevel(meta$status, ref = "control")
  }
  if ("Sex" %in% names(meta)) {
    meta$Sex <- factor(meta$Sex)
    if ("F" %in% levels(meta$Sex)) {
      meta$Sex <- stats::relevel(meta$Sex, ref = "F")
    } else if ("female" %in% levels(meta$Sex)) {
      meta$Sex <- stats::relevel(meta$Sex, ref = "female")
    }
  }
  if ("Age" %in% names(meta)) meta$Age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta$Age))
  if ("Match_IDs" %in% names(meta)) meta$Match_IDs <- factor(meta$Match_IDs)
  out[[nm]]$metadata <- meta

  if (nm == "David2021") {
    out[[nm]]$design <- ~ status + Age + Sex + (1 | Match_IDs)
  } else if (nm == "Evans2022") {
    if ("BMI" %in% names(meta)) meta$BMI <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta$BMI))
    if ("constipation" %in% names(meta)) names(meta)[names(meta) == "constipation"] <- "Constipation"
    if ("Constipation" %in% names(meta)) meta$Constipation <- factor(meta$Constipation)
    if ("Country" %in% names(meta)) meta$Country <- factor(meta$Country)

    out[[nm]]$metadata <- meta
    out[[nm]]$design <- ~ status + Age + Sex + BMI + Constipation + Country
  } else if (nm == "Huang2021") {
    out[[nm]]$design <- ~ status + Age
  } else if (nm == "Fasano2020") {
    out[[nm]]$design <- ~ status + Age
  } else {
    out[[nm]]$design <- ~ status + Age + Sex
  }
}

status_counts_str <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return("")
  }
  tt <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  paste0(names(tt), ":", as.integer(tt), collapse = " | ")
}

canon_status <- function(x) {
  x0 <- as.character(x)
  x0 <- str_trim(x0)
  x0[x0 %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "None", "none", "N/A", "n/a")] <- NA_character_
  xl <- tolower(x0)
  autism_terms <- c("asd", "autism", "case", "cases", "patient", "patients")
  control_terms <- c("control", "controls", "ctrl", "ctl", "con", "healthy", "typical", "neurotypical", "td")
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(xl))
  out[!is.na(xl) & xl %in% autism_terms] <- "autism"
  out[!is.na(xl) & xl %in% control_terms] <- "control"
  out
}

status_audit_out <- function(out) {
  imap_dfr(out, function(study_obj, study) {
    meta <- study_obj$metadata
    if (is.null(meta) || !is.data.frame(meta)) {
      return(tibble(
        study = study,
        has_Status = FALSE, has_status = FALSE,
        n_rows = NA_integer_,
        Status_counts = "", status_counts = "",
        values_only_in_Status = "", values_only_in_status = "",
        n_only_Status_nonNA = NA_integer_, n_only_status_nonNA = NA_integer_,
        n_both_nonNA = NA_integer_,
        n_row_mismatch_raw = NA_integer_, n_row_mismatch_norm = NA_integer_,
        unmapped_raw_values = ""
      ))
    }
    has_Status <- "Status" %in% names(meta)
    has_status <- "status" %in% names(meta)
    n_rows <- nrow(meta)
    Status_vec <- if (has_Status) meta$Status else rep(NA, n_rows)
    status_vec <- if (has_status) meta$status else rep(NA, n_rows)
    u_Status <- sort(unique(as.character(Status_vec[!is.na(Status_vec)])))
    u_status <- sort(unique(as.character(status_vec[!is.na(status_vec)])))
    only_in_Status <- base::setdiff(u_Status, u_status)
    only_in_status <- base::setdiff(u_status, u_Status)
    a_raw <- as.character(Status_vec)
    b_raw <- as.character(status_vec)
    both_nonNA <- !is.na(a_raw) & !is.na(b_raw)
    n_row_mismatch_raw <- if (any(both_nonNA)) sum(a_raw[both_nonNA] != b_raw[both_nonNA]) else 0L
    a_norm <- canon_status(Status_vec)
    b_norm <- canon_status(status_vec)
    both_nonNA_norm <- !is.na(a_norm) & !is.na(b_norm)
    n_row_mismatch_norm <- if (any(both_nonNA_norm)) sum(a_norm[both_nonNA_norm] != b_norm[both_nonNA_norm]) else 0L
    all_raw <- c(as.character(Status_vec), as.character(status_vec))
    all_raw <- unique(all_raw[!is.na(all_raw)])
    unmapped <- all_raw[is.na(canon_status(all_raw))]
    unmapped <- unmapped[!tolower(str_trim(unmapped)) %in% c("", "na", "nan", "null", "none", "n/a")]
    tibble(
      study = study,
      has_Status = has_Status,
      has_status = has_status,
      n_rows = n_rows,
      Status_counts = if (has_Status) status_counts_str(Status_vec) else "",
      status_counts = if (has_status) status_counts_str(status_vec) else "",
      values_only_in_Status = if (length(only_in_Status)) paste(only_in_Status, collapse = ", ") else "",
      values_only_in_status = if (length(only_in_status)) paste(only_in_status, collapse = ", ") else "",
      n_only_Status_nonNA = sum(!is.na(Status_vec) & is.na(status_vec)),
      n_only_status_nonNA = sum(is.na(Status_vec) & !is.na(status_vec)),
      n_both_nonNA = sum(both_nonNA),
      n_row_mismatch_raw = n_row_mismatch_raw,
      n_row_mismatch_norm = n_row_mismatch_norm,
      unmapped_raw_values = if (length(unmapped)) paste(unmapped, collapse = ", ") else ""
    )
  })
}

clean_out_to_single_status <- function(out, strict = FALSE) {
  audit_before <- status_audit_out(out)
  for (st in names(out)) {
    meta <- out[[st]]$metadata
    if (is.null(meta) || !is.data.frame(meta)) next
    has_Status <- "Status" %in% names(meta)
    has_status <- "status" %in% names(meta)
    Status_vec <- if (has_Status) meta$Status else rep(NA, nrow(meta))
    status_vec <- if (has_status) meta$status else rep(NA, nrow(meta))
    a <- canon_status(Status_vec)
    b <- canon_status(status_vec)
    conflict <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(b) & (a != b)
    if (strict && any(conflict)) {
      bad <- which(conflict)[1]
      stop(
        "Study ", st, ": Status vs status conflict at row ", bad,
        " (Status=", as.character(Status_vec[bad]), ", status=", as.character(status_vec[bad]), ")."
      )
    }

    final <- dplyr::coalesce(b, a)
    bad_final <- !is.na(final) & !(final %in% c("autism", "control"))
    if (any(bad_final)) {
      bad_vals <- unique(final[bad_final])
      if (strict) {
        stop("Study ", st, ": unmapped final status values: ", paste(bad_vals, collapse = ", "))
      }
      final[bad_final] <- NA_character_
    }
    meta$status <- factor(final, levels = c("control", "autism"))
    if ("Status" %in% names(meta)) meta$Status <- NULL
    out[[st]]$metadata <- meta
  }

  audit_after <- status_audit_out(out)
  issues_before <- audit_before %>%
    filter(
      (has_Status & has_status & (values_only_in_Status != "" | values_only_in_status != "" | n_row_mismatch_raw > 0 | n_row_mismatch_norm > 0)) |
        (has_Status != has_status) |
        (n_only_Status_nonNA > 0 | n_only_status_nonNA > 0) |
        (unmapped_raw_values != "")
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(n_row_mismatch_raw), desc(n_row_mismatch_norm),
      desc(n_only_Status_nonNA + n_only_status_nonNA)
    )

  issues_after <- audit_after %>%
    filter(
      (has_Status & has_status & (values_only_in_Status != "" | values_only_in_status != "" | n_row_mismatch_raw > 0 | n_row_mismatch_norm > 0)) |
        (has_Status != has_status) |
        (n_only_Status_nonNA > 0 | n_only_status_nonNA > 0) |
        (unmapped_raw_values != "")
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(n_row_mismatch_raw), desc(n_row_mismatch_norm),
      desc(n_only_Status_nonNA + n_only_status_nonNA)
    )

  list(
    out = out,
    audit_before = audit_before,
    audit_after = audit_after,
    issues_before = issues_before,
    issues_after = issues_after
  )
}

unassigned_summary <- data.frame(
  study = character(0),
  n_samples = integer(0),
  mean_pct_unassigned = numeric(0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (st in names(out)) {
  X <- out[[st]]$counts
  if (is.null(X)) next
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  storage.mode(X) <- "numeric"
  rn <- rownames(X)
  if (is.null(rn)) next
  keep_un <- unassigned_rows(rn)
  totals_by_sample <- colSums(X, na.rm = TRUE)
  un_by_sample <- if (any(keep_un)) colSums(X[keep_un, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) else rep(0, ncol(X))
  pct_un_by_sample <- ifelse(totals_by_sample > 0, 100 * un_by_sample / totals_by_sample, NA_real_)
  mean_pct <- mean(pct_un_by_sample, na.rm = TRUE)
  unassigned_summary <- rbind(
    unassigned_summary,
    data.frame(
      study = st,
      n_samples = ncol(X),
      mean_pct_unassigned = mean_pct,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}
```

```{r load cleaned amplicon data}
load("out_cleaned2.RData")

min_prevalence <- 0.10
for (study_name in names(out)) {
  counts_mat <- out[[study_name]]$counts
  meta_df <- out[[study_name]]$metadata
  if (is.null(counts_mat) || is.null(meta_df)) {
    warning(paste("Skipping", study_name, "- missing data."))
    next
  }
  common_samples <- intersect(colnames(counts_mat), meta_df$sampleid)
  if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
    warning(paste("Skipping", study_name, "- sample IDs do not match."))
    next
  }
  counts_work <- counts_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
  meta_work <- meta_df[match(common_samples, meta_df$sampleid), ]
  status_lower <- tolower(trimws(as.character(meta_work$status)))
  idx_autism <- which(grepl("^(autism|asd)$", status_lower, perl = TRUE))
  idx_control <- which(grepl("^(control)", status_lower, perl = TRUE))
  if (length(idx_autism) > 0) {
    prev_autism <- rowMeans(counts_work[, idx_autism, drop = FALSE] > 0)
  } else {
    prev_autism <- rep(0, nrow(counts_work))
  }
  if (length(idx_control) > 0) {
    prev_control <- rowMeans(counts_work[, idx_control, drop = FALSE] > 0)
  } else {
    prev_control <- rep(0, nrow(counts_work))
  }
  keep_taxa <- (prev_autism >= min_prevalence) | (prev_control >= min_prevalence)
  keep_taxa[is.na(keep_taxa)] <- FALSE
  original_count <- nrow(out[[study_name]]$counts)
  out[[study_name]]$counts <- out[[study_name]]$counts[keep_taxa, , drop = FALSE]
  final_count <- nrow(out[[study_name]]$counts)
  cat(sprintf(
    "[%s] Filtered taxa: %d -> %d (Removed %d)\n",
    study_name, original_count, final_count, original_count - final_count
  ))
}

if (!requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("digest")

library(digest)
library(biomformat)

norm_seq <- function(s) toupper(gsub("\\s+", "", s))
is_md5 <- function(x) grepl("^[0-9a-f]{32}$", tolower(x))
is_dna <- function(x) grepl("^[ACGTNacgtn]+$", x)

gg2_version <- "2024.09"
gg2_dir <- "gg2_cache"
dir.create(gg2_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
gg2_fasta_gz <- file.path(gg2_dir, paste0(gg2_version, ".seqs.fna.gz"))
gg2_fasta_url <- paste0("https://ftp.microbio.me/greengenes_release/current/", gg2_version, ".seqs.fna.gz")
if (!file.exists(gg2_fasta_gz)) download.file(gg2_fasta_url, gg2_fasta_gz, mode = "wb", quiet = FALSE)

gg2_ids_rds <- file.path(gg2_dir, paste0(gg2_version, ".record_id_set.rds"))
if (file.exists(gg2_ids_rds)) {
  gg2_record_ids <- readRDS(gg2_ids_rds)
} else {
  con <- gzfile(gg2_fasta_gz, open = "rt")
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  ids <- character()
  repeat {
    x <- readLines(con, n = 50000L, warn = FALSE)
    if (length(x) == 0) break
    hdr <- x[startsWith(x, ">")]
    if (length(hdr)) {
      tok <- sub("^>(\\S+).*", "\\1", hdr)
      ids <- c(ids, tok)
    }
  }
  gg2_record_ids <- unique(ids)
  saveRDS(gg2_record_ids, gg2_ids_rds)
}
gg2_record_ids <- as.character(gg2_record_ids)
gg2_record_set <- gg2_record_ids
rm(gg2_record_ids)

write_fasta <- function(ids, seqs, path) {
  ok <- !is.na(ids) & nzchar(ids) & !is.na(seqs) & nzchar(seqs)
  ids <- ids[ok]
  seqs <- seqs[ok]
  if (length(ids) == 0) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  con <- file(path, "wt")
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  for (i in seq_along(ids)) {
    writeLines(paste0(">", ids[i]), con)
    writeLines(paste(strwrap(norm_seq(seqs[i]), 80), collapse = "\n"), con)
  }
  TRUE
}

pick_sample_id_col <- function(df, sample_ids) {
  cols <- names(df)
  pref <- c("ID", "sampleid", "sampleID")
  pref_hits <- cols[tolower(cols) %in% tolower(pref)]
  cand <- unique(c(pref_hits, cols))
  best <- NULL
  best_score <- -1
  for (cn in cand) {
    v <- df[[cn]]
    if (!(is.character(v) || is.factor(v))) next
    v <- as.character(v)
    sc <- mean(sample_ids %in% v)
    if (is.finite(sc) && sc > best_score) {
      best_score <- sc
      best <- cn
    }
  }
  list(col = best, score = best_score)
}

pick_status_col <- function(df) {
  cand <- c(
    "status", "Status", "diagnosis", "Diagnosis", "group", "Group", "condition", "Condition",
    "case_control", "CaseControl", "phenotype", "Phenotype", "asd_control", "ASD_Control"
  )
  for (cn in cand) {
    if (cn %in% names(df)) {
      return(cn)
    }
  }
  NULL
}

outdir <- "qiime_inputs"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

manifest <- list()
k <- 0L

for (study in names(out)) {
  cm0 <- out[[study]]$counts_original
  if (is.null(cm0)) next
  cm <- as.matrix(cm0)
  if (is.null(rownames(cm)) || is.null(colnames(cm))) next

  rn_raw <- rownames(cm)
  vals <- unname(rn_raw)
  nm <- names(rn_raw)

  frac_gg2_record <- mean(vals %in% gg2_record_set)
  id_type <- if (isTRUE(frac_gg2_record >= 0.90)) "gg2_record" else if (all(is_md5(vals))) "md5" else if (mean(is_dna(vals)) > 0.9) "dna" else "id"

  feat_ids <- vals
  rep_ids <- NULL
  rep_seqs <- NULL
  label <- rep(NA_character_, length(vals))
  if (!is.null(nm) && length(nm) == length(vals)) label <- nm

  if (id_type == "gg2_record") {
    feat_ids <- vals
    rownames(cm) <- feat_ids
    rep_ids <- feat_ids
  } else if (id_type == "md5") {
    feat_ids <- tolower(vals)
    rownames(cm) <- feat_ids
    if (any(duplicated(feat_ids))) {
      cm <- rowsum(cm, group = feat_ids, reorder = FALSE)
      feat_ids <- rownames(cm)
      label <- rep(NA_character_, length(feat_ids))
    }
    rep_ids <- feat_ids
    if (!is.null(nm) && length(nm) == length(vals) && mean(is_dna(nm)) > 0.9) {
      tmp <- setNames(norm_seq(nm), tolower(unname(vals)))
      rep_seqs <- unname(tmp[rep_ids])
    } else if (!is.null(out[[study]]$tax) && is.data.frame(out[[study]]$tax)) {
      tx <- out[[study]]$tax
      if (all(c("GG2_md5", "ASV_seq") %in% names(tx))) {
        tmp <- setNames(tx$ASV_seq, tolower(tx$GG2_md5))
        rep_seqs <- unname(tmp[rep_ids])
      }
    }
  } else if (id_type == "dna") {
    seqs <- vals
    gg2 <- vapply(norm_seq(seqs), digest::digest, character(1), algo = "md5", serialize = FALSE)
    feat_ids <- tolower(gg2)
    rownames(cm) <- feat_ids
    if (any(duplicated(feat_ids))) {
      cm <- rowsum(cm, group = feat_ids, reorder = FALSE)
      rep_ids <- rownames(cm)
      rep_seqs <- rep(NA_character_, length(rep_ids))
      label <- rep(NA_character_, length(rep_ids))
    } else {
      rep_ids <- feat_ids
      rep_seqs <- norm_seq(seqs)
      if (!is.null(nm) && length(nm) == length(vals)) label <- nm
    }
  } else {
    feat_ids <- vals
    rownames(cm) <- feat_ids
    rep_ids <- feat_ids
    if (!is.null(nm) && length(nm) == length(vals) && mean(is_dna(nm)) > 0.9) rep_seqs <- norm_seq(nm)
  }

  study_dir <- file.path(outdir, study)
  dir.create(study_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  biom_path <- file.path(study_dir, "table.biom")
  write_biom(make_biom(data = cm), biom_path)

  wrote_repseqs <- FALSE
  if (id_type %in% c("md5", "dna", "id")) {
    if (!is.null(rep_ids) && !is.null(rep_seqs) && length(rep_ids) == length(rep_seqs) && mean(is_dna(rep_seqs[!is.na(rep_seqs)])) > 0.9) {
      wrote_repseqs <- write_fasta(rep_ids, rep_seqs, file.path(study_dir, "rep-seqs.fasta"))
    }
  }

  fm_path <- file.path(study_dir, "feature-map.tsv")
  fm <- data.frame(
    feature_id = rownames(cm),
    label = if (id_type == "md5" && !is.null(nm) && length(nm) == length(vals)) {
      tmp_lab <- setNames(label, tolower(unname(vals)))
      unname(tmp_lab[rownames(cm)])
    } else if (length(label) == nrow(cm)) label else rep(NA_character_, nrow(cm)),
    rep_seq = if (!is.null(rep_seqs) && length(rep_seqs) == nrow(cm)) rep_seqs else rep(NA_character_, nrow(cm)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  m <- out[[study]]$metadata
  sample_ids <- colnames(cm)

  md_out <- data.frame(`#SampleID` = sample_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  wrote_status <- FALSE
  sampleid_col_used <- NA_character_
  status_col_used <- NA_character_

  if (is.data.frame(m) && nrow(m) > 0) {
    df <- m
    if (!is.null(rownames(df)) && mean(sample_ids %in% rownames(df)) > 0.5) {
      df$.__rowname_sid__ <- rownames(df)
      rownames(df) <- NULL
    }
    sid_col <- NULL
    if (".__rowname_sid__" %in% names(df)) {
      sid_col <- ".__rowname_sid__"
    } else {
      pick <- pick_sample_id_col(df, sample_ids)
      if (!is.null(pick$col) && isTRUE(pick$score >= 0.5)) sid_col <- pick$col
    }
    if (!is.null(sid_col)) {
      sampleid_col_used <- sid_col
      sid <- as.character(df[[sid_col]])
      ord <- match(sample_ids, sid)
      df2 <- df[ord, , drop = FALSE]
      stc <- pick_status_col(df2)
      if (!is.null(stc)) {
        status_col_used <- stc
        md_out$status <- as.character(df2[[stc]])
        wrote_status <- TRUE
      }
    }
  } else if (is.list(m) && length(m) > 0) {
    cand <- c(
      "status", "Status", "diagnosis", "Diagnosis", "group", "Group", "condition", "Condition",
      "case_control", "CaseControl", "phenotype", "Phenotype", "asd_control", "ASD_Control"
    )
    stc <- cand[cand %in% names(m)][1]
    if (!is.na(stc) && !is.null(stc)) {
      v <- m[[stc]]
      if (length(v) == length(sample_ids)) {
        md_out$status <- as.character(v)
        wrote_status <- TRUE
        status_col_used <- stc
      } else if (!is.null(names(v))) {
        md_out$status <- as.character(v[sample_ids])
        wrote_status <- TRUE
        status_col_used <- stc
      }
    }
  }

  if (wrote_status) {
    keep_rows <- !is.na(md_out$status) & (tolower(md_out$status) %in% c("autism", "control", "asd"))
    md_out <- md_out[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(md_out) > 0) {
      cm <- cm[, md_out[["#SampleID"]], drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      cm <- cm[, character(0), drop = FALSE]
    }
  } else {
    md_out <- md_out[FALSE, , drop = FALSE]
    cm <- cm[, character(0), drop = FALSE]
  }

  study_dir <- file.path(outdir, study)
  dir.create(study_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  # Export TSV Feature Table
  out_tbl <- data.frame(`#OTU ID` = rownames(cm), as.data.frame(cm), check.names = FALSE)
  write.table(out_tbl, file.path(study_dir, "table.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

  wrote_repseqs <- FALSE
  if (id_type %in% c("md5", "dna", "id")) {
    if (!is.null(rep_ids) && !is.null(rep_seqs) && length(rep_ids) == length(rep_seqs) && mean(is_dna(rep_seqs[!is.na(rep_seqs)])) > 0.9) {
      wrote_repseqs <- write_fasta(rep_ids, rep_seqs, file.path(study_dir, "rep-seqs.fasta"))
    }
  }

  fm_path <- file.path(study_dir, "feature-map.tsv")
  fm <- data.frame(
    feature_id = rownames(cm),
    label = if (id_type == "md5" && !is.null(nm) && length(nm) == length(vals)) {
      tmp_lab <- setNames(label, tolower(unname(vals)))
      unname(tmp_lab[rownames(cm)])
    } else if (length(label) == nrow(cm)) label else rep(NA_character_, nrow(cm)),
    rep_seq = if (!is.null(rep_seqs) && length(rep_seqs) == nrow(cm)) rep_seqs else rep(NA_character_, nrow(cm)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write.table(fm, fm_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

  write.table(md_out, file.path(study_dir, "metadata.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

  k <- k + 1L
  manifest[[k]] <- data.frame(
    Study = study,
    id_type = id_type,
    frac_gg2_record = frac_gg2_record,
    n_features = nrow(cm),
    n_samples = ncol(cm),
    wrote_repseqs = wrote_repseqs,
    wrote_status = wrote_status,
    sampleid_col = sampleid_col_used,
    status_col = status_col_used,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

manifest_df <- if (length(manifest)) do.call(rbind, manifest) else data.frame()
write.table(manifest_df, file.path(outdir, "manifest.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r summary_stats_visualization, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(vegan)
  library(cowplot)
  library(scales)
  library(grid)
})

set.seed(1)
study_stats_list <- list()
study_metrics_list <- list()
permdisp_list <- list()

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("")
  }
  if (p < 0.001) {
    return("***")
  }
  if (p < 0.01) {
    return("**")
  }
  if (p < 0.05) {
    return("*")
  }
  ""
}

for (study_name in names(out)) {
  cts <- out[[study_name]]$counts
  if (is.null(cts)) next
  cts <- as.matrix(cts)
  storage.mode(cts) <- "numeric"

  meta <- out[[study_name]]$metadata
  if (is.null(meta) || nrow(meta) == 0) next

  sample_ids_in_counts <- colnames(cts)
  meta_sids <- rownames(meta)
  match_frac <- mean(sample_ids_in_counts %in% meta_sids)

  sid_col <- NULL
  if (match_frac < 0.5) {
    if (exists("pick_sample_id_col")) {
      pick <- pick_sample_id_col(meta, sample_ids_in_counts)
      if (!is.null(pick$col) && pick$score > 0.5) {
        sid_col <- pick$col
        meta_sids <- as.character(meta[[sid_col]])
      }
    } else {
      cands <- c("sampleid", "SampleID", "ID", "id", "#SampleID")
      for (cj in cands) {
        if (cj %in% names(meta)) {
          curr <- as.character(meta[[cj]])
          if (mean(sample_ids_in_counts %in% curr) > 0.5) {
            sid_col <- cj
            meta_sids <- curr
            break
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  common <- intersect(sample_ids_in_counts, meta_sids)
  if (length(common) < 5) next

  cts_sub <- cts[, common, drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(sid_col)) {
    row_idxs <- match(common, as.character(meta[[sid_col]]))
  } else {
    row_idxs <- match(common, rownames(meta))
  }
  meta_sub <- meta[row_idxs, , drop = FALSE]

  group_vec <- NULL
  if ("status" %in% names(meta_sub)) {
    group_vec <- meta_sub$status
  } else if ("Status" %in% names(meta_sub)) {
    group_vec <- meta_sub$Status
  } else if (exists("pick_status_col")) {
    stc <- pick_status_col(meta_sub)
    if (!is.null(stc)) group_vec <- meta_sub[[stc]]
  }
  if (is.null(group_vec)) next
  group_vec <- as.character(group_vec)

  # A) Sequencing depth
  depths <- colSums(cts_sub, na.rm = TRUE)

  # B) Sparsity
  sparsity <- colMeans(cts_sub == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  # C) Dispersion (Bray–Curtis on relative abundance)
  cts_prop <- apply(cts_sub, 2, function(x) x / sum(x))
  dist_bray <- tryCatch(vegan::vegdist(t(cts_prop), method = "bray"), error = function(e) NULL)

  disp_vals <- rep(NA_real_, length(common))
  if (!is.null(dist_bray) && length(unique(group_vec)) >= 1) {
    g_fac <- factor(group_vec)
    if (nlevels(g_fac) >= 1 && length(common) > nlevels(g_fac)) {
      try(
        {
          mod <- vegan::betadisper(dist_bray, g_fac)
          disp_vals <- mod$distances
        },
        silent = TRUE
      )
    }
  }

  permdisp_p <- NA_real_

  if (!is.null(dist_bray)) {
    g2 <- factor(group_vec)
    tabN <- table(g2)

    if (nlevels(g2) == 2 && all(tabN >= 2)) {
      try(
        {
          bd2 <- vegan::betadisper(dist_bray, g2)
          bd2p <- vegan::permutest(bd2, permutations = 999)
          permdisp_p <- as.numeric(as.data.frame(bd2p$tab)[1, "Pr(>F)"])
        },
        silent = TRUE
      )
    }
  }

  permdisp_list[[study_name]] <- data.frame(
    Study = study_name,
    PERMDISP_p = permdisp_p,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  PERMDISP_p <- NA_real_
  PERMDISP_F <- NA_real_
  PERMANOVA_p <- NA_real_
  PERMANOVA_F <- NA_real_
  PERMANOVA_R2 <- NA_real_

  if (!is.null(dist_bray)) {
    g_fac <- factor(group_vec)
    tabN <- table(g_fac)

    if (nlevels(g_fac) >= 2 && all(tabN >= 2)) {
      # PERMDISP (dispersion difference)
      try(
        {
          bd <- vegan::betadisper(dist_bray, g_fac)
          bd_perm <- vegan::permutest(bd, permutations = 999)
          bd_tab <- as.data.frame(bd_perm$tab)[1, , drop = FALSE]
          PERMDISP_F <- as.numeric(bd_tab[["F"]])
          PERMDISP_p <- as.numeric(bd_tab[["Pr(>F)"]])
        },
        silent = TRUE
      )

      # PERMANOVA (centroid/location difference)
      try(
        {
          dat <- data.frame(g = g_fac)
          ad <- vegan::adonis2(dist_bray ~ g, data = dat, permutations = 999)
          ad_row <- as.data.frame(ad)[1, , drop = FALSE]
          PERMANOVA_F <- as.numeric(ad_row[["F"]])
          PERMANOVA_R2 <- as.numeric(ad_row[["R2"]])
          PERMANOVA_p <- as.numeric(ad_row[["Pr(>F)"]])
        },
        silent = TRUE
      )
    }
  }

  study_stats_list[[study_name]] <- data.frame(
    Study = study_name,
    PERMDISP_F = PERMDISP_F,
    PERMDISP_p = PERMDISP_p,
    PERMANOVA_F = PERMANOVA_F,
    PERMANOVA_R2 = PERMANOVA_R2,
    PERMANOVA_p = PERMANOVA_p,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # D) Shannon Diversity
  div_shannon <- tryCatch(
    vegan::diversity(t(cts_sub), index = "shannon"),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(common))
  )

  # E) Observed features
  obs_features <- colSums(cts_sub > 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  study_metrics_list[[study_name]] <- data.frame(
    Study = study_name,
    SampleID = common,
    Group = group_vec,
    Depth = depths,
    Sparsity = sparsity,
    Dispersion = disp_vals,
    Shannon = div_shannon,
    Observed = obs_features,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

df_viz <- do.call(rbind, study_metrics_list)

if (is.null(df_viz) || nrow(df_viz) == 0) {
  message("No valid data for plotting.")
} else {
  # ----------------------------
  # 2) Clean groups + ordering
  # ----------------------------
  df_viz <- df_viz %>%
    mutate(
      Group = trimws(as.character(Group)),
      Group = ifelse(tolower(Group) %in% c("na", "nan", "null", ""), NA_character_, Group)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group))

  if (nrow(df_viz) == 0) {
    message("All samples had missing Group after filtering.")
  } else {
    df_viz$Group <- factor(tolower(df_viz$Group))

    # Order studies by total N (prettier + more informative than alphabetical)
    study_order <- df_viz %>%
      dplyr::count(Study, name = "N") %>%
      arrange(N) %>%
      pull(Study)
    df_viz$Study <- factor(df_viz$Study, levels = study_order)

    df_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(study_stats_list)
    df_permdisp <- dplyr::bind_rows(permdisp_list) %>%
      mutate(Study = factor(Study, levels = levels(df_viz$Study)))

    fmt_p <- function(p) {
      ifelse(is.na(p), "", paste0("p=", format.pval(p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3)))
    }

    # ----------------------------
    # 3) Nature-quality styling
    # ----------------------------
    okabe_ito <- c(
      "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73", "#CC79A7",
      "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#F0E442", "#000000"
    )
    group_levels <- levels(df_viz$Group)
    pal_group <- setNames(okabe_ito[seq_along(group_levels)], group_levels)

    base_size <- 15
    theme_nature2 <- theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
      theme(
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 4, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 6)),
        axis.title = element_text(size = base_size + 1),
        axis.text = element_text(size = base_size, color = "grey15"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "grey15"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "grey15"),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.35),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.9, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 12, 10, 12)
      )

    geom_box_pretty <- function(width = 0.70, lw = 0.75, out_alpha = 0.20, out_size = 1.4) {
      list(
        geom_boxplot(
          width = width,
          linewidth = lw,
          color = "grey15",
          fatten = 2.6,
          outlier.alpha = out_alpha,
          outlier.size = out_size,
          outlier.stroke = 0,
          whisker.linewidth = 1,
          staplewidth = 0.5,
          staple.linewidth = 0.8
        )
      )
    }

    scale_fill_group <- scale_fill_manual(values = pal_group, drop = FALSE)

    # 1) Sample size
    df_counts <- df_viz %>% dplyr::count(Study, Group, name = "n")

    p_size <- ggplot(df_counts, aes(x = Study, y = n, fill = Group)) +
      geom_col(
        position = position_dodge2(width = 0.85, preserve = "single"),
        width = 0.78,
        color = "grey15",
        linewidth = 0.75
      ) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = n),
        position = position_dodge2(width = 0.85, preserve = "single"),
        hjust = -0.12,
        size = 4.0,
        color = "grey10"
      ) +
      coord_flip(clip = "off") +
      scale_fill_group +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))) +
      theme_nature2 +
      labs(
        title = "Sample size and balance per study",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Sample count",
        fill = "Group"
      )

    print(p_size)

    ord_fun <- median

    # ----------------------------
    # A) p_spar (ordered by Sparsity)
    # ----------------------------
    spar_order <- df_viz %>%
      group_by(Study) %>%
      summarise(ord = ord_fun(Sparsity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(ord) %>% # low -> high; use desc(ord) if you want opposite
      pull(Study)

    df_spar_comb <- df_viz %>%
      mutate(Study = factor(Study, levels = spar_order))

    p_spar_comb <- ggplot(df_spar_comb, aes(x = Study, y = Sparsity, fill = Group)) +
      geom_box_pretty(width = 0.68, lw = 0.75) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_group +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
        breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 5),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
      ) +
      theme_nature2 +
      labs(
        title = "Sparsity",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Fraction zeros",
        fill = "Group"
      )

    # ----------------------------
    # B) p_disp - SECOND plot
    # ----------------------------
    df_disp_comb <- df_viz %>%
      filter(!is.na(Dispersion)) %>%
      mutate(Study = factor(Study, levels = spar_order))

    # Add permutation stars for dispersion
    df_disp_sig2 <- df_disp_comb %>%
      group_by(Study) %>%
      summarise(ymax = max(Dispersion, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(df_permdisp, by = "Study") %>%
      mutate(stars = vapply(PERMDISP_p, p_to_stars, character(1))) %>%
      filter(stars != "" & is.finite(ymax))

    rngc <- range(df_disp_comb$Dispersion, na.rm = TRUE)
    offc <- if (is.finite(diff(rngc)) && diff(rngc) > 0) 0.06 * diff(rngc) else 0.02
    tickc <- 0.01 * diff(rngc)
    star_push <- offc * 0.3

    df_disp_sig2$y_bar <- df_disp_sig2$ymax + offc
    df_disp_sig2$y_star <- df_disp_sig2$ymax + offc * 1.55

    p_disp_comb <- ggplot(df_disp_comb, aes(x = Study, y = Dispersion, fill = Group)) +
      geom_box_pretty(width = 0.68, lw = 0.75) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_group +
      scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 5),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
      ) +
      theme_nature2 +
      theme(
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank()
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Dispersion",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Distance to centroid",
        fill = "Group"
      )

    df_disp_sig2 <- df_disp_sig2[0, , drop = FALSE]

    # Annotate dispersion with stars
    boxdat2 <- ggplot_build(p_disp_comb)$data[[1]]
    levS2 <- levels(df_disp_comb$Study)
    # Map index to factor level
    boxdat2$Study <- levS2[pmax(1, pmin(length(levS2), round(boxdat2$x)))]

    br_disp2 <- boxdat2 %>%
      group_by(Study) %>%
      summarise(
        x1 = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        x2 = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        whisk = max(ymax, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      left_join(df_permdisp, by = "Study") %>%
      mutate(stars = vapply(PERMDISP_p, p_to_stars, character(1))) %>%
      filter(stars != "" & is.finite(whisk))

    br_disp2 <- br_disp2 %>%
      mutate(
        y = whisk + offc,
        y_tick = y - tickc,
        x_mid = (x1 + x2) / 2
      )

    p_disp_comb <- p_disp_comb +
      geom_segment(
        data = br_disp2,
        aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        linewidth = 0.90,
        color = "grey15"
      ) +
      geom_segment(
        data = br_disp2,
        aes(x = x1, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y_tick),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        linewidth = 0.90,
        color = "grey15"
      ) +
      geom_segment(
        data = br_disp2,
        aes(x = x2, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y_tick),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        linewidth = 0.90,
        color = "grey15"
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = br_disp2,
        aes(x = x_mid, y = y, label = stars),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        angle = 90,
        nudge_y = star_push,
        vjust = 0.5,
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 4.4,
        color = "grey15"
      ) +
      coord_flip(clip = "off") +
      geom_point(
        data = df_disp_sig2,
        aes(x = Study, y = y_bar),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        shape = 95,
        size = 6.5
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = df_disp_sig2,
        aes(x = Study, y = y_star, label = stars),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 5
      )

    # ----------------------------
    # C) Sequencing Depth - THIRD plot
    # ----------------------------
    df_depth_comb <- df_viz %>%
      filter(!is.na(Depth)) %>%
      mutate(Study = factor(Study, levels = spar_order))

    p_depth_comb <- ggplot(df_depth_comb, aes(x = Study, y = Depth, fill = Group)) +
      geom_box_pretty(width = 0.68, lw = 0.75) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_group +
      scale_y_log10(
        breaks = trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x),
        labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x)),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
      ) +
      theme_nature2 +
      theme(
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank()
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Sequencing Depth",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Total reads (log10)",
        fill = "Group"
      )

    # ----------------------------
    # D) Shannon Diversity - FOURTH plot
    # ----------------------------
    df_shannon_comb <- df_viz %>%
      filter(!is.na(Shannon)) %>%
      mutate(Study = factor(Study, levels = spar_order))

    p_shannon_comb <- ggplot(df_shannon_comb, aes(x = Study, y = Shannon, fill = Group)) +
      geom_box_pretty(width = 0.68, lw = 0.75) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_group +
      scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 5),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
      ) +
      theme_nature2 +
      theme(
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank()
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Alpha Diversity",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Shannon Index",
        fill = "Group"
      )

    # ----------------------------
    # E) Observed Features - FIFTH plot
    # ----------------------------
    df_obs_comb <- df_viz %>%
      filter(!is.na(Observed)) %>%
      mutate(Study = factor(Study, levels = spar_order))

    p_obs_comb <- ggplot(df_obs_comb, aes(x = Study, y = Observed, fill = Group)) +
      geom_box_pretty(width = 0.68, lw = 0.75) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_group +
      scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 5),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
      ) +
      theme_nature2 +
      theme(
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank()
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Richness",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Observed Features",
        fill = "Group"
      )

    # ----------------------------
    # Combine all 5 plots
    # ----------------------------
    leg <- cowplot::get_legend(p_spar_comb + theme(legend.position = "top"))

    # Strip legends and margins
    p1 <- p_spar_comb + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 0, 0))
    p2 <- p_disp_comb + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 0, 0))
    p3 <- p_depth_comb + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 0, 0))
    p4 <- p_shannon_comb + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 0, 0))
    p5 <- p_obs_comb + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

    p_side <- cowplot::plot_grid(
      p1, p2, p3, p4, p5,
      nrow = 1,
      align = "h",
      axis = "tb",
      rel_widths = c(1.4, 1, 1, 1, 1)
    )

    p_final <- cowplot::plot_grid(
      leg,
      p_side,
      ncol = 1,
      rel_heights = c(0.13, 1)
    )

    print(p_final)

    ggsave("Fig_study_summary_stats.pdf", p_final, width = 15, height = 10, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
    ggsave("Fig_study_summary_stats.png", p_final, width = 15, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 600)
  }
}
```
