```{r diff abundance}
tss_scale <- function(X, logComp, gamma = 0.5) {
  P <- nrow(X)
  nsample <- dim(logComp)[3]
  LambdaScale <- matrix(rnorm(P * nsample, mean = 0, sd = gamma),
    nrow = P, ncol = nsample
  )
  t(X) %*% LambdaScale
}

make_tss_scale <- function(gamma) {
  force(gamma)
  function(X, logComp, ...) tss_scale(X, logComp, gamma = gamma)
}

is_mixed_design <- function(design) {
  tl <- attr(terms(design), "term.labels")
  any(grepl("\\|", tl))
}

split_design <- function(design) {
  term_labels <- attr(terms(design), "term.labels")
  rand_idx <- grepl("\\|", term_labels)
  fixed_terms <- term_labels[!rand_idx]
  rand_raw <- term_labels[rand_idx]
  rand_terms <- trimws(gsub("[()]", "", rand_raw))
  fixed_string <- if (length(fixed_terms)) paste(fixed_terms, collapse = " + ") else "1"
  fixed_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", fixed_string))
  rand_formula <- if (length(rand_terms)) {
    as.formula(paste("~", paste(rand_terms, collapse = " + ")))
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  rand_string <- if (length(rand_terms)) paste(rand_terms, collapse = " + ") else ""
  rand_groups <- if (length(rand_raw)) {
    trimws(gsub("[()]", "", sub(".*\\|", "", rand_raw)))
  } else {
    character(0)
  }

  list(
    fixed_formula = fixed_formula,
    rand_formula  = rand_formula,
    fixed_terms   = fixed_terms,
    rand_terms    = rand_terms,
    fixed_string  = fixed_string,
    rand_string   = rand_string,
    rand_groups   = rand_groups
  )
}

count_summary_from_Y <- function(Y) {
  Y <- as.matrix(Y)
  n_taxa <- nrow(Y)
  n_samp <- ncol(Y)
  lib <- if (n_samp) colSums(Y) else numeric(0)
  sp <- if (n_taxa && n_samp) rowMeans(Y == 0) else numeric(0)
  prev <- if (n_taxa && n_samp) rowMeans(Y > 0) else numeric(0)
  tot <- if (n_taxa) rowSums(Y) else numeric(0)
  list(
    n_taxa = n_taxa,
    n_samples = n_samp,
    lib_min = if (length(lib)) min(lib) else NA_real_,
    lib_median = if (length(lib)) stats::median(lib) else NA_real_,
    lib_mean = if (length(lib)) mean(lib) else NA_real_,
    lib_max = if (length(lib)) max(lib) else NA_real_,
    sparsity_min = if (length(sp)) min(sp) else NA_real_,
    sparsity_median = if (length(sp)) stats::median(sp) else NA_real_,
    sparsity_mean = if (length(sp)) mean(sp) else NA_real_,
    sparsity_max = if (length(sp)) max(sp) else NA_real_,
    prevalence_min = if (length(prev)) min(prev) else NA_real_,
    prevalence_median = if (length(prev)) stats::median(prev) else NA_real_,
    prevalence_mean = if (length(prev)) mean(prev) else NA_real_,
    prevalence_max = if (length(prev)) max(prev) else NA_real_,
    tax_total_min = if (length(tot)) min(tot) else NA_real_,
    tax_total_median = if (length(tot)) stats::median(tot) else NA_real_,
    tax_total_mean = if (length(tot)) mean(tot) else NA_real_,
    tax_total_max = if (length(tot)) max(tot) else NA_real_
  )
}

diagnose_random_effects <- function(meta, rand_groups) {
  out <- list()
  for (g in rand_groups) {
    if (!g %in% names(meta)) {
      out[[g]] <- list(present = FALSE, note = "missing in metadata")
      next
    }
    z_raw <- meta[[g]]
    z_chr <- trimws(as.character(z_raw))
    z_chr[z_chr %in% c("", "NA", "NaN")] <- NA
    z_fac <- factor(z_chr)
    n_obs <- nrow(meta)
    n_levels <- nlevels(droplevels(z_fac[!is.na(z_fac)]))
    tab <- table(z_fac, useNA = "ifany")
    sizes <- as.integer(tab)
    sizes_no_na <- sizes[names(tab) != "<NA>"]
    ok_levels_vs_obs <- is.finite(n_levels) && (n_levels >= 2L) && (n_levels < n_obs)

    out[[g]] <- list(
      present = TRUE,
      n_obs = n_obs,
      n_levels = n_levels,
      levels_over_obs_ratio = if (n_obs > 0) n_levels / n_obs else NA_real_,
      ok_levels_vs_obs = ok_levels_vs_obs,
      size_summary = summary(sizes_no_na),
      n_singletons = sum(sizes_no_na == 1L),
      n_pairs = sum(sizes_no_na == 2L),
      n_ge3 = sum(sizes_no_na >= 3L),
      n_missing = sum(is.na(z_fac)),
      note = if (!ok_levels_vs_obs) "BAD: need n_levels < n_obs (and at least 2 levels)" else "OK"
    )
  }
  out
}

harmonize_var_name <- function(df, want = "status", aliases = c("status")) {
  nms <- names(df)
  nms_l <- tolower(nms)
  aliases_l <- unique(tolower(c(want, aliases)))
  hits <- which(nms_l %in% aliases_l)
  if (!length(hits)) {
    return(df)
  }
  if (want %in% nms) {
    drop_idx <- hits[nms[hits] != want]
    if (length(drop_idx)) df[[nms[drop_idx[1]]]] <- NULL
    return(df)
  }
  first <- hits[1]
  old <- nms[first]
  names(df)[names(df) == old] <- want
  if (length(hits) > 1) {
    extra <- setdiff(nms[hits], old)
    for (e in extra) df[[e]] <- NULL
  }
  df
}

prepare_study <- function(study_obj,
                          min_nonzero = 3L,
                          min_total = 9L,
                          max_sparsity = 1,
                          normalize_run_ids = TRUE,
                          on_bad_random = c("drop", "warn", "stop")) {
  on_bad_random <- match.arg(on_bad_random)

  Y <- study_obj$counts
  X <- study_obj$metadata
  design <- study_obj$design

  if (!is.matrix(Y)) stop("counts must be a matrix")
  if (!is.data.frame(X)) X <- as.data.frame(X)
  if (is.null(design) || !inherits(design, "formula")) stop("design must be a formula")
  if ("ID" %in% names(X)) {
    rownames(X) <- as.character(X$ID)
  } else if ("sampleid" %in% names(X)) {
    rownames(X) <- as.character(X$sampleid)
  } else if (!is.null(rownames(X))) {
    rownames(X) <- as.character(rownames(X))
  } else {
    stop("metadata needs an 'ID' column, 'sampleid' column, or rownames as sample IDs")
  }

  keep_id <- !is.na(rownames(X)) & nzchar(rownames(X))
  X <- X[keep_id, , drop = FALSE]
  if (any(duplicated(rownames(X)))) X <- X[!duplicated(rownames(X)), , drop = FALSE]
  if (normalize_run_ids) {
    normalize_run <- function(z) {
      m <- regmatches(z, regexpr("(SRR|ERR|DRR)[0-9]+", z, perl = TRUE))
      ifelse(m == "", z, m)
    }
    if (length(intersect(colnames(Y), rownames(X))) < 2L) {
      colnames(Y) <- normalize_run(colnames(Y))
      rownames(X) <- normalize_run(rownames(X))
    }
  }

  sample_ids <- intersect(colnames(Y), rownames(X))
  if (length(sample_ids) < 2L) stop("Not enough overlapping samples after ID matching")

  Y <- Y[, sample_ids, drop = FALSE]
  X <- X[sample_ids, , drop = FALSE]

  vars_in_design <- all.vars(design)

  if ("Status" %in% vars_in_design && !"Status" %in% names(X) && "status" %in% names(X)) names(X)[names(X) == "status"] <- "Status"
  if ("status" %in% vars_in_design && !"status" %in% names(X) && "Status" %in% names(X)) names(X)[names(X) == "Status"] <- "status"
  if ("Sex" %in% vars_in_design && !"Sex" %in% names(X) && "sex" %in% names(X)) names(X)[names(X) == "sex"] <- "Sex"
  if ("sex" %in% vars_in_design && !"sex" %in% names(X) && "Sex" %in% names(X)) names(X)[names(X) == "Sex"] <- "sex"
  if ("Age" %in% vars_in_design && !"Age" %in% names(X) && "age" %in% names(X)) names(X)[names(X) == "age"] <- "Age"
  if ("age" %in% vars_in_design && !"age" %in% names(X) && "Age" %in% names(X)) names(X)[names(X) == "Age"] <- "age"
  if ("Status" %in% names(X)) {
    z <- trimws(as.character(X$Status))
    z[z %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")] <- NA
    X$Status <- factor(z)
    if ("Control" %in% levels(X$Status)) X$Status <- stats::relevel(X$Status, ref = "Control")
  }
  if ("status" %in% names(X)) {
    z <- trimws(as.character(X$status))
    z[z %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")] <- NA
    X$status <- factor(z)
    if ("Control" %in% levels(X$status)) X$status <- stats::relevel(X$status, ref = "Control")
  }

  if ("Sex" %in% names(X)) {
    z <- trimws(as.character(X$Sex))
    z[z %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")] <- NA
    X$Sex <- factor(z)
    if ("F" %in% levels(X$Sex)) X$Sex <- stats::relevel(X$Sex, ref = "F")
    if ("female" %in% levels(X$Sex)) X$Sex <- stats::relevel(X$Sex, ref = "female")
  }
  if ("sex" %in% names(X)) {
    z <- trimws(as.character(X$sex))
    z[z %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")] <- NA
    X$sex <- factor(z)
    if ("F" %in% levels(X$sex)) X$sex <- stats::relevel(X$sex, ref = "F")
    if ("female" %in% levels(X$sex)) X$sex <- stats::relevel(X$sex, ref = "female")
  }

  if ("Age" %in% names(X)) X$Age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(X$Age))
  if ("age" %in% names(X)) X$age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(X$age))
  if ("Age" %in% names(X)) X$Age[!is.finite(X$Age) | X$Age <= 0] <- NA
  if ("age" %in% names(X)) X$age[!is.finite(X$age) | X$age <= 0] <- NA

  if ("Match_IDs" %in% names(X)) {
    z <- trimws(as.character(X$Match_IDs))
    z[z %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")] <- NA
    X$Match_IDs <- factor(z)
  }
  d_parts0 <- split_design(design)
  if (length(d_parts0$rand_groups)) {
    for (g in d_parts0$rand_groups) {
      if (g %in% names(X)) {
        z <- trimws(as.character(X[[g]]))
        z[z %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")] <- NA
        X[[g]] <- factor(z)
      }
    }
  }

  parts_fixed_first <- split_design(design)
  fixed_vars <- all.vars(parts_fixed_first$fixed_formula)
  missing_fixed <- setdiff(fixed_vars, names(X))
  if (length(missing_fixed)) {
    stop("Missing fixed-effect variable(s) in metadata: ", paste(missing_fixed, collapse = ", "))
  }

  keep_meta_fixed <- stats::complete.cases(X[, fixed_vars, drop = FALSE])
  Y <- Y[, keep_meta_fixed, drop = FALSE]
  X <- X[keep_meta_fixed, , drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(Y) < 2L) stop("Not enough samples after dropping missing fixed-effect metadata")

  lib0 <- colSums(Y)
  keep_s0 <- is.finite(lib0) & (lib0 > 0)
  Y <- Y[, keep_s0, drop = FALSE]
  X <- X[keep_s0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(Y) < 2L) stop("Not enough samples after dropping zero-library samples")

  rand_diagnostics <- NULL
  bad_rand_groups <- character(0)
  dropped_random_terms <- FALSE

  d_parts <- split_design(design)
  if (length(d_parts$rand_groups) > 0L) {
    rand_diagnostics <- vector("list", length(d_parts$rand_groups))
    names(rand_diagnostics) <- d_parts$rand_groups

    for (g in d_parts$rand_groups) {
      if (!g %in% names(X)) {
        bad_rand_groups <- c(bad_rand_groups, g)
        rand_diagnostics[[g]] <- list(present = FALSE, note = "missing in metadata")
        next
      }

      z <- X[[g]]
      keep_g <- !is.na(z)
      n_obs_eff <- sum(keep_g)
      z2 <- droplevels(z[keep_g])
      n_levels <- nlevels(z2)

      tab <- table(z2, useNA = "no")
      sizes <- as.integer(tab)
      n_singletons <- sum(sizes == 1L)
      n_pairs <- sum(sizes == 2L)
      n_ge3 <- sum(sizes >= 3L)

      ratio_levels_to_obs <- if (n_obs_eff > 0L) n_levels / n_obs_eff else NA_real_
      prop_singletons <- if (n_levels > 0L) n_singletons / n_levels else NA_real_

      ok_basic <- (n_obs_eff >= 2L) && (n_levels >= 2L) && (n_levels < n_obs_eff)
      ok_not_unique <- is.finite(ratio_levels_to_obs) && (ratio_levels_to_obs <= 0.75)
      ok_pairing <- is.finite(prop_singletons) && (prop_singletons <= 0.25)

      ok <- ok_basic && ok_not_unique && ok_pairing

      rand_diagnostics[[g]] <- list(
        present = TRUE,
        n_obs_eff = n_obs_eff,
        n_levels = n_levels,
        ratio_levels_to_obs = ratio_levels_to_obs,
        n_singletons = n_singletons,
        n_pairs = n_pairs,
        n_ge3 = n_ge3,
        prop_singletons = prop_singletons,
        ok = ok,
        note = if (ok) "OK" else "BAD"
      )

      if (!ok) bad_rand_groups <- c(bad_rand_groups, g)
    }

    bad_rand_groups <- unique(bad_rand_groups)

    if (length(bad_rand_groups) > 0L) {
      msg <- paste0(
        "Bad random-effect grouping factor(s): ",
        paste(bad_rand_groups, collapse = ", "),
        ". Mixed model needs: (1) >=2 non-missing samples, (2) >=2 group ids, (3) #group ids < #samples-with-id. ",
        "Also guarded against nearly-unique ids (levels/obs > 0.75) and mostly-singleton ids (singletons/levels > 0.25)."
      )

      if (on_bad_random == "stop") {
        stop(msg)
      } else if (on_bad_random == "warn") {
        warning(msg, call. = FALSE)
      } else if (on_bad_random == "drop") {
        warning(msg, " Dropping random terms; using fixed-only formula.", call. = FALSE)
        design <- d_parts$fixed_formula
        dropped_random_terms <- TRUE
      }
    }

    if (!dropped_random_terms && length(d_parts$rand_groups) > 0L) {
      keep_rand <- stats::complete.cases(X[, d_parts$rand_groups, drop = FALSE])
      Y <- Y[, keep_rand, drop = FALSE]
      X <- X[keep_rand, , drop = FALSE]
      if (ncol(Y) < 2L) stop("Not enough samples after dropping missing random-effect group ids")
      lib1 <- colSums(Y)
      keep_s1 <- is.finite(lib1) & (lib1 > 0)
      Y <- Y[, keep_s1, drop = FALSE]
      X <- X[keep_s1, , drop = FALSE]
      if (ncol(Y) < 2L) stop("Not enough samples after dropping zero-library samples (post random-id filter)")
    }
  }

  summary_pre <- count_summary_from_Y(Y)
  keep_t <- rowSums(Y > 0) >= min_nonzero & rowSums(Y) >= min_total
  Y_filt <- Y[keep_t, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(Y_filt) < 2L) stop("Not enough taxa left after min_nonzero/min_total filtering")

  sp <- rowMeans(Y_filt == 0)
  keep_sparse <- sp <= max_sparsity
  dropped_sparse <- sum(!keep_sparse)
  Y_filt <- Y_filt[keep_sparse, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(Y_filt) < 2L) stop("Not enough taxa left after sparsity filtering")

  lib2 <- colSums(Y_filt)
  keep_s2 <- is.finite(lib2) & (lib2 > 0)
  if (any(!keep_s2)) {
    Y_filt <- Y_filt[, keep_s2, drop = FALSE]
    X <- X[keep_s2, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (ncol(Y_filt) < 2L) stop("Not enough samples after dropping samples with zero library (post taxa filtering)")

  summary_post <- count_summary_from_Y(Y_filt)

  d_parts_final <- split_design(design)

  list(
    counts = Y_filt,
    metadata = X,
    design = design,
    fixed_formula = d_parts_final$fixed_formula,
    fixed_string = d_parts_final$fixed_string,
    rand_terms = d_parts_final$rand_terms,
    rand_string = d_parts_final$rand_string,
    rand_groups = d_parts_final$rand_groups,
    rand_diagnostics = rand_diagnostics,
    bad_rand_groups = bad_rand_groups,
    dropped_random_terms = dropped_random_terms,
    vars = intersect(all.vars(design), names(X)),
    sample_ids = colnames(Y_filt),
    count_summary = list(
      max_sparsity = max_sparsity,
      dropped_sparse = dropped_sparse,
      pre = summary_pre,
      post = summary_post
    )
  )
}


design_matrix_checks <- function(meta, fixed_formula, kappa_warn = 1e8) {
  mm <- tryCatch(stats::model.matrix(fixed_formula, data = meta),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(mm, "error")) {
    return(list(
      ok = FALSE,
      error = conditionMessage(mm),
      n = NA_integer_, p = NA_integer_, rank = NA_integer_,
      singular = NA, finite = NA, df_ok = NA,
      bad_const_cols = character(0),
      kappa = NA_real_, kappa_warn = FALSE
    ))
  }

  n <- nrow(mm)
  p <- ncol(mm)
  r <- qr(mm)$rank

  finite_ok <- all(is.finite(mm))
  singular <- (r < p)
  df_ok <- (n > p)

  const_cols <- names(which(apply(mm, 2, function(z) all(z == z[1]))))
  bad_const <- setdiff(const_cols, "(Intercept)")
  const_ok <- length(bad_const) == 0L

  kap <- NA_real_
  if (p >= 2L && p <= 200L) {
    kap <- tryCatch(kappa(mm), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }
  kap_warn <- is.finite(kap) && (kap >= kappa_warn)

  list(
    ok = (!singular) && finite_ok && const_ok && df_ok,
    error = NULL,
    n = n, p = p, rank = r,
    singular = singular,
    finite = finite_ok,
    df_ok = df_ok,
    bad_const_cols = bad_const,
    kappa = kap,
    kappa_warn = kap_warn
  )
}

variable_checks <- function(meta, fixed_formula) {
  vars <- all.vars(fixed_formula)
  missing <- setdiff(vars, names(meta))
  if (length(missing)) {
    return(list(ok = FALSE, missing = missing, bad = list()))
  }
  bad <- list()
  for (v in vars) {
    z <- meta[[v]]
    if (is.character(z)) z <- factor(trimws(z))
    if (is.factor(z)) {
      z2 <- droplevels(z[!is.na(z)])
      if (nlevels(z2) < 2L) {
        bad[[v]] <- paste0("factor has <2 levels (levels=", nlevels(z2), ")")
      }
    } else if (is.numeric(z) || is.integer(z)) {
      z2 <- z[is.finite(z)]
      if (length(z2) < 2L) {
        bad[[v]] <- "numeric has <2 finite values"
      } else if (stats::sd(z2) == 0) {
        bad[[v]] <- "numeric is constant (sd=0)"
      }
    } else {
      z2 <- factor(trimws(as.character(z)))
      z2 <- droplevels(z2[!is.na(z2)])
      if (nlevels(z2) < 2L) {
        bad[[v]] <- paste0("treated-as-factor has <2 levels (levels=", nlevels(z2), ")")
      }
    }
  }

  list(ok = (length(bad) == 0L), missing = character(0), bad = bad)
}

parse_rand_term <- function(term) {
  term <- gsub("[()]", "", term)
  term <- gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(term))
  left <- trimws(sub("\\|.*$", "", term))
  grp <- trimws(sub("^.*\\|", "", term))
  vars <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(left, "\\+")))
  vars <- vars[vars != ""]
  slope_vars <- setdiff(vars, "1")
  list(group = grp, slope_vars = slope_vars)
}

random_structure_checks <- function(meta,
                                    rand_terms,
                                    min_levels = 2L,
                                    min_repeats_per_level = 2L,
                                    min_levels_with_repeats = 2L,
                                    min_levels_with_slope_variation = 2L) {
  if (!length(rand_terms)) {
    return(list(ok = TRUE, per_term = list(), note = "no random terms"))
  }

  per_term <- list()
  ok_all <- TRUE

  for (rt in rand_terms) {
    pr <- parse_rand_term(rt)
    g <- pr$group
    sv <- pr$slope_vars

    if (!g %in% names(meta)) {
      per_term[[rt]] <- list(ok = FALSE, note = paste0("group '", g, "' missing"))
      ok_all <- FALSE
      next
    }

    gf <- meta[[g]]
    gf <- factor(trimws(as.character(gf)))
    gf[gf %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")] <- NA

    keep <- !is.na(gf)
    gf2 <- droplevels(gf[keep])
    n_obs <- sum(keep)
    n_lev <- nlevels(gf2)
    tab <- table(gf2)
    n_rep_levels <- sum(tab >= min_repeats_per_level)
    ok_basic <- (n_obs >= 2L) &&
      (n_lev >= min_levels) &&
      (n_lev < n_obs) &&
      (n_rep_levels >= min_levels_with_repeats)
    slope_ok <- TRUE
    slope_notes <- list()
    if (length(sv)) {
      for (v in sv) {
        if (!v %in% names(meta)) {
          slope_ok <- FALSE
          slope_notes[[v]] <- "slope variable missing"
          next
        }
        z <- meta[[v]][keep]
        if (is.character(z)) z <- factor(trimws(z))
        by_grp <- split(z, gf2)
        has_var <- vapply(by_grp, function(u) {
          u <- u[!is.na(u)]
          if (!length(u)) {
            return(FALSE)
          }
          if (is.factor(u)) {
            nlevels(droplevels(u)) >= 2L
          } else {
            u2 <- u[is.finite(u)]
            length(unique(u2)) >= 2L
          }
        }, logical(1))
        n_var_groups <- sum(has_var)
        if (n_var_groups < min_levels_with_slope_variation) {
          slope_ok <- FALSE
          slope_notes[[v]] <- paste0(
            "need >= ", min_levels_with_slope_variation,
            " groups with within-group variation; got ", n_var_groups
          )
        } else {
          slope_notes[[v]] <- paste0("OK (groups with variation=", n_var_groups, ")")
        }
      }
    }
    ok_term <- ok_basic && slope_ok
    per_term[[rt]] <- list(
      ok = ok_term,
      group = g,
      n_obs = n_obs,
      n_levels = n_lev,
      n_levels_with_repeats = n_rep_levels,
      slope_vars = sv,
      slope_notes = slope_notes,
      note = if (ok_term) "OK" else "BAD"
    )

    if (!ok_term) ok_all <- FALSE
  }

  list(ok = ok_all, per_term = per_term, note = if (ok_all) "OK" else "BAD")
}

preflight_from_prep <- function(prep) {
  parts <- split_design(prep$design)
  vchk <- variable_checks(prep$metadata, parts$fixed_formula)
  dchk <- design_matrix_checks(prep$metadata, parts$fixed_formula)
  rchk <- random_structure_checks(prep$metadata, parts$rand_terms)
  has_random_slopes <- any(vapply(parts$rand_terms, function(rt) {
    length(parse_rand_term(rt)$slope_vars) > 0L
  }, logical(1)))
  fixed_ok <- isTRUE(vchk$ok) && isTRUE(dchk$ok)
  mixed_ok <- fixed_ok && (length(parts$rand_terms) == 0L || isTRUE(rchk$ok))
  by_method <- list(
    aldex3_mem_0 = mixed_ok,
    aldex3_mem_0p3 = mixed_ok,
    aldex3_mem_0p5 = mixed_ok,
    aldex3_mem_1 = mixed_ok,
    lmerSeq = mixed_ok,
    nbzimm = mixed_ok && length(parts$rand_terms) > 0L,
    ancombc2 = mixed_ok && !has_random_slopes,
    maaslin2 = mixed_ok && !has_random_slopes,
    edger = fixed_ok,
    deseq2 = fixed_ok,
    voom_limma = fixed_ok,
    metagenomeSeq = fixed_ok,
    linda = fixed_ok,
    corncob = fixed_ok
  )

  list(
    fixed_formula = parts$fixed_formula,
    rand_terms = parts$rand_terms,
    checks = list(
      variable = vchk,
      design_matrix = dchk,
      random = rchk,
      has_random_slopes = has_random_slopes
    ),
    by_method = by_method,
    ok_any = any(unlist(by_method), na.rm = TRUE),
    ok_all = all(unlist(by_method), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

run_aldex3_mem <- function(Y,
                           meta,
                           design,
                           mc.samples = 2000L,
                           scale_fun = tss_scale,
                           c.mu = NULL,
                           c.cor = NULL,
                           fixed_method = "lm",
                           mixed_method = "lme4",
                           test = "t.HC3") {
  mixed <- is_mixed_design(design)
  method <- if (mixed) mixed_method else fixed_method
  ALDEx3::aldex(
    Y        = Y,
    X        = design,
    data     = meta,
    method   = method,
    nsample  = mc.samples,
    scale    = scale_fun,
    c.mu     = c.mu,
    c.cor    = c.cor,
    test     = test
  )
}

run_deseq2 <- function(Y, meta, design, fitType = "parametric") {
  message("running deseq2")
  parts <- split_design(design)
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(Y),
    colData   = meta,
    design    = parts$fixed_formula
  )
  DESeq2::DESeq(dds, fitType = fitType, sfType = "poscounts")
}

run_edger <- function(Y,
                      meta,
                      design,
                      coef_name = NULL,
                      robust = TRUE) {
  message("running edgeR")
  Y <- as.matrix(Y)
  stopifnot(!is.null(colnames(Y)))
  stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(meta)))
  meta <- meta[colnames(Y), , drop = FALSE]
  parts <- split_design(design)
  fixed_formula <- parts$fixed_formula
  X <- stats::model.matrix(fixed_formula, data = meta)
  stopifnot(nrow(X) == ncol(Y))
  if (any(!is.finite(Y))) stop("edgeR: Y has non-finite values")
  if (any(Y < 0)) stop("edgeR: Y has negative values")
  Y <- round(Y)
  storage.mode(Y) <- "integer"
  y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = Y)
  lib1 <- colSums(y$counts)
  keep_s1 <- lib1 > 0
  if (!all(keep_s1)) {
    message("edgeR: dropping ", sum(!keep_s1), " zero-library samples (pre-filter)")
    y <- y[, keep_s1, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
    X <- X[keep_s1, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  stopifnot(ncol(y) == nrow(X))
  keep_f <- edgeR::filterByExpr(y, design = X)
  if (sum(keep_f) < 2L) stop("edgeR: <2 taxa left after filterByExpr")
  y <- y[keep_f, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  lib2 <- colSums(y$counts)
  keep_s2 <- lib2 > 0
  if (!all(keep_s2)) {
    message("edgeR: dropping ", sum(!keep_s2), " zero-library samples (post-filter)")
    y <- y[, keep_s2, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
    X <- X[keep_s2, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  stopifnot(ncol(y) == nrow(X))
  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")
  y <- edgeR::estimateDisp(y, design = X, robust = robust)
  fit <- edgeR::glmFit(y, design = X)
  if (is.null(coef_name)) {
    cn <- colnames(X)
    hit <- grep("Status|status|Group|Autism|autism|ASD|Case", cn, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (length(hit) == 0) stop("edgeR: could not auto-pick coef_name; pass coef_name explicitly.")
    coef_name <- hit[1]
  }
  coef_idx <- match(coef_name, colnames(X))
  if (is.na(coef_idx)) stop("edgeR: coef_name not found in design matrix columns.")
  tt <- edgeR::topTags(edgeR::glmLRT(fit, coef = coef_idx),
    n = Inf, sort.by = "none"
  )$table
  tibble::tibble(
    feature  = rownames(tt),
    estimate = tt$logFC,
    se       = NA_real_,
    p_value  = tt$PValue,
    q_value  = tt$FDR
  )
}

run_voom_limma <- function(Y, meta, design) {
  message("running limma voom")
  parts <- split_design(design)
  X <- stats::model.matrix(parts$fixed_formula, data = meta)
  dge <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = Y)
  keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(dge, design = X)
  dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
  v <- limma::voom(dge, design = X, plot = FALSE)
  fit <- limma::lmFit(v, X)
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit, robust = TRUE)
  list(voom = v, fit = fit)
}

run_metagenomeseq <- function(Y, meta, design) {
  message("running metagenomeseq")
  parts <- split_design(design)
  M <- metagenomeSeq::newMRexperiment(
    counts    = as.matrix(Y),
    phenoData = methods::new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = meta)
  )
  p <- metagenomeSeq::cumNormStatFast(M)
  M <- metagenomeSeq::cumNorm(M, p)
  mm <- stats::model.matrix(parts$fixed_formula,
    data = Biobase::pData(M)
  )
  metagenomeSeq::fitZig(obj = M, mod = mm)
}

run_linda <- function(Y, meta, design, n.cores = 4L, ...) {
  if (tolower(.Platform$OS.type) == "windows") n.cores <- 1L
  parts <- split_design(design)
  f <- paste(deparse(parts$fixed_formula), collapse = " ")
  MicrobiomeStat::linda(as.matrix(Y), meta, f, n.cores = n.cores, ...)
}

run_ancombc2 <- function(Y,
                         meta,
                         design,
                         group = "Status",
                         tax_level = NULL,
                         assay_name = "counts",
                         p_adj_method = "BH",
                         fallback_fixed = TRUE,
                         ...) {
  message("running ancombc2")
  parts <- split_design(design)
  otu <- phyloseq::otu_table(as.matrix(Y), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
  sam <- phyloseq::sample_data(meta)
  ps <- phyloseq::phyloseq(otu, sam)
  fix_string <- if (length(parts$fixed_terms)) paste(parts$fixed_terms, collapse = " + ") else "1"
  has_random_slopes <- FALSE
  if (length(parts$rand_terms)) {
    has_random_slopes <- any(grepl("^\\s*1\\s*\\|", parts$rand_terms) == FALSE)
  }
  rand_string <- NULL
  if (length(parts$rand_terms) && !has_random_slopes) {
    rand_string <- paste0("(", paste(parts$rand_terms, collapse = ") + ("), ")")
  }
  run_fixed <- function(note = NULL, orig = NULL) {
    res2 <- ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
      data         = ps,
      assay_name   = assay_name,
      tax_level    = tax_level,
      fix_formula  = fix_string,
      rand_formula = NULL,
      group        = group,
      p_adj_method = p_adj_method,
      ...
    )
    if (!is.null(note)) res2$fallback_note <- note
    if (!is.null(orig)) res2$fallback_orig <- orig
    res2
  }
  if (has_random_slopes) {
    return(run_fixed(note = "ANCOMBC2: random slopes present; ran fixed-only"))
  }
  res <- tryCatch(
    ANCOMBC::ancombc2(
      data         = ps,
      assay_name   = assay_name,
      tax_level    = tax_level,
      fix_formula  = fix_string,
      rand_formula = rand_string,
      group        = group,
      p_adj_method = p_adj_method,
      ...
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  if (inherits(res, "error")) {
    if (isTRUE(fallback_fixed)) {
      return(run_fixed(
        note = "ANCOMBC2: mixed run errored; ran fixed-only",
        orig = conditionMessage(res)
      ))
    }
    stop(res)
  }
  if (isTRUE(fallback_fixed) &&
    !is.null(res$message) &&
    grepl("number of levels of each grouping factor must be < number of observations",
      res$message,
      fixed = TRUE
    )) {
    return(run_fixed(
      note = "ANCOMBC2: mixed run hit lmerTest levels/obs issue; ran fixed-only",
      orig = res$message
    ))
  }
  res
}

run_maaslin2 <- function(Y, meta, design, output_dir,
                         normalization = "TSS", transform = "LOG",
                         standardize = FALSE, ...) {
  message("running maaslin2")
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  parts <- split_design(design)
  fixed_effects <- parts$fixed_terms
  random_effects <- unique(parts$rand_groups)

  args <- list(
    input_data     = t(as.matrix(Y)),
    input_metadata = meta,
    output         = output_dir,
    fixed_effects  = fixed_effects,
    random_effects = random_effects,
    normalization  = normalization,
    transform      = transform,
    standardize    = standardize,
    ...
  )

  fm <- names(formals(Maaslin2::Maaslin2))
  if ("plot_heatmap" %in% fm) args$plot_heatmap <- FALSE
  if ("plot_scatter" %in% fm) args$plot_scatter <- FALSE
  if ("plot_box" %in% fm) args$plot_box <- FALSE

  out_obj <- tryCatch(
    do.call(Maaslin2::Maaslin2, args),
    error = function(e) {
      if (file.exists(file.path(output_dir, "all_results.tsv"))) {
        return(list(output_dir = output_dir, plot_error = conditionMessage(e)))
      }
      stop(e)
    }
  )

  out_obj
}

run_nbzimm <- function(Y,
                       meta,
                       design,
                       lib_size_col = NULL,
                       min.p = 0.0,
                       ...) {
  message("running nbzimm")
  parts <- split_design(design)
  if (is.null(parts$rand_formula) || !length(parts$rand_groups)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  g <- parts$rand_groups[1]
  if (!g %in% names(meta)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  gg <- factor(meta[[g]])
  if (nlevels(gg) < 2L || nlevels(gg) >= nrow(meta)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  meta[[g]] <- gg
  fixed_terms <- parts$fixed_terms
  if (!is.null(lib_size_col)) {
    if (!lib_size_col %in% names(meta)) stop("lib_size_col not found in metadata")
    fixed_terms <- c(fixed_terms, sprintf("offset(log(%s))", lib_size_col))
  }
  fixed_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", if (length(fixed_terms)) paste(fixed_terms, collapse = " + ") else "1"))
  random_formula <- parts$rand_formula
  y_mat <- t(as.matrix(Y))
  study_has_zero <- any(y_mat == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  out <- list()
  out$nbzimm_nb <- NBZIMM::mms(
    y      = y_mat,
    fixed  = fixed_formula,
    random = random_formula,
    data   = meta,
    method = "nb",
    min.p  = min.p,
    ...
  )
  out$nbzimm_zinb <- if (study_has_zero) {
    NBZIMM::mms(
      y      = y_mat,
      fixed  = fixed_formula,
      random = random_formula,
      data   = meta,
      method = "zinb",
      min.p  = min.p,
      ...
    )
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
  out$info <- list(
    n_taxa = ncol(y_mat),
    n_samples = nrow(y_mat),
    study_has_zero = study_has_zero
  )
  out
}

run_lmerseq <- function(Y,
                        meta,
                        design,
                        coef_name = NULL,
                        mean_thresh = 5,
                        ...) {
  if (!is_mixed_design(design)) {
    return("SKIP: lmerSeq only for mixed-effects designs")
  }
  message("running lmerseq")
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(Y),
    colData   = meta,
    design    = ~1
  )

  dds <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(dds, type = "poscounts")

  keep <- rowMeans(DESeq2::counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)) > mean_thresh
  dds <- dds[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  vst_expr <- DESeq2::varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind = TRUE)
  expr_mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(vst_expr)

  fit <- lmerSeq::lmerSeq.fit(
    form        = design,
    expr_mat    = expr_mat,
    sample_data = meta,
    REML        = TRUE,
    ...
  )

  if (is.null(coef_name)) {
    return(fit)
  }

  summ <- lmerSeq::lmerSeq.summary(
    lmerSeq_results = fit,
    coefficient     = coef_name,
    p_adj_method    = "BH",
    ddf             = "Satterthwaite",
    sort_results    = FALSE
  )

  summ$summary_table
}

run_corncob <- function(Y,
                        meta,
                        design,
                        test = "Wald",
                        fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
                        use_phi = TRUE,
                        ...) {
  message("running corncob")
  parts <- split_design(design)
  fixed_formula <- parts$fixed_formula

  otu <- phyloseq::otu_table(as.matrix(Y), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
  sam <- phyloseq::sample_data(meta)
  ps <- phyloseq::phyloseq(otu, sam)

  phi_form <- if (use_phi) fixed_formula else ~1
  phi_form_null <- if (use_phi) phi_form else ~1
  corncob::differentialTest(
    formula           = fixed_formula,
    phi.formula       = phi_form,
    formula_null      = ~1,
    phi.formula_null  = phi_form_null,
    test              = test,
    boot              = FALSE,
    data              = ps,
    fdr_cutoff        = fdr_cutoff,
    ...
  )
}

nonzero_withingroup_repeats <- function(Y, meta, group) {
  stopifnot(all(colnames(Y) == rownames(meta)))
  if (!group %in% names(meta)) stop("group not in metadata: ", group)
  g <- factor(trimws(as.character(meta[[group]])))
  g[g %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")] <- NA
  keep_g <- !is.na(g)
  g <- droplevels(g[keep_g])
  Yg <- Y[, keep_g, drop = FALSE]
  n_taxa <- nrow(Yg)
  groups_with_2plus_nonzero <- integer(n_taxa)
  nonzero_samples <- integer(n_taxa)
  nonzero_groups <- integer(n_taxa)

  for (i in seq_len(n_taxa)) {
    nz <- (Yg[i, ] > 0)

    nonzero_samples[i] <- sum(nz)
    if (nonzero_samples[i] == 0L) {
      nonzero_groups[i] <- 0L
      groups_with_2plus_nonzero[i] <- 0L
      next
    }
    gi <- droplevels(g[nz])
    nonzero_groups[i] <- nlevels(gi)
    per_group <- tapply(nz, g, sum)
    groups_with_2plus_nonzero[i] <- sum(per_group >= 2L)
  }

  list(
    group = group,
    n_samples = ncol(Yg),
    n_groups = nlevels(g),
    n_taxa = n_taxa,
    frac_taxa_all_zero = mean(nonzero_samples == 0L),
    frac_taxa_no_withingroup_nonzero_repeat = mean(groups_with_2plus_nonzero == 0L),
    frac_taxa_unique_group_per_nonzero = mean(nonzero_groups >= nonzero_samples & nonzero_samples > 0L),
    nonzero_samples_summary = summary(nonzero_samples),
    nonzero_groups_summary = summary(nonzero_groups),
    groups_with_2plus_nonzero_summary = summary(groups_with_2plus_nonzero)
  )
}


run_all_methods_for_study <- function(out,
                                      nm_study,
                                      mc.samples = 2000L,
                                      maaslin_root = "maaslin2_out",
                                      strict_preflight = FALSE) {
  prep <- tryCatch(
    prepare_study(out[[nm_study]], on_bad_random = "drop"),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(prep, "error")) {
    out[[nm_study]]$preflight <- list(ok_any = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(prep))
    message("SKIP study ", nm_study, " (prepare_study failed)")
    return(out)
  }
  pf <- preflight_from_prep(prep)
  out[[nm_study]]$preflight <- pf
  if (isTRUE(strict_preflight) && !isTRUE(pf$ok_all)) {
    message("SKIP study ", nm_study, " (strict_preflight=TRUE and not all methods pass)")
    return(out)
  }

  if (!isTRUE(pf$ok_any)) {
    message("SKIP study ", nm_study, " (no methods pass preflight)")
    return(out)
  }
  out[[nm_study]]$count_summary <- prep$count_summary
  cat(nm_study, "PRE sparsity(min/med/mean/max)=",
    prep$count_summary$pre$sparsity_min, "/",
    prep$count_summary$pre$sparsity_median, "/",
    prep$count_summary$pre$sparsity_mean, "/",
    prep$count_summary$pre$sparsity_max, "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat(nm_study, "POST sparsity(min/med/mean/max)=",
    prep$count_summary$post$sparsity_min, "/",
    prep$count_summary$post$sparsity_median, "/",
    prep$count_summary$post$sparsity_mean, "/",
    prep$count_summary$post$sparsity_max,
    " dropped_sparse=", prep$count_summary$dropped_sparse,
    " (>", prep$count_summary$max_sparsity, ")\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  Y <- prep$counts
  meta <- prep$metadata
  if ("Status" %in% names(meta) && !"status" %in% names(meta)) meta$status <- meta$Status
  if ("status" %in% names(meta) && !"Status" %in% names(meta)) meta$Status <- meta$status
  col_status <- if ("Status" %in% names(meta)) "Status" else if ("status" %in% names(meta)) "status" else NA_character_
  if (!is.na(col_status)) {
    x <- as.character(meta[[col_status]])
    x[!is.na(x) & tolower(x) == "control"] <- "Control"
    meta[[col_status]] <- factor(x)
    if ("Control" %in% levels(meta[[col_status]])) {
      meta[[col_status]] <- relevel(meta[[col_status]], ref = "Control")
    } else if ("control" %in% levels(meta[[col_status]])) {
      meta[[col_status]] <- relevel(meta[[col_status]], ref = "control")
    } else {
      stop(
        "Status column has no 'Control'/'control' level. Levels are: ",
        paste(levels(meta[[col_status]]), collapse = ", ")
      )
    }

    if ("Status" %in% names(meta)) meta$Status <- meta[[col_status]]
    if ("status" %in% names(meta)) meta$status <- meta[[col_status]]
  }
  design <- prep$design
  stopifnot(all(colnames(Y) == rownames(meta)))
  parts <- split_design(design)
  if (length(parts$rand_groups) > 0L) {
    diag_list <- setNames(vector("list", length(parts$rand_groups)), parts$rand_groups)
    for (g in parts$rand_groups) {
      diag_list[[g]] <- nonzero_withingroup_repeats(Y, meta, g)
    }
    out[[nm_study]]$count_summary$nonzero_withingroup_repeats <- diag_list
  }

  safe_run <- function(label, f) {
    tryCatch(
      {
        res <- f()
        cat("OK:", label, "\n")
        res
      },
      error = function(e) {
        cat("FAIL:", label, "-", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
        e
      }
    )
  }

  out[[nm_study]]$counts <- Y
  out[[nm_study]]$metadata <- meta
  out[[nm_study]]$design <- design

  can <- pf$by_method
  out[[nm_study]]$results <- list(
    aldex3_mem_0 = if (isTRUE(can$aldex3_mem_0)) safe_run("aldex3_mem_0", function() run_aldex3_mem(Y, meta, design, mc.samples = mc.samples, scale_fun = make_tss_scale(0))) else "SKIP: preflight",
    aldex3_mem_0p1 = if (isTRUE(can$aldex3_mem_0p5)) safe_run("aldex3_mem_0p1", function() run_aldex3_mem(Y, meta, design, mc.samples = mc.samples, scale_fun = make_tss_scale(0.1))) else "SKIP: preflight",
    aldex3_mem_0p3 = if (isTRUE(can$aldex3_mem_0p3)) safe_run("aldex3_mem_0p3", function() run_aldex3_mem(Y, meta, design, mc.samples = mc.samples, scale_fun = make_tss_scale(0.3))) else "SKIP: preflight",
    aldex3_mem_0p5 = if (isTRUE(can$aldex3_mem_0p5)) safe_run("aldex3_mem_0p5", function() run_aldex3_mem(Y, meta, design, mc.samples = mc.samples, scale_fun = make_tss_scale(0.5))) else "SKIP: preflight",
    aldex3_mem_1 = if (isTRUE(can$aldex3_mem_1)) safe_run("aldex3_mem_1", function() run_aldex3_mem(Y, meta, design, mc.samples = mc.samples, scale_fun = make_tss_scale(1))) else "SKIP: preflight",
    edger = if (isTRUE(can$deseq2)) safe_run("edger", function() run_edger(Y, meta, design)) else "SKIP: preflight",
    deseq2 = if (isTRUE(can$deseq2)) safe_run("deseq2", function() run_deseq2(Y, meta, design)) else "SKIP: preflight",
    voom_limma = if (isTRUE(can$voom_limma)) safe_run("voom_limma", function() run_voom_limma(Y, meta, design)) else "SKIP: preflight",
    metagenomeSeq = if (isTRUE(can$metagenomeSeq)) safe_run("metagenomeSeq", function() run_metagenomeseq(Y, meta, design)) else "SKIP: preflight",
    linda = if (isTRUE(can$linda)) safe_run("linda", function() run_linda(Y, meta, design)) else "SKIP: preflight",
    ancombc2 = if (isTRUE(can$ancombc2)) safe_run("ancombc2", function() run_ancombc2(Y, meta, design)) else "SKIP: preflight",
    maaslin2 = if (isTRUE(can$maaslin2)) safe_run("maaslin2", function() run_maaslin2(Y, meta, design, output_dir = file.path(maaslin_root, nm_study))) else "SKIP: preflight",
    nbzimm = if (isTRUE(can$nbzimm)) safe_run("nbzimm", function() run_nbzimm(Y, meta, design, lib_size_col = NULL)) else "SKIP: preflight",
    lmerSeq = if (isTRUE(can$lmerSeq)) safe_run("lmerSeq", function() run_lmerseq(Y, meta, design, coef_name = NULL)) else "SKIP: preflight",
    corncob = if (isTRUE(can$corncob)) safe_run("corncob", function() run_corncob(Y, meta, design)) else "SKIP: preflight"
  )
  out
}

preflight_all_studies <- function(out) {
  summary <- data.frame(
    study = character(0),
    ok_any = logical(0),
    ok_all = logical(0),
    n_samples = integer(0),
    n_taxa = integer(0),
    singular_fixed_X = logical(0),
    random_ok = logical(0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (nm in names(out)) {
    prep <- tryCatch(
      prepare_study(out[[nm]], on_bad_random = "warn"),
      error = function(e) e
    )

    if (inherits(prep, "error")) {
      out[[nm]]$preflight <- list(ok_any = FALSE, ok_all = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(prep))
      summary <- rbind(summary, data.frame(
        study = nm, ok_any = FALSE, ok_all = FALSE,
        n_samples = NA_integer_, n_taxa = NA_integer_,
        singular_fixed_X = NA, random_ok = NA,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
      next
    }

    pf <- preflight_from_prep(prep)
    out[[nm]]$preflight <- pf
    dm <- pf$checks$design_matrix
    rd <- pf$checks$random
    summary <- rbind(summary, data.frame(
      study = nm,
      ok_any = isTRUE(pf$ok_any),
      ok_all = isTRUE(pf$ok_all),
      n_samples = ncol(prep$counts),
      n_taxa = nrow(prep$counts),
      singular_fixed_X = isTRUE(dm$singular),
      random_ok = isTRUE(rd$ok),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  list(out = out, summary = summary)
}

is_failed_result <- function(x) {
  inherits(x, "error")
}

postcheck_rerun_failed_for_study <- function(out,
                                             nm_study,
                                             mc.samples = 2000L,
                                             maaslin_root = "maaslin2_out") {
  if (is.null(out[[nm_study]]$results) || !is.list(out[[nm_study]]$results)) {
    out[[nm_study]]$results <- list()
  }

  prep <- tryCatch(prepare_study(out[[nm_study]]), error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(prep, "error")) {
    cat("POSTCHECK FAIL:", nm_study, "- prepare_study -", conditionMessage(prep), "\n")
    out[[nm_study]]$postcheck_prepare_error <- prep
    return(out)
  }

  out[[nm_study]]$count_summary <- prep$count_summary

  Y <- prep$counts
  meta <- prep$metadata
  design <- prep$design

  safe_run <- function(label, f) {
    tryCatch(
      {
        res <- f()
        cat("POSTCHECK OK:", label, "\n")
        res
      },
      error = function(e) {
        cat("POSTCHECK FAIL:", label, "-", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
        e
      }
    )
  }

  method_calls <- list(
    aldex3_mem_0 = function() run_aldex3_mem(Y, meta, design, mc.samples = mc.samples, scale_fun = make_tss_scale(0)),
    aldex3_mem_0p1 = function() run_aldex3_mem(Y, meta, design, mc.samples = mc.samples, scale_fun = make_tss_scale(0.1)),
    aldex3_mem_0p3 = function() run_aldex3_mem(Y, meta, design, mc.samples = mc.samples, scale_fun = make_tss_scale(0.3)),
    aldex3_mem_0p5 = function() run_aldex3_mem(Y, meta, design, mc.samples = mc.samples, scale_fun = make_tss_scale(0.5)),
    aldex3_mem_1 = function() run_aldex3_mem(Y, meta, design, mc.samples = mc.samples, scale_fun = make_tss_scale(1)),
    edger = function() run_edger(Y, meta, design),
    deseq2 = function() run_deseq2(Y, meta, design),
    voom_limma = function() run_voom_limma(Y, meta, design),
    metagenomeSeq = function() run_metagenomeseq(Y, meta, design),
    linda = function() run_linda(Y, meta, design),
    ancombc2 = function() {
      cat("DEBUG design:\n")
      print(design)
      cat("DEBUG vars:\n")
      print(all.vars(design))
      cat("DEBUG meta has vars:\n")
      print(all.vars(design) %in% colnames(meta))
      run_ancombc2(Y, meta, design)
    },
    maaslin2 = function() run_maaslin2(Y, meta, design, output_dir = file.path(maaslin_root, nm_study)),
    nbzimm = function() run_nbzimm(Y, meta, design, lib_size_col = NULL),
    lmerSeq = function() run_lmerseq(Y, meta, design, coef_name = NULL),
    corncob = function() run_corncob(Y, meta, design)
  )

  allow_null <- c("nbzimm", "lmerSeq")
  failed <- character(0)
  for (m in names(method_calls)) {
    cur <- out[[nm_study]]$results[[m]]
    if (is.null(cur)) {
      if (!m %in% allow_null) failed <- c(failed, m)
    } else if (is_failed_result(cur)) {
      failed <- c(failed, m)
    }
  }

  if (!length(failed)) {
    cat("POSTCHECK:", nm_study, "- nothing to rerun\n")
    out[[nm_study]]$postcheck_failed_methods <- character(0)
    return(out)
  }

  cat("POSTCHECK:", nm_study, "- rerunning:", paste(failed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  out[[nm_study]]$postcheck_failed_methods <- failed

  for (m in failed) {
    out[[nm_study]]$results[[m]] <- safe_run(m, method_calls[[m]])
  }

  out
}

postcheck_rerun_failed_all <- function(out,
                                       mc.samples = 2000L,
                                       maaslin_root = "maaslin2_out") {
  for (nm in names(out)) {
    out <- postcheck_rerun_failed_for_study(
      out = out,
      nm_study = nm,
      mc.samples = mc.samples,
      maaslin_root = maaslin_root
    )
  }
  out
}

remove_lmerSeq_if_not_mixed <- function(out, verbose = TRUE) {
  for (st in names(out)) {
    if (is.null(out[[st]]$results) || !("lmerSeq" %in% names(out[[st]]$results))) next
    design <- NULL
    if (!is.null(out[[st]]$design) && inherits(out[[st]]$design, "formula")) {
      design <- out[[st]]$design
    } else if (!is.null(out[[st]]$results$aldex3_mem$formula) && inherits(out[[st]]$results$aldex3_mem$formula, "formula")) {
      design <- out[[st]]$results$aldex3_mem$formula
    } else if (!is.null(out[[st]]$preflight$design) && inherits(out[[st]]$preflight$design, "formula")) {
      design <- out[[st]]$preflight$design
    }
    if (is.null(design)) {
      if (isTRUE(verbose)) message("remove_lmerSeq_if_not_mixed: ", st, " - could not find design; leaving lmerSeq as-is")
      next
    }
    if (!is_mixed_design(design)) {
      out[[st]]$results$lmerSeq <- "SKIP: preflight"
      if (isTRUE(verbose)) message("Skipping lmerSeq for ", st, " (design is fixed-only: ", paste(deparse(design), collapse = " "), ")")
    }
  }
  out
}

safe_study_filename <- function(study, ext = ".RData") {
  stem <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_", study)
  paste0(stem, ext)
}

slim_study <- function(study_obj,
                       keep_counts = TRUE,
                       keep_metadata = TRUE) {
  if (!is.null(study_obj$counts)) study_obj$counts_dim <- dim(study_obj$counts)
  if (!keep_counts) study_obj$counts <- NULL
  if (!keep_metadata) study_obj$metadata <- NULL
  study_obj
}

process_study_to_rdata <- function(out,
                                   nm_study,
                                   out_dir = "study_RData",
                                   mc.samples = 2000L,
                                   maaslin_root = "maaslin2_out",
                                   strict_preflight = FALSE,
                                   slim = TRUE,
                                   keep_counts = FALSE) {
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  tmp <- list()
  tmp[[nm_study]] <- out[[nm_study]]
  tmp <- run_all_methods_for_study(
    out = tmp,
    nm_study = nm_study,
    mc.samples = mc.samples,
    maaslin_root = maaslin_root,
    strict_preflight = strict_preflight
  )
  study <- tmp[[nm_study]]
  attr(study, "study_name") <- nm_study
  if (isTRUE(slim)) {
    study <- slim_study(study, keep_counts = keep_counts, keep_metadata = TRUE)
  }
  fpath <- file.path(out_dir, safe_study_filename(nm_study))
  save(study, file = fpath, compress = "xz")
  out[[nm_study]] <- NULL
  rm(tmp, study)
  gc()
  invisible(out)
}


load_studies_from_rdata <- function(in_dir = "study_RData") {
  files <- list.files(in_dir, pattern = "\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) stop("No .RData files found in: ", in_dir)

  out2 <- list()
  for (f in files) {
    e <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
    load(f, envir = e)
    if (!exists("study", envir = e, inherits = FALSE)) {
      stop("File does not contain an object named 'study': ", f)
    }
    st <- e$study
    nm <- attr(st, "study_name")
    if (is.null(nm) || !nzchar(nm)) {
      nm <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
    }
    out2[[nm]] <- st
  }
  out2
}
```

```{r check metadata differences}
  if (is.null(m)) m <- list()

  region <- if ("SeqRegion" %in% names(m)) as.character(m$SeqRegion[1]) else if ("Variable_Region" %in% names(m)) as.character(m$Variable_Region[1]) else NA_character_
  region <- sub("^V([0-9])([0-9])$", "V\\1-V\\2", gsub("[\u2013\u2014\u2212]", "-", region))
  platform <- if ("SeqPlatform" %in% names(m)) as.character(m$SeqPlatform[1]) else NA_character_
  location <- if ("Subjects_Location" %in% names(m)) as.character(m$Subjects_Location[1]) else NA_character_

  bioproject <- if ("BioProject" %in% names(m)) as.character(m$BioProject[1]) else NA_character_ # ADDED

  data.frame(
    Study = n,
    BioProject = bioproject, # ADDED
    SeqRegion = region,
    SeqPlatform = platform,
    Location = location,
    Significant = ifelse(n %in% my_sig_studies, "**YES**", "No"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

technical_summary <- do.call(rbind, meta_list) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    study_info %>%
      dplyr::select(Study, Bioproject, SeqRegion, SeqPlatform) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        BioProject_fb = Bioproject,
        SeqRegion_fb = SeqRegion,
        SeqPlatform_fb = SeqPlatform
      ),
    by = "Study"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    BioProject = dplyr::coalesce(dplyr::na_if(trimws(BioProject), ""), BioProject_fb),
    SeqRegion = dplyr::coalesce(dplyr::na_if(trimws(SeqRegion), ""), SeqRegion_fb),
    SeqPlatform = dplyr::coalesce(dplyr::na_if(trimws(SeqPlatform), ""), SeqPlatform_fb),
    SeqRegion = sub("^V([0-9])([0-9])$", "V\\1-V\\2", gsub("[\u2013\u2014\u2212]", "-", SeqRegion))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-BioProject_fb, -SeqRegion_fb, -SeqPlatform_fb) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(Significant), Study)
```

```{r Outlier check}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(vegan)
})

mad_safe <- function(x) {
  m <- stats::mad(x, constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(m) || m == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  m
}

pick_col <- function(df, candidates, what = "column") {
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% colnames(df)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) {
    stop(paste0("Missing ", what, ". Need one of: ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  hit[[1]]
}

ordination_qc_one_study <- function(counts,
                                    metadata,
                                    id_col_candidates = c("ID", "sampleid"),
                                    group_col = "status",
                                    k = 5,
                                    z_cut = 3.5,
                                    drop_taxa_total_lt = 10,
                                    drop_taxa_prevalence_lt = 2) {
  if (is.data.frame(counts)) counts <- as.matrix(counts)
  if (!is.matrix(counts)) stop("counts must be a matrix or data.frame convertible to matrix.")
  if (any(!is.finite(counts))) stop("counts contains non-finite values (NA/Inf).")
  if (any(counts < 0)) stop("counts contains negative values.")
  if (is.null(colnames(counts))) colnames(counts) <- paste0("sample_", seq_len(ncol(counts)))
  if (is.null(rownames(counts))) rownames(counts) <- paste0("taxon_", seq_len(nrow(counts)))

  if (!is.data.frame(metadata)) stop("metadata must be a data.frame.")

  id_col <- pick_col(metadata, id_col_candidates, what = "ID column (sample id)")
  if (!(group_col %in% colnames(metadata))) stop(paste0("metadata missing group_col: ", group_col))

  # ---- align metadata to counts by sample id ----
  samp_ids <- colnames(counts)
  m_idx <- match(samp_ids, metadata[[id_col]])

  keep_match <- is.finite(m_idx)
  if (!all(keep_match)) {
    counts <- counts[, keep_match, drop = FALSE]
    samp_ids <- colnames(counts)
    m_idx <- match(samp_ids, metadata[[id_col]])
  }

  meta2 <- metadata[m_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  group_vec <- as.character(meta2[[group_col]])

  keep_group <- !is.na(group_vec) & nzchar(group_vec)
  counts <- counts[, keep_group, drop = FALSE]
  meta2 <- meta2[keep_group, , drop = FALSE]
  group_vec <- as.character(meta2[[group_col]])
  samp_ids <- colnames(counts)

  if (ncol(counts) < 3) {
    return(data.frame(
      sample_id = samp_ids,
      group = group_vec,
      n_reads = as.numeric(colSums(counts)),
      n_taxa_after_filter = NA_integer_,
      k_used = NA_integer_,
      axis1 = NA_real_,
      axis2 = NA_real_,
      ord_score_within = NA_real_,
      ord_z_within = NA_real_,
      ord_flag_within = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  # ---- filter taxa ----
  taxa_total <- rowSums(counts)
  taxa_prev <- rowSums(counts > 0)
  keep_taxa <- (taxa_total >= drop_taxa_total_lt) & (taxa_prev >= drop_taxa_prevalence_lt)
  counts_f <- counts[keep_taxa, , drop = FALSE]

  # ---- drop samples with zero reads ----
  samp_total <- colSums(counts_f)
  keep_samp <- samp_total > 0
  counts_f <- counts_f[, keep_samp, drop = FALSE]
  meta2 <- meta2[keep_samp, , drop = FALSE]
  group_vec <- as.character(meta2[[group_col]])
  samp_total <- samp_total[keep_samp]
  samp_ids <- colnames(counts_f)

  n_samp <- ncol(counts_f)
  if (n_samp < 3) {
    return(data.frame(
      sample_id = samp_ids,
      group = group_vec,
      n_reads = as.numeric(samp_total),
      n_taxa_after_filter = nrow(counts_f),
      k_used = NA_integer_,
      axis1 = NA_real_,
      axis2 = NA_real_,
      ord_score_within = NA_real_,
      ord_z_within = NA_real_,
      ord_flag_within = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  # proportions
  P <- sweep(counts_f, 2, samp_total, "/")

  # Bray–Curtis between samples
  D <- vegan::vegdist(t(P), method = "bray")

  # PCoA
  k_used <- min(k, n_samp - 1L)
  ord <- stats::cmdscale(D, k = k_used, eig = TRUE)
  Y <- ord$points
  if (is.null(dim(Y))) Y <- matrix(Y, nrow = n_samp, ncol = k_used)
  rownames(Y) <- samp_ids

  # within-group distance to centroid
  ord_score_within <- rep(NA_real_, n_samp)
  names(ord_score_within) <- samp_ids

  for (g in unique(group_vec)) {
    idx <- which(group_vec == g)
    if (length(idx) < 3) next
    Yg <- Y[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    mu_g <- colMeans(Yg)
    d <- sqrt(rowSums((Yg - matrix(mu_g, nrow(Yg), ncol(Yg), byrow = TRUE))^2))
    ord_score_within[idx] <- d
  }

  # within-group robust z
  ord_z_within <- rep(NA_real_, n_samp)
  names(ord_z_within) <- samp_ids

  for (g in unique(group_vec)) {
    idx <- which(group_vec == g)
    x <- ord_score_within[idx]
    if (sum(is.finite(x)) < 3) next
    med <- stats::median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    m <- mad_safe(x)
    if (is.na(m)) next
    ord_z_within[idx] <- (x - med) / m
  }

  ord_flag_within <- ifelse(is.na(ord_z_within), FALSE, ord_z_within > z_cut)

  data.frame(
    sample_id = samp_ids,
    group = group_vec,
    n_reads = as.numeric(samp_total),
    n_taxa_after_filter = nrow(counts_f),
    k_used = k_used,
    axis1 = if (k_used >= 1) as.numeric(Y[, 1]) else NA_real_,
    axis2 = if (k_used >= 2) as.numeric(Y[, 2]) else NA_real_,
    ord_score_within = as.numeric(ord_score_within[samp_ids]),
    ord_z_within = as.numeric(ord_z_within[samp_ids]),
    ord_flag_within = as.logical(ord_flag_within[samp_ids]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

run_ordination_qc_all_studies <- function(out,
                                          id_col_candidates = c("ID", "sampleid"),
                                          group_col = "status",
                                          k = 5,
                                          z_cut = 3.5,
                                          drop_taxa_total_lt = 10,
                                          drop_taxa_prevalence_lt = 2) {
  study_names <- names(out)
  if (is.null(study_names)) study_names <- paste0("study_", seq_along(out))

  qc_list <- vector("list", length(out))
  names(qc_list) <- study_names

  for (nm in study_names) {
    if (is.null(out[[nm]]$counts)) stop(paste0("Missing $counts for study: ", nm))
    if (is.null(out[[nm]]$metadata)) stop(paste0("Missing $metadata for study: ", nm))

    qc_df <- ordination_qc_one_study(
      counts = out[[nm]]$counts,
      metadata = out[[nm]]$metadata,
      id_col_candidates = id_col_candidates,
      group_col = group_col,
      k = k,
      z_cut = z_cut,
      drop_taxa_total_lt = drop_taxa_total_lt,
      drop_taxa_prevalence_lt = drop_taxa_prevalence_lt
    )
    qc_df$study <- nm
    qc_list[[nm]] <- qc_df

    if (is.null(out[[nm]]$qc)) out[[nm]]$qc <- list()
    out[[nm]]$qc$ordination_within_status <- qc_df
  }

  qc_all <- do.call(rbind, qc_list)
  rownames(qc_all) <- NULL
  list(out = out, qc_all = qc_all)
}

# ---- RUN ----
res <- run_ordination_qc_all_studies(out,
  id_col_candidates = c("ID", "sampleid"),
  group_col = "status", k = 5, z_cut = 3.5
)
qc_all <- res$qc_all

# ---- QUICK SUMMARIES ----
qc_all %>%
  group_by(study, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_flagged = sum(ord_flag_within, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_flagged = n_flagged / n_samples,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(frac_flagged))

qc_all %>%
  filter(is.finite(ord_z_within)) %>%
  arrange(desc(ord_z_within)) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- PLOTS ----
qc_all %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  summarise(frac_flagged = mean(ord_flag_within, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(study, frac_flagged), y = frac_flagged)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Study", y = "Fraction flagged (within-status ordination outliers)") +
  theme_classic()

ggplot(qc_all, aes(x = study, y = ord_z_within)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(x = "Study", y = "ord_z_within (bigger = more unusual within status)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))


qc_all %>%
  filter(study == "Zou2020") %>%
  filter(ord_flag_within == "TRUE") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id)

qc_all %>%
  filter(study == "Dan2020") %>%
  filter(ord_flag_within == "TRUE") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id)

qc_all %>%
  filter(study == "Ding2020") %>%
  filter(ord_flag_within == "TRUE") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id)
```
