```{r Extract results}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(edgeR)
library(phyloseq)
library(metagenomeSeq)
library(lmerTest)
library(nlme)
library(limma)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

# ----------------------- Extraction functions
bh <- function(p) stats::p.adjust(p, method = "BH")

choose_status_term <- function(term_vec) {
  if (is.null(term_vec)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  term_vec <- term_vec[!grepl("Intercept", term_vec, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  hits <- grep("Status|Autism|Group|Case|ASD", term_vec, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) > 0) {
    return(hits[1])
  }
  if (length(term_vec) > 0) {
    return(tail(term_vec, 1))
  }
  return(NA_character_)
}

get_first <- function(x, candidates) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  for (nm in candidates) {
    if (!is.null(x[[nm]])) {
      return(x[[nm]])
    }
  }
  NULL
}


get_counts_matrix_from_out <- function(out_study) {
  if (is.null(out_study)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (!is.null(out_study$counts) && (is.matrix(out_study$counts) || is.data.frame(out_study$counts))) {
    return(as.matrix(out_study$counts))
  }

  if (!is.null(out_study$y) && !is.null(out_study$y$counts)) {
    return(as.matrix(out_study$y$counts))
  }

  if (!is.null(out_study$dds) && methods::is(out_study$dds, "DESeqDataSet")) {
    return(as.matrix(DESeq2::counts(out_study$dds)))
  }

  if (!is.null(out_study$ps) && methods::is(out_study$ps, "phyloseq")) {
    ot <- phyloseq::otu_table(out_study$ps)
    mat <- as.matrix(ot)
    if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(ot)) mat <- t(mat)
    return(mat)
  }

  NULL
}

extract_taxa_sparsity <- function(out_study, study) {
  Y <- get_counts_matrix_from_out(out_study)
  if (is.null(Y)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  Y <- as.matrix(Y)
  storage.mode(Y) <- "numeric"

  feat <- rownames(Y)
  if (is.null(feat)) feat <- paste0("feature_", seq_len(nrow(Y)))

  sp <- 100 * rowMeans(Y == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble::tibble(
    study = study,
    feature = as.character(feat),
    taxa_sparsity_pct = as.numeric(sp)
  )
}

extract_sample_sparsity <- function(out_study, study) {
  Y <- get_counts_matrix_from_out(out_study)
  if (is.null(Y)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  Y <- as.matrix(Y)
  storage.mode(Y) <- "numeric"

  # Per-sample sparsity: % of genera that are 0 in that sample
  sp_sample <- 100 * colMeans(Y == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble::tibble(
    study = study,
    sample_sparsity_median_pct = median(sp_sample, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

design_to_text <- function(design_obj) {
  if (is.null(design_obj)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  if (inherits(design_obj, "formula")) {
    return(paste(deparse(design_obj), collapse = " "))
  }
  if (is.character(design_obj)) {
    return(paste(design_obj, collapse = " "))
  }
  paste(capture.output(print(design_obj)), collapse = " ")
}

extract_covariate_flags <- function(design_obj) {
  txt <- design_to_text(design_obj)
  out <- tibble(
    design_text = txt,
    Age = FALSE,
    Sex = FALSE,
    Sibling_Match = FALSE,
    GI = FALSE,
    Med = FALSE,
    Other = FALSE,
    other_covariates = "",
    n_covariates_total = NA_integer_,
    has_random_effect = FALSE
  )
  if (is.na(txt)) {
    return(out)
  }
  vars <- character(0)
  if (inherits(design_obj, "formula")) {
    vars <- all.vars(design_obj)
  } else {
    vars <- unique(stringr::str_extract_all(
      txt, "\\b[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_\\.]*\\b"
    )[[1]])
  }
  vars <- vars[!is.na(vars) & vars != ""]
  vars_norm <- tolower(gsub("\\.", "_", vars))
  txt_norm <- tolower(gsub("\\.", "_", txt))
  has_any <- function(cands) {
    cands_norm <- tolower(gsub("\\.", "_", cands))
    any(cands_norm %in% vars_norm) ||
      any(stringr::str_detect(txt_norm, paste0("\\b(", paste(cands_norm, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")))
  }

  out$Age <- has_any(c("age", "host_age"))
  out$Sex <- has_any(c("sex", "host_sex", "gender"))
  out$Sibling_Match <- has_any(c("match_ids"))
  out$has_random_effect <- grepl("\\|", txt)

  gi_terms_norm <- tolower(c("constipation", "calprotectin__ug_g_", "gs_index_total"))
  med_terms_norm <- tolower(c("current_medications", "nutritional_supplement", "pro_biotics________________average_consumption_frequences_per_week_"))
  canon <- function(v) {
    v <- tolower(gsub("\\.", "_", v))
    v <- dplyr::recode(
      v,
      "host_age" = "age",
      "host_sex" = "sex",
      "gender"   = "sex",
      .default   = v
    )
    v
  }
  vars_canon <- unique(vapply(vars, canon, character(1)))
  drop_terms <- unique(c("status", "age", "sex", "match_ids"))
  other_canon <- setdiff(vars_canon, drop_terms)
  out$n_covariates_total <- length(setdiff(vars_canon, "status"))
  out$GI <- any(other_canon %in% gi_terms_norm)
  out$Med <- any(other_canon %in% med_terms_norm)
  out$Other <- any(!other_canon %in% c(gi_terms_norm, med_terms_norm))
  drop_display_norm <- c("status", "age", "host_age", "sex", "host_sex", "gender", "match_ids")
  keep_idx <- !(tolower(gsub("\\.", "_", vars)) %in% drop_display_norm)
  other_display <- unique(vars[keep_idx])

  out$other_covariates <- if (length(other_display) == 0) "" else paste(sort(other_display), collapse = ", ")

  out
}

parse_sparsity_from_text <- function(txt) {
  m <- stringr::str_match(
    txt,
    "sparsity\\(min/med/mean/max\\)=\\s*([0-9\\.eE\\-]+)\\s*/\\s*([0-9\\.eE\\-]+)\\s*/\\s*([0-9\\.eE\\-]+)\\s*/\\s*([0-9\\.eE\\-]+)"
  )
  if (all(is.na(m))) {
    return(tibble(
      sparsity_min_pct = NA_real_,
      sparsity_median_pct = NA_real_,
      sparsity_mean_pct = NA_real_,
      sparsity_max_pct = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  vals <- as.numeric(m[1, 2:5])
  if (all(is.finite(vals)) && max(vals, na.rm = TRUE) <= 1.5) vals <- 100 * vals
  tibble(
    sparsity_min_pct = vals[1],
    sparsity_median_pct = vals[2],
    sparsity_mean_pct = vals[3],
    sparsity_max_pct = vals[4]
  )
}

parse_dropped_sparse_from_text <- function(txt) {
  m <- stringr::str_match(txt, "dropped_sparse\\s*=\\s*([0-9]+)")
  if (all(is.na(m))) {
    return(tibble(dropped_sparse = NA_integer_))
  }
  tibble(dropped_sparse = as.integer(m[1, 2]))
}

get_first <- function(lst, keys) {
  if (is.null(lst) || !is.list(lst)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  for (k in keys) {
    if (!is.null(lst[[k]]) && length(lst[[k]]) > 0 && !all(is.na(lst[[k]]))) {
      return(lst[[k]])
    }
  }
  NULL
}

extract_dataset_characteristics <- function(out_study) {
  # Define empty structure to return on failure
  empty_char <- tibble(
    n_samples = NA_integer_,
    n_taxa = NA_integer_,
    libsize_min = NA_real_,
    libsize_median = NA_real_,
    libsize_mean = NA_real_,
    libsize_max = NA_real_,
    sparsity_min_pct = NA_real_,
    sparsity_median_pct = NA_real_,
    sparsity_mean_pct = NA_real_,
    sparsity_max_pct = NA_real_,
    dropped_sparse = NA_integer_,
    prevalence_min = NA_real_,
    prevalence_median = NA_real_,
    prevalence_mean = NA_real_,
    prevalence_max = NA_real_,
    tax_total_min = NA_real_,
    tax_total_median = NA_real_,
    tax_total_mean = NA_real_,
    tax_total_max = NA_real_
  )

  if (is.null(out_study$count_summary) || !is.list(out_study$count_summary)) {
    return(empty_char)
  }
  if (is.null(out_study$count_summary$post) || !is.list(out_study$count_summary$post)) {
    return(empty_char)
  }
  post <- out_study$count_summary$post
  to_pct <- function(v) {
    if (is.null(v)) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
    if (!is.finite(v)) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    if (v <= 1.5) v <- 100 * v
    v
  }
  n_taxa <- get_first(post, c("n_taxa", "ntaxa", "n_features", "p", "P"))
  n_samples <- get_first(post, c("n_samples", "nsamples", "N", "n"))
  lib_min <- get_first(post, c("lib_min", "libsize_min", "library_size_min", "reads_min"))
  lib_median <- get_first(post, c("lib_median", "libsize_median", "library_size_median", "reads_median"))
  lib_mean <- get_first(post, c("lib_mean", "libsize_mean", "library_size_mean", "reads_mean"))
  lib_max <- get_first(post, c("lib_max", "libsize_max", "library_size_max", "reads_max"))
  sp_min <- get_first(post, c("sparsity_min", "sparsity_min_pct"))
  sp_med <- get_first(post, c("sparsity_median", "sparsity_median_pct"))
  sp_mean <- get_first(post, c("sparsity_mean", "sparsity_mean_pct", "sparsity"))
  sp_max <- get_first(post, c("sparsity_max", "sparsity_max_pct"))
  req <- list(
    n_taxa = n_taxa, n_samples = n_samples,
    lib_min = lib_min, lib_median = lib_median, lib_mean = lib_mean, lib_max = lib_max,
    sparsity_min = sp_min, sparsity_median = sp_med, sparsity_mean = sp_mean, sparsity_max = sp_max
  )
  missing_req <- names(req)[vapply(req, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (length(missing_req) > 0) {
    stop(
      "extract_dataset_characteristics(): missing required fields in out_study$count_summary$post: ",
      paste(missing_req, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  prev_min <- get_first(post, c("prevalence_min"))
  prev_med <- get_first(post, c("prevalence_median"))
  prev_mean <- get_first(post, c("prevalence_mean"))
  prev_max <- get_first(post, c("prevalence_max"))
  tax_total_min <- get_first(post, c("tax_total_min"))
  tax_total_med <- get_first(post, c("tax_total_median"))
  tax_total_mean <- get_first(post, c("tax_total_mean"))
  tax_total_max <- get_first(post, c("tax_total_max"))
  dropped_sparse <- get_first(post, c("dropped_sparse", "n_dropped_sparse", "dropped"))

  tibble(
    n_samples = as.integer(n_samples),
    n_taxa = as.integer(n_taxa),
    libsize_min = as.numeric(lib_min),
    libsize_median = as.numeric(lib_median),
    libsize_mean = as.numeric(lib_mean),
    libsize_max = as.numeric(lib_max),
    sparsity_min_pct = to_pct(sp_min),
    sparsity_median_pct = to_pct(sp_med),
    sparsity_mean_pct = to_pct(sp_mean),
    sparsity_max_pct = to_pct(sp_max),
    dropped_sparse = if (is.null(dropped_sparse)) NA_integer_ else as.integer(dropped_sparse),
    prevalence_min = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(prev_min)),
    prevalence_median = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(prev_med)),
    prevalence_mean = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(prev_mean)),
    prevalence_max = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(prev_max)),
    tax_total_min = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tax_total_min)),
    tax_total_median = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tax_total_med)),
    tax_total_mean = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tax_total_mean)),
    tax_total_max = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tax_total_max))
  )
}

extract_aldex3_mem <- function(obj, study, gamma) {
  if (is.character(obj)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  term_vec <- rownames(obj$p.val)
  term <- choose_status_term(term_vec)
  if (is.na(term)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # obj$estimate is usually [term, feature, draw]
  est_slice <- obj$estimate[term, , ]

  # Ensure est_slice is a matrix (features x draws)
  # If there's only 1 feature, R might drop it to a vector [draws]
  if (is.vector(est_slice)) {
    est_slice <- matrix(est_slice, nrow = 1)
    rownames(est_slice) <- colnames(obj$p.val)
  }

  est_vals <- rowMeans(est_slice)
  se_vals <- apply(est_slice, 1, sd)

  # --- New metrics requested ---
  # t-statistic (beta / SE)
  t_vals <- est_vals / se_vals

  # Sign stability: fraction of draws > 0 (or < 0).
  # We take the maximum proportion to represent "stability" (0.5 = unstable, 1.0 = stable)
  sign_stab <- apply(est_slice, 1, function(x) {
    p_pos <- mean(x > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    max(p_pos, 1 - p_pos)
  })
  # -----------------------------

  p_vals <- obj$p.val[term, ]
  q_vals <- obj$p.val.adj[term, ]

  data.frame(
    study = study,
    method = paste0("aldex3_mem_", gamma),
    feature = colnames(obj$p.val),
    term = term,
    estimate = as.numeric(est_vals),
    se = as.numeric(se_vals),
    t_stat = as.numeric(t_vals),
    sign_stability = as.numeric(sign_stab),
    p_value = as.numeric(p_vals),
    q_value = as.numeric(q_vals),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

extract_metagenomeseq <- function(fz, study) {
  if (is.character(fz)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  fit <- if ("eb" %in% slotNames(fz)) fz@eb else fz@fit
  coefs <- colnames(fit$coefficients)
  term <- choose_status_term(coefs)
  if (is.na(term)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  tt <- limma::topTable(fit, coef = term, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  se_calc <- tt$logFC / tt$t
  data.frame(
    study = study,
    method = "metagenomeSeq",
    feature = rownames(tt),
    term = term,
    estimate = tt$logFC,
    se = se_calc,
    p_value = tt$P.Value,
    q_value = tt$adj.P.Val,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

extract_deseq2 <- function(dds, study) {
  if (is.character(dds)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (is(dds, "DESeqDataSet")) {
    rn <- resultsNames(dds)
    term <- choose_status_term(rn)
    if (is.na(term)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    res <- results(dds, name = term)
  } else {
    res <- dds
    term <- "Unknown"
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(res)
  data.frame(
    study = study,
    method = "deseq2",
    feature = rownames(df),
    term = term,
    estimate = df$log2FoldChange,
    se = df$lfcSE,
    p_value = df$pvalue,
    q_value = df$padj,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

extract_edgeR <- function(obj, study) {
  if (is.null(obj) || is.character(obj)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  extract_from_table <- function(tt, term = "Unknown") {
    if (is.null(tt)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    tt <- as.data.frame(tt)
    feat <- if ("feature" %in% names(tt)) tt$feature else rownames(tt)
    if (is.null(feat)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    est <- if ("estimate" %in% names(tt)) tt$estimate else if ("logFC" %in% names(tt)) tt$logFC else NULL
    if (is.null(est)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    pval <- if ("p_value" %in% names(tt)) tt$p_value else if ("PValue" %in% names(tt)) tt$PValue else if ("p.value" %in% names(tt)) tt[["p.value"]] else NULL
    qval <- if ("q_value" %in% names(tt)) tt$q_value else if ("FDR" %in% names(tt)) tt$FDR else if ("adj.P.Val" %in% names(tt)) tt$adj.P.Val else NULL
    se <- if ("se" %in% names(tt)) tt$se else NA_real_
    data.frame(
      study = study,
      method = "edgeR",
      feature = as.character(feat),
      term = term,
      estimate = as.numeric(est),
      se = as.numeric(se),
      p_value = if (is.null(pval)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(pval),
      q_value = if (is.null(qval)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(qval),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  if (is.data.frame(obj) && all(c("feature", "estimate", "p_value", "q_value") %in% names(obj))) {
    term <- if ("term" %in% names(obj)) {
      x <- unique(obj$term)
      if (length(x) >= 1) x[1] else "Unknown"
    } else {
      "Unknown"
    }
    return(extract_from_table(obj, term = term))
  }
  if (is.list(obj) && !is.null(obj$table) && is.data.frame(obj$table)) {
    term <- if (!is.null(attr(obj, "term"))) attr(obj, "term") else "Unknown"
    return(extract_from_table(obj$table, term = term))
  }
  if (is.list(obj)) {
    if (!is.null(obj$topTags) && is.list(obj$topTags) && !is.null(obj$topTags$table)) {
      term <- if (!is.null(obj$term)) obj$term else "Unknown"
      return(extract_from_table(obj$topTags$table, term = term))
    }
    if (!is.null(obj$tt) && is.data.frame(obj$tt)) {
      term <- if (!is.null(obj$term)) obj$term else "Unknown"
      return(extract_from_table(obj$tt, term = term))
    }
    if (!is.null(obj$table) && is.data.frame(obj$table)) {
      term <- if (!is.null(obj$term)) obj$term else "Unknown"
      return(extract_from_table(obj$table, term = term))
    }
  }
  if (is.data.frame(obj) && all(c("logFC", "PValue", "FDR") %in% names(obj))) {
    return(extract_from_table(obj, term = "Unknown"))
  }
  NULL
}


extract_voom_limma <- function(vl, study) {
  if (is.character(vl)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (is.null(vl$fit)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  coefs <- colnames(vl$fit$coefficients)
  term <- choose_status_term(coefs)
  if (is.na(term)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tt <- limma::topTable(vl$fit, coef = term, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  se_calc <- tt$logFC / tt$t

  data.frame(
    study = study,
    method = "voom_limma",
    feature = rownames(tt),
    term = term,
    estimate = tt$logFC,
    se = se_calc,
    p_value = tt$P.Value,
    q_value = tt$adj.P.Val,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

extract_linda <- function(obj, study) {
  if (is.character(obj)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  term <- choose_status_term(names(obj$output))
  if (is.na(term)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  df <- obj$output[[term]]
  se_val <- if ("lfcSE" %in% colnames(df)) df$lfcSE else (df$log2FoldChange / df$stat)
  data.frame(
    study = study,
    method = "linda",
    feature = rownames(df),
    term = term,
    estimate = df$log2FoldChange,
    se = se_val,
    p_value = df$pvalue,
    q_value = df$padj,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

extract_ancombc2 <- function(obj, study) {
  if (is.character(obj)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  df <- obj$res
  if (is.null(df)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  lfc_cols <- grep("lfc_", colnames(df), value = TRUE)
  se_cols <- grep("se_", colnames(df), value = TRUE)
  q_cols <- grep("q_", colnames(df), value = TRUE)
  term_candidates <- gsub("lfc_", "", lfc_cols)
  term <- choose_status_term(term_candidates)
  lfc_col <- paste0("lfc_", term)
  se_col <- paste0("se_", term)
  q_col <- paste0("q_", term)
  if (!lfc_col %in% colnames(df)) lfc_col <- grep(term, lfc_cols, value = TRUE)[1]
  if (!se_col %in% colnames(df)) se_col <- grep(term, se_cols, value = TRUE)[1]
  if (!q_col %in% colnames(df)) q_col <- grep(term, q_cols, value = TRUE)[1]
  data.frame(
    study = study,
    method = "ancombc2",
    feature = df$taxon,
    term = term,
    estimate = df[[lfc_col]],
    se = df[[se_col]],
    p_value = NA,
    q_value = df[[q_col]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

extract_maaslin2 <- function(obj, study) {
  if (is.character(obj)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  df <- obj$results
  if (is.null(df)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  term <- choose_status_term(unique(df$metadata))
  if (is.na(term)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  df_sub <- df[df$metadata == term, ]
  data.frame(
    study = study,
    method = "maaslin2",
    feature = df_sub$feature,
    term = term,
    estimate = df_sub$coef,
    se = df_sub$stderr,
    p_value = df_sub$pval,
    q_value = df_sub$qval,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

extract_corncob <- function(obj, study) {
  if (is.character(obj)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  model_list <- obj$all_models
  if (is.null(model_list) || length(model_list) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  COEF_ROW_INDEX <- 2
  estimates <- sapply(model_list, function(model_summ) {
    if (!is.list(model_summ)) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    if (is.null(model_summ$coefficients) || nrow(model_summ$coefficients) < COEF_ROW_INDEX) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    tryCatch(model_summ$coefficients[COEF_ROW_INDEX, "Estimate"], error = function(e) NA_real_)
  })
  ses <- sapply(model_list, function(model_summ) {
    if (!is.list(model_summ)) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    if (is.null(model_summ$coefficients) || nrow(model_summ$coefficients) < COEF_ROW_INDEX) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    tryCatch(model_summ$coefficients[COEF_ROW_INDEX, "Std. Error"], error = function(e) NA_real_)
  })
  estimates <- as.numeric(estimates)
  ses <- as.numeric(ses)
  if (all(is.na(estimates))) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  data.frame(
    study = study,
    method = "corncob",
    feature = names(obj$p_fdr),
    term = "status",
    estimate = estimates,
    se = ses,
    p_value = obj$p,
    q_value = obj$p_fdr,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

extract_lmerSeq <- function(obj, study) {
  if (is.null(obj) || is.character(obj) || length(obj) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  rows <- lapply(obj, function(one) {
    if (is.null(one$fit)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    tryCatch(
      {
        co <- summary(one$fit)$coefficients
        term <- choose_status_term(rownames(co))
        if (is.na(term)) {
          return(NULL)
        }
        pcol <- grep("Pr\\(", colnames(co), value = TRUE)
        data.frame(
          study = study,
          method = "lmerSeq",
          feature = one$gene,
          term = term,
          estimate = co[term, "Estimate"],
          se = co[term, "Std. Error"],
          p_value = co[term, pcol[1]],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      },
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  })

  df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  if (is.null(df)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  df$q_value <- bh(df$p_value)
  df
}

extract_nbzimm <- function(fit_obj, study, method_name = "nbzimm") {
  if (is.null(fit_obj) || is.character(fit_obj) || (length(fit_obj) == 1 && is.na(fit_obj))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  model_list <- fit_obj$fit
  if (is.null(model_list)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  rows <- lapply(names(model_list), function(taxon_name) {
    one_fit <- model_list[[taxon_name]]
    tryCatch(
      {
        summ <- summary(one_fit)
        t_tab <- summ$tTable
        term <- choose_status_term(rownames(t_tab))
        if (is.na(term)) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        data.frame(
          study = study,
          method = method_name,
          feature = taxon_name,
          term = term,
          estimate = t_tab[term, "Value"],
          se = t_tab[term, "Std.Error"],
          p_value = t_tab[term, "p-value"],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      },
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  })

  df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  if (is.null(df)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  df$q_value <- bh(df$p_value)
  df
}

  ds_chars <- extract_dataset_characteristics(out[[st]])
  covs <- extract_covariate_flags(out[[st]]$design)
  study_info_rows[[st]] <- tibble(study = st) %>%
    bind_cols(ds_chars) %>%
    bind_cols(covs)
}
```

```{r Visualize Amplicon results}
  ridge_geom(na.rm = TRUE) +
  highlight_layer(q_value) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Q-value", option = "C") +

leg_q <- cowplot::get_legend(p_ridge_q_leg + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

# Function to generate ridge plots for filtered data
run_filtered_plots <- function(cutoff, suffix) {
  # Filter to cutoff
  plot_data_sub <- bench_long %>%
    filter(method == target_method, q_value < cutoff)

  if (nrow(plot_data_sub) == 0) {
    message("No data for cutoff ", cutoff)
    return()
  }

  # Re-compute study levels for this subset
  study_levels_sub <- plot_data_sub %>%
    group_by(study) %>%
    summarise(min_q = min(q_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(min_q = ifelse(is.infinite(min_q), NA_real_, min_q)) %>%
    arrange(min_q, study) %>%
    pull(study)

  plot_data_sub <- plot_data_sub %>%
    mutate(study = factor(study, levels = study_levels_sub))

  # Specific scale for this subset
  y_scale_fixed_sub <- scale_y_discrete(
    limits = study_levels_sub,
    drop   = FALSE,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )

  # Plotting
  p_ridge_q_sub <- ggplot(plot_data_sub, aes(x = q_value, y = study, fill = after_stat(x))) +
    ridge_geom(na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Q-value", option = "C") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0), limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
    y_scale_fixed_sub +
    labs(title = "Q-values", subtitle = paste("Threshold <", cutoff), x = "Q-value (BH)", y = NULL) +
    common_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_text(vjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 0, 8, 5)
    )

  p_ridge_est_sub <- ggplot(plot_data_sub, aes(x = estimate, y = study, fill = after_stat(x))) +
    ridge_geom(na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      name = "Effect Size",
      low = "#D55E00", mid = "white", high = "#0072B2",
      midpoint = 0
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
    y_scale_fixed_sub +
    labs(title = "Effect Sizes", subtitle = " ", x = "Effect Size", y = NULL) +
    common_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 0, 8, 0)
    )

  p_ridge_se_sub <- ggplot(plot_data_sub, aes(x = se, y = study, fill = after_stat(x))) +
    ridge_geom(na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "SE", option = "B", direction = -1) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    y_scale_fixed_sub +
    labs(title = "Standard Errors", subtitle = " ", x = "Standard Error", y = NULL) +
    common_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 0, 8, 0)
    )

  p_ridge_t_sub <- ggplot(plot_data_sub, aes(x = abs(t_stat), y = study, fill = after_stat(x))) +
    ridge_geom(na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "|t|", option = "magma", direction = -1) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    y_scale_fixed_sub +
    labs(title = "|t| Statistic", subtitle = " ", x = "|t|", y = NULL) +
    common_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 0, 8, 0)
    )

  p_ridge_stab_sub <- ggplot(plot_data_sub, aes(x = sign_stability, y = study, fill = after_stat(x))) +
    ridge_geom(na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Stab.", option = "plasma") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0), limits = c(0.5, 1.0)) +
    y_scale_fixed_sub +
    labs(title = "Sign Stability", subtitle = " ", x = "Stability (max prob)", y = NULL) +
    common_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 5, 8, 0)
    )

  p_ridge_q_leg_sub <- p_ridge_q_sub +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(fill = guide_colourbar(
      barwidth  = unit(6, "cm"),
      barheight = unit(0.7, "cm")
    ))

  get_leg <- function(p) cowplot::get_legend(p + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

  leg_q_sub <- get_leg(p_ridge_q_leg_sub)
  leg_e_sub <- get_leg(p_ridge_est_sub)
  leg_s_sub <- get_leg(p_ridge_se_sub)
  leg_t_sub <- get_leg(p_ridge_t_sub)
  leg_st_sub <- get_leg(p_ridge_stab_sub)

  aligned_sub <- cowplot::align_plots(p_ridge_q_sub, p_ridge_est_sub, p_ridge_se_sub, p_ridge_t_sub, p_ridge_stab_sub, align = "hv", axis = "tblr")

  p_panels_sub <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    plotlist = aligned_sub,
    nrow = 1,
    align = "h",
    axis = "tb",
    rel_widths = c(1.5, 1, 1, 1, 1)
  )
  p_legs_sub <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    leg_q_sub, leg_e_sub, leg_s_sub, leg_t_sub, leg_st_sub,
    nrow = 1,
    align = "h",
    axis = "tb",
    rel_widths = c(1.5, 1, 1, 1, 1)
  )
  p_combined_sub <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    p_panels_sub,
    p_legs_sub,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(1, 0.14)
  )

  print(p_combined_sub)
  ggsave(paste0("combined_ridge_plot_", suffix, ".pdf"), p_combined_sub, width = 20, height = 10)
  ggsave(paste0("combined_ridge_plot_", suffix, ".png"), p_combined_sub, width = 20, height = 10, dpi = 300)
}

# Run for 0.3
run_filtered_plots(0.4, "q0.4")

# Run for 0.1
run_filtered_plots(0.1, "q0.1")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})

alpha <- 0.1
method_keep <- "aldex3_mem_0p3"

# ---- prevalence settings ----
prevalence_mode <- "count" # "prop" (recommended) or "count"
detect_prop <- 1e-4 # detected if proportion > this (only used if mode="prop")
detect_count <- 2 # detected if count > this (only used if mode="count")

# If too many taxa labels, set e.g. 40; Inf labels all taxa.
max_row_labels <- Inf

# ---- text sizes ----
row_font <- 10
slice_font <- 12
legend_title_font <- 12
legend_label_font <- 10

# ---------- helpers ----------
pick_sample_col <- function(meta) {
  cand <- c("sampleid", "sample_id", "SampleID", "SampleId", "run", "Run", "SRA", "sra", "ID", "id")
  hit <- cand[cand %in% names(meta)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) NULL else hit[1]
}

pick_meta_df <- function(x) {
  if (!is.null(x$meta)) {
    return(as.data.frame(x$meta, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  if (!is.null(x$metadata)) {
    return(as.data.frame(x$metadata, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  NULL
}

norm_status <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[x %in% c("asd", "autism", "case", "cases")] <- "autism"
  x[x %in% c("control", "ctrl", "con", "healthy", "neurotypical")] <- "control"
  x
}

pick_q_col <- function(df) {
  cand <- c("q_value", "q_global", "q", "padj", "qval", "qval_global")
  hit <- cand[cand %in% names(df)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) NULL else hit[1]
}

# ---------- 0) sanity ----------
if (!exists("bench_long")) stop("bench_long not found.")
if (!exists("out")) stop("out not found.")

qcol <- pick_q_col(bench_long)
if (is.null(qcol)) stop("No q-value column found in bench_long.")
if (!all(c("study", "feature", "method") %in% names(bench_long))) stop("bench_long must have columns: study, feature, method")

bench_long[[qcol]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bench_long[[qcol]]))

# ---------- 1) studies that can be plotted ----------
studies_ok <- names(out)
studies_ok <- studies_ok[
  vapply(studies_ok, function(st) {
    !is.null(out[[st]]$counts) &&
      !is.null(pick_meta_df(out[[st]])) &&
      ("status" %in% names(pick_meta_df(out[[st]]))) &&
      !is.null(pick_sample_col(pick_meta_df(out[[st]])))
  }, logical(1))
]
if (length(studies_ok) == 0) stop("No studies in out have counts + meta/status + detectable sample id column.")

# ---------- 2) union significant taxa to plot (ALL q < alpha, plottable studies only) ----------
sub_all <- bench_long[
  bench_long$method == method_keep &
    bench_long$study %in% studies_ok &
    is.finite(bench_long[[qcol]]) &
    bench_long[[qcol]] < alpha,
  c("study", "feature", qcol),
  drop = FALSE
]
names(sub_all)[names(sub_all) == qcol] <- "q_value"
if (nrow(sub_all) == 0) stop("No taxa with q < ", alpha, " for method=", method_keep, " in plottable studies.")

sub_all$feature <- trimws(as.character(sub_all$feature))
sub_all <- sub_all[!is.na(sub_all$feature) & sub_all$feature != "", , drop = FALSE]

minq <- tapply(sub_all$q_value, sub_all$feature, min, na.rm = TRUE)
taxa_order <- names(sort(minq, decreasing = FALSE))

# ---------- 3) order studies shown ----------
sig_counts <- sort(table(sub_all$study), decreasing = TRUE)
study_show <- c(intersect(names(sig_counts), studies_ok), setdiff(studies_ok, names(sig_counts)))

# ---------- 4) compute prevalence matrix: taxa x (study,status) ----------
status_levels <- c("control", "autism")

calc_prev_two_groups <- function(Msub, status, mode, detect_count, detect_prop) {
  status <- factor(status, levels = status_levels)
  if (mode == "prop") {
    cs <- colSums(Msub)
    keep <- which(cs > 0)
    Msub <- Msub[, keep, drop = FALSE]
    status <- status[keep]
    cs <- cs[keep]
    P <- sweep(Msub, 2, cs, "/")
    P[is.na(P)] <- 0
    present <- P > detect_prop
  } else {
    present <- Msub > detect_count
  }

  outm <- matrix(NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(Msub), ncol = length(status_levels),
    dimnames = list(rownames(Msub), status_levels)
  )

  for (g in status_levels) {
    idx <- which(status == g)
    if (length(idx) == 0) next
    outm[, g] <- rowMeans(present[, idx, drop = FALSE])
  }
  outm
}

prev_list <- list()
col_study <- character(0)
col_status <- character(0)

for (st in study_show) {
  M <- as.matrix(out[[st]]$counts)
  storage.mode(M) <- "numeric"
  if (is.null(rownames(M)) || is.null(colnames(M))) next

  meta <- pick_meta_df(out[[st]])
  sc <- pick_sample_col(meta)
  if (is.null(sc)) next

  meta$status2 <- norm_status(meta$status)
  samp_ids <- as.character(meta[[sc]])
  keep_samps <- intersect(colnames(M), samp_ids)
  if (length(keep_samps) == 0) next

  meta2 <- meta[match(keep_samps, samp_ids), , drop = FALSE]
  status <- meta2$status2
  keep_idx <- which(status %in% status_levels)
  if (length(keep_idx) == 0) next

  keep_samps <- keep_samps[keep_idx]
  status <- status[keep_idx]

  missing <- setdiff(taxa_order, rownames(M))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    add <- matrix(0,
      nrow = length(missing), ncol = ncol(M),
      dimnames = list(missing, colnames(M))
    )
    M <- rbind(M, add)
  }

  Msub <- M[taxa_order, keep_samps, drop = FALSE]

  prev2 <- calc_prev_two_groups(
    Msub, status,
    mode = prevalence_mode,
    detect_count = detect_count,
    detect_prop = detect_prop
  )

  prev_list[[st]] <- prev2
  col_study <- c(col_study, rep(st, length(status_levels)))
  col_status <- c(col_status, status_levels)
}

if (length(prev_list) == 0) stop("No studies produced prevalence output (check sample id matching + status normalization).")

PrevMat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(prev_list, function(m) m[, status_levels, drop = FALSE]))

# ---------- 5) significant cells (study,taxon): q < alpha ----------
sig_by_study <- lapply(split(sub_all$feature, sub_all$study), unique)

sig_cell <- matrix(FALSE,
  nrow = nrow(PrevMat), ncol = ncol(PrevMat),
  dimnames = dimnames(PrevMat)
)

for (j in seq_len(ncol(PrevMat))) {
  st <- col_study[j]
  sig_taxa <- sig_by_study[[st]]
  if (!is.null(sig_taxa)) {
    sig_cell[, j] <- rownames(PrevMat) %in% sig_taxa
  }
}

# ---------- 6) gold rows: >=2 studies significant (q < alpha) ----------
n_studies_sig <- tapply(sub_all$study, sub_all$feature, function(z) length(unique(z)))
gold_taxa <- names(n_studies_sig)[n_studies_sig >= 2]
if (is.null(gold_taxa)) gold_taxa <- character(0)
row_gold <- rownames(PrevMat) %in% gold_taxa

# label columns as status within each study, but use study names as the slice titles
colnames(PrevMat) <- col_status

# row labels (optionally truncated)
rn <- rownames(PrevMat)
row_labels <- rn
if (is.finite(max_row_labels) && length(rn) > max_row_labels) {
  row_labels <- rep("", length(rn))
  row_labels[seq_len(max_row_labels)] <- rn[seq_len(max_row_labels)]
}

# ---------- 7) heatmap ----------
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "#ecedee", "#000000"))
col_fun_sig <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "#fcbba1", "#cb181d"))

status_cols <- c(control = "#0072B2", autism = "#D55E00")

split_study <- factor(col_study, levels = unique(col_study))

top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  status = factor(col_status, levels = status_levels),
  col = list(status = status_cols),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

gold_col <- "#FFD700"
gold_lwd <- 3

ht <- Heatmap(
  PrevMat,
  name = "Prevalence",
  col = col_fun,
  na_col = "white",

  # CRITICAL: draw overlays here (works reliably)
  layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    # (A) recolor significant cells in red scale
    idx_sig <- sig_cell[cbind(i, j)]
    if (any(idx_sig)) {
      v <- PrevMat[cbind(i, j)]
      grid::grid.rect(
        x[idx_sig], y[idx_sig], width[idx_sig], height[idx_sig],
        gp = grid::gpar(col = NA, fill = col_fun_sig(v[idx_sig]))
      )
    }

    # (B) gold outline for rows where >=2 studies significant
    idx_gold <- row_gold[i]
    if (!any(idx_gold)) {
      return()
    }

    # cell bounds
    xL <- x - width / 2
    xR <- x + width / 2
    yB <- y - height / 2
    yT <- y + height / 2

    # top & bottom edges for every cell in gold rows (horizontal line across row)
    grid::grid.segments(
      x0 = xL[idx_gold], x1 = xR[idx_gold],
      y0 = yT[idx_gold], y1 = yT[idx_gold],
      gp = grid::gpar(col = gold_col, lwd = gold_lwd, lineend = "butt")
    )
    grid::grid.segments(
      x0 = xL[idx_gold], x1 = xR[idx_gold],
      y0 = yB[idx_gold], y1 = yB[idx_gold],
      gp = grid::gpar(col = gold_col, lwd = gold_lwd, lineend = "butt")
    )

    # left edge only on the very first column of the entire heatmap
    idx_left <- idx_gold & (j == 1)
    if (any(idx_left)) {
      grid::grid.segments(
        x0 = xL[idx_left], x1 = xL[idx_left],
        y0 = yB[idx_left], y1 = yT[idx_left],
        gp = grid::gpar(col = gold_col, lwd = gold_lwd, lineend = "butt")
      )
    }

    # right edge only on the very last column of the entire heatmap
    idx_right <- idx_gold & (j == ncol(PrevMat))
    if (any(idx_right)) {
      grid::grid.segments(
        x0 = xR[idx_right], x1 = xR[idx_right],
        y0 = yB[idx_right], y1 = yT[idx_right],
        gp = grid::gpar(col = gold_col, lwd = gold_lwd, lineend = "butt")
      )
    }
  },
  top_annotation = top_ha,
  column_split = split_study,
  column_title = levels(split_study),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = slice_font, fontface = "bold"),
  column_title_rot = 45,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_names_rot = 90,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  row_dend_side = "left",
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_labels = row_labels,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = row_font),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Prevalence",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = legend_title_font, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = legend_label_font),
    at = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)
  ),

  # important for crisp vector outlines (and avoids some raster edge weirdness)
  use_raster = FALSE
)

# on-screen
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")

# PDF
pdf("prevalence_heatmap.pdf", width = 16, height = 10, useDingbats = FALSE)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()

# PNG
png("prevalence_heatmap.png", width = 4800, height = 3000, res = 300)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()



pick_sample_col <- function(meta) {
  cand <- c("sampleid", "sample_id", "SampleID", "SampleId", "run", "Run", "SRA", "sra", "ID", "id")
  hit <- cand[cand %in% names(meta)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) NULL else hit[1]
}

norm_status <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[x %in% c("asd", "autism", "case", "cases")] <- "autism"
  x[x %in% c("control", "ctrl", "con", "healthy", "neurotypical")] <- "control"
  x
}

# ---- rebuild studies_ok if you don't already have it ----
studies_ok <- names(out)
studies_ok <- studies_ok[
  vapply(studies_ok, function(st) {
    !is.null(out[[st]]$counts) &&
      !is.null(out[[st]]$meta) &&
      ("status" %in% names(out[[st]]$meta))
  }, logical(1))
]

# ---- build one combined taxa x samples matrix on the UNION taxa set ----
X_list <- list()
meta_list <- list()

for (st in studies_ok) {
  M <- as.matrix(out[[st]]$counts)
  storage.mode(M) <- "numeric"
  if (is.null(rownames(M)) || is.null(colnames(M))) next

  meta <- as.data.frame(out[[st]]$meta, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  sc <- pick_sample_col(meta)
  if (is.null(sc)) next

  meta$status2 <- norm_status(meta$status)

  samp_ids <- as.character(meta[[sc]])
  keep_samps <- intersect(colnames(M), samp_ids)
  if (length(keep_samps) == 0) next

  meta2 <- meta[match(keep_samps, samp_ids), , drop = FALSE]
  status <- meta2$status2
  keep_idx <- which(status %in% c("control", "autism"))
  if (length(keep_idx) == 0) next

  keep_samps <- keep_samps[keep_idx]
  status <- status[keep_idx]

  # enforce union taxa rows (missing -> 0)
  missing <- setdiff(taxa_order, rownames(M))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    add <- matrix(0,
      nrow = length(missing), ncol = ncol(M),
      dimnames = list(missing, colnames(M))
    )
    M <- rbind(M, add)
  }

  Msub <- M[taxa_order, keep_samps, drop = FALSE]

  # prefix sample names so different studies cannot collide
  colnames(Msub) <- paste0(st, "::", colnames(Msub))

  X_list[[st]] <- Msub

  meta_list[[st]] <- data.frame(
    sample = colnames(Msub),
    study = st,
    status = factor(status, levels = c("control", "autism")),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

X <- do.call(cbind, X_list)
meta_all <- do.call(rbind, meta_list)

# ---- TSS proportions ----
cs <- colSums(X)
keep <- which(cs > 0)
X <- X[, keep, drop = FALSE]
meta_all <- meta_all[match(colnames(X), meta_all$sample), , drop = FALSE]
cs <- cs[keep]

P <- sweep(X, 2, cs, "/") # taxa x samples proportions
P[is.na(P)] <- 0

# ---- Bray–Curtis distance between samples ----
D <- vegan::vegdist(t(P), method = "bray") # samples x taxa required => t(P)

# ---- PCoA (classical multidimensional scaling) ----
pc <- cmdscale(D, k = 2, eig = TRUE)

scores <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(pc$points),
  Axis1 = pc$points[, 1],
  Axis2 = pc$points[, 2],
  study = meta_all$study,
  status = meta_all$status,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Percent variance explained
ve <- 100 * pc$eig[1:2] / sum(pc$eig[pc$eig > 0])

# Highlight Zou2020 points: Control=Red, Autism=Blue, others=Grey
scores$fill_group <- "Other"
is_zou <- (scores$study == "Zou2020")
scores$fill_group[is_zou & scores$status == "control"] <- "Zou2020 (Control)"
scores$fill_group[is_zou & scores$status == "autism"] <- "Zou2020 (Autism)"

# Define manual colors
fill_colors <- c(
  "Zou2020 (Control)" = "red",
  "Zou2020 (Autism)"  = "blue",
  "Other"             = "grey85"
)

# Re-level so Zou2020 appears nicely in legend
scores$fill_group <- factor(scores$fill_group, levels = c("Zou2020 (Control)", "Zou2020 (Autism)", "Other"))

p_ordination <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2)) +
  # Ellipses: explicitly define which status is solid vs dotted (no guessing)
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(group = status, linetype = status),
    type = "norm", level = 0.68,
    linewidth = 0.9, color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # Points: use custom fill_group
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = fill_group, shape = status),
    size = 3.2, alpha = 0.9,
    color = "black", stroke = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, name = "Group") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(control = "solid", autism = "dotted")) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(control = 21, autism = 24),
    labels = c(control = "Control (solid ellipse)", autism = "Autism (dotted ellipse)"),
    name = "Status"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCoA on Bray–Curtis (TSS proportions)",
    x = sprintf("Axis 1 (%.1f%%)", ve[1]),
    y = sprintf("Axis 2 (%.1f%%)", ve[2])
  ) +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 4, alpha = 1)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey85"))
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.6, "lines"),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.9, "lines")
  )

p_ordination


all_methods <- c("aldex3_mem_0", "aldex3_mem_0p1", "aldex3_mem_0p3", "aldex3_mem_0p5", "aldex3_mem_1", "edgeR", "deseq2", "voom_limma", "metagenomeSeq", "linda", "ancombc2", "maaslin2", "corncob", "lmerSeq", "nbzimm_nb", "nbzimm_zinb")
all_studies <- names(out)

master_grid <- expand.grid(method = all_methods, study = all_studies, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

stats_raw <- bench_long %>%
  group_by(method, study) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tested = n(),
    n_sig = sum(sig, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_up = sum(sig & estimate > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_down = sum(sig & estimate < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stats_df <- master_grid %>%
  left_join(stats_raw, by = c("method", "study"))

# --- PRINT TABLES ---
table1_hits <- stats_df %>%
  dplyr::select(method, study, n_sig) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = n_sig)

table2_direction <- stats_df %>%
  mutate(direction_str = ifelse(is.na(n_sig), NA, paste(n_up, "/", n_down))) %>%
  dplyr::select(method, study, direction_str) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = direction_str)

table3_pct_tested <- stats_df %>%
  mutate(pct_sig = ifelse(is.na(n_tested), NA, round((n_sig / n_tested) * 100, 1))) %>%
  dplyr::select(method, study, pct_sig) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = pct_sig)

table4_pct_hits <- stats_df %>%
  mutate(
    hit_breakdown = case_when(
      is.na(n_sig) ~ NA_character_,
      n_sig == 0 ~ "-",
      TRUE ~ paste0(round((n_up / n_sig) * 100, 0), "% / ", round((n_down / n_sig) * 100, 0), "%")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(method, study, hit_breakdown) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = hit_breakdown)

print("Table 1: Total Significant Hits (NA = Not Run)")
print(table1_hits)
print("Table 2: Directional Breakdown (Up / Down)")
print(table2_direction)
print("Table 3: % of Tested Taxa that are Significant")
print(table3_pct_tested)
print("Table 4: Directional Balance (% Up / % Down of Hits)")
print(table4_pct_hits)

library(grid)

aldex3_methods <- c("aldex3_mem_0", "aldex3_mem_0p1", "aldex3_mem_0p3", "aldex3_mem_0p5", "aldex3_mem_1")

study_order <- bench_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sparsity_mean_pct = dplyr::if_else(
      all(is.na(sparsity_mean_pct)),

    ),

  drop = FALSE,
  expand = c(0, 0)
)

aldex3_methods <- c("aldex3_mem_0", "aldex3_mem_0p1", "aldex3_mem_0p3", "aldex3_mem_0p5", "aldex3_mem_1")

median_fixed <- stats_df %>%

method_order_raw <- c(aldex3_present, median_fixed, mixed_present)

first_non_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA)
  }
  x[1]
}

anno_study <- bench_long %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = first_non_na(n_samples),
    n_taxa = first_non_na(n_taxa),
    sparsity_mean_pct = first_non_na(sparsity_mean_pct),
    Age = as.logical(first_non_na(Age)),
    Sex = as.logical(first_non_na(Sex)),
    GI = as.logical(first_non_na(GI)),
    Med = as.logical(first_non_na(Med)),
    Sibling_Match = as.logical(first_non_na(Sibling_Match)),
    Other = as.logical(first_non_na(Other)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

anno_study <- tibble(study = study_order) %>%
  left_join(anno_study, by = "study") %>%
  mutate(study = factor(study, levels = study_order))

anno_num <- anno_study %>%
  transmute(
    study,
    `Samples (N)`  = n_samples,
    `Sparsity (%)` = sparsity_mean_pct,
    `Genus (D)`    = n_taxa
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-study, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(
    value_scaled = {
      v <- value
      if (all(is.na(v))) {
        0
      } else {
        rng <- range(v, na.rm = TRUE)
        if (!is.finite(rng[1]) || !is.finite(rng[2]) || rng[1] == rng[2]) 0 else (v - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
      }
    },
    label = case_when(
      is.na(value) ~ "NA",
      metric == "Sparsity (%)" ~ paste0(round(value, 0)),
      TRUE ~ format(as.integer(round(value, 0)), big.mark = ",")
    ),
    label_color = ifelse(value_scaled >= 0.60, "white", "black")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p_anno_num <- ggplot(anno_num, aes(x = study, y = metric, fill = value_scaled)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", lwd = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, color = label_color), size = 2.6, family = "sans") +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "grey90",
    high = "black",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    na.value = "grey85",
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  common_x +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, expand = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 0, l = 2, unit = "mm")
  )

anno_bin <- anno_study %>%

N_REPS <- 1000

  dplyr::filter(q_value < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study, method) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_sig = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%

  dplyr::summarise(avg_sig_per_study = mean(n_sig, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

run_random_sim <- function(method_name, avg_n_sig) {
  p_sig_feature <- avg_n_sig / N_FEATURES
  sim_mat <- matrix(
    rbinom(N_FEATURES * N_STUDIES, size = 1, prob = p_sig_feature),
    nrow = N_FEATURES,
    ncol = N_STUDIES
  )
  consistency_vector <- rowSums(sim_mat)
  sim_counts <- as.data.frame(table(consistency_vector)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(n_studies = consistency_vector, count = Freq) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(n_studies = as.numeric(as.character(n_studies))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_studies > 0)
  return(sim_counts)
}

random_consistency_list <- list()

for (m in unique(avg_sig_per_study_method$method)) {
  avg_n_sig <- avg_sig_per_study_method$avg_sig_per_study[avg_sig_per_study_method$method == m]

  if (is.na(avg_n_sig) || avg_n_sig <= 1) next

  sim_results <- map_dfr(1:N_REPS, ~ run_random_sim(m, avg_n_sig)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(n_studies) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(count = mean(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(method = m, type = "Random")

  random_consistency_list[[m]] <- sim_results
}

get_consensus_matrix <- function(data_subset, min_methods = 2) {
  if (nrow(data_subset) == 0) {
    mat <- as.data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = length(target_methods)))
    colnames(mat) <- target_methods
    return(mat)
  }

  mat <- data_subset %>%
    mutate(unique_id = paste(study, feature, sep = "__")) %>%
    select(unique_id, method_clean) %>%
    mutate(present = 1) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = method_clean, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  missing_cols <- base::setdiff(target_methods, colnames(mat))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    mat[missing_cols] <- 0
  }

  cols_to_sum <- base::intersect(colnames(mat), target_methods)
  mat$agreement <- rowSums(mat[, cols_to_sum])

  mat_consensus <- mat %>% filter(agreement >= min_methods)

  if (nrow(mat_consensus) == 0) {
    dummy <- as.data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = length(target_methods)))
    colnames(dummy) <- target_methods
    return(dummy)
  }

  return(mat_consensus)
}

mat_down <- get_consensus_matrix(down_data)

plot_sorted_upset <- function(mat, title, bar_color) {
  mat[target_methods] <- lapply(mat[target_methods], as.integer)
  set_sizes <- colSums(mat[, target_methods])
  sorted_methods <- names(sort(set_sizes, decreasing = TRUE))

  ComplexUpset::upset(
    mat,
    sorted_methods,
    name = "Intersection Size",
    mode = "distinct",
    sort_intersections_by = "cardinality",
    keep_empty_groups = TRUE,
    sort_sets = FALSE,
    n_intersections = 15,
    base_annotations = list(
      "Intersection Size" = intersection_size(
        counts = TRUE,
        text = list(vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, family = "sans"),
        mapping = aes(fill = "bars_color")
      ) +
        scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("bars_color" = bar_color), guide = "none") +
        theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") +
        labs(title = title, y = "Shared Taxa Count") +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y = element_line(size = 0.5)
        )
    ),
    matrix = (
      intersection_matrix(
        geom = geom_point(
          shape = 19,
          color = "black",
          aes(size = intersection_size)
        ),
        segment = geom_segment(size = 0.6, color = "grey60")
      ) +
        scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6), guide = "none") +
        scale_y_discrete(
          limits = sorted_methods,
          labels = function(x) {
            parse(text = ifelse(grepl("^ALDEx3", x), "bold(x)", paste0("'", x, "'")))
          }
        ) +
        theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") +
        theme(
          axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_blank()
        )
    ),
    set_sizes = (
      upset_set_size(geom = geom_bar(fill = "grey70", width = 0.6)) +
        theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
          axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
          axis.line.y = element_blank()
        ) +
        labs(y = "Consensus Hits")
    ),
    width_ratio = 0.2
  )
}

      method == "edger" ~ "edgeR",

get_study_matrix <- function(data_subset, min_agreement = 2) {
  if (nrow(data_subset) == 0) {
    mat <- as.data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = length(all_studies)))
    colnames(mat) <- all_studies
    return(mat)
  }
  mat <- data_subset %>%
    select(feature, study) %>%
    mutate(present = 1) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  missing_studies <- base::setdiff(all_studies, colnames(mat))
  if (length(missing_studies) > 0) mat[missing_studies] <- 0
  cols_to_sum <- base::intersect(colnames(mat), all_studies)
  mat$agreement <- rowSums(mat[, cols_to_sum])
  mat_consensus <- mat %>% filter(agreement >= min_agreement)
  if (nrow(mat_consensus) == 0) {
    dummy <- as.data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = length(all_studies)))
    colnames(dummy) <- all_studies
    return(dummy)
  }
  return(mat_consensus)
}

plot_method_consensus <- function(df_clean, method_name, direction_filter, title, bar_color) {
  subset_data <- df_clean %>%
    filter(method_clean == method_name) %>%
    filter(sig == TRUE) %>%
    filter(if (direction_filter == "UP") estimate > 0 else estimate < 0)
  mat <- get_study_matrix(subset_data)
  mat[all_studies] <- lapply(mat[all_studies], as.integer)
  sorted_studies <- rev(all_studies)
  ComplexUpset::upset(
    mat,
    sorted_studies,
    name = "Shared Taxa",
    mode = "distinct",
    sort_intersections_by = "cardinality",
    keep_empty_groups = TRUE,
    sort_sets = FALSE,
    n_intersections = 15,
    base_annotations = list(
      "Intersection Size" = intersection_size(
        counts = FALSE,
        mapping = aes(fill = "bars_color")
      ) +
        scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("bars_color" = bar_color), guide = "none") +
        theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "sans") +
        labs(title = title, y = NULL) +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 11),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y = element_line(size = 0.5)
        )
    ),
    matrix = (
      intersection_matrix(
        geom = geom_point(
          shape = 19,
          color = "black",
          aes(size = intersection_size)
        ),
        segment = geom_segment(size = 0.4, color = "grey70")
      ) +
        scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 4), guide = "none") +
        scale_y_discrete(limits = sorted_studies) +
        theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "sans") +
        theme(
          axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_blank()
        )
    ),
    set_sizes = (
      upset_set_size(geom = geom_bar(fill = "grey70", width = 0.6)) +
        theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "sans") +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_blank()
        )
    ),
    width_ratio = 0.3
  )
}

bench_clean <- clean_method_names(bench_long)

plots_up <- lapply(target_methods, function(m) {
  plot_method_consensus(bench_clean, m, "UP", title = m, bar_color = "#4575b4")
})

plots_down <- lapply(target_methods, function(m) {
  plot_method_consensus(bench_clean, m, "DOWN", title = m, bar_color = "#d73027")
})

combined_up <- wrap_plots(plots_up, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Consensus Across Studies: INCREASED (Positive)")

combined_down <- wrap_plots(plots_down, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Consensus Across Studies: DECREASED (Negative)")

ggsave("Consensus_Up_MultiRow.pdf", combined_up, width = 25, height = 25)
ggsave("Consensus_Down_MultiRow.pdf", combined_down, width = 25, height = 25)
```

```{r cross_study_replicability_amplicon, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(knitr)
})

if (!exists("bench_long")) bench_long <- readRDS("amplicon_bench_long.rds")

replic_alpha <- 0.1
method_label_replic <- c(
  aldex3_mem_0p3  = "ALDEx3 \u03b3=0.3",
  edgeR           = "edgeR",
  deseq2          = "DESeq2",
  voom_limma      = "Limma-Voom",
  metagenomeSeq   = "metagenomeSeq",
  linda           = "LinDA",
  ancombc2        = "ANCOM-BC2",
  maaslin2        = "MaAsLin2",
  corncob         = "Corncob"
  # lmerSeq         = "lmerSeq",
  # nbzimm_nb       = "NBZIMM (NB)",
  # nbzimm_zinb     = "NBZIMM (ZINB)"
)

replic_dat <- bench_long %>%
  filter(method %in% names(method_label_replic)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(q_value), is.finite(estimate)) %>%
  mutate(
    method_label = method_label_replic[method],
    sig_01 = q_value < replic_alpha,
    direction = case_when(
      estimate > 0 ~ 1L,
      estimate < 0 ~ -1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(direction))

sig_sets <- replic_dat %>%
  filter(sig_01) %>%
  select(method, method_label, study, feature, direction) %>%
  distinct()

replic_counts <- replic_dat %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, feature) %>%
  summarise(
    R_total = n_distinct(study),
    R_pos   = sum(sig_01 & direction == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
    R_neg   = sum(sig_01 & direction == -1L, na.rm = TRUE),
    R_non   = sum(!sig_01, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    R_dom = pmax(R_pos, R_neg),
    conflict = (R_pos > 0L & R_neg > 0L),
    R_strict = if_else(conflict, 0L, R_total)
  )

hits_per_study <- replic_dat %>%
  filter(sig_01) %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, study) %>%
  summarise(n_hits = n_distinct(feature), .groups = "drop")

per_method_summary <- hits_per_study %>%
  group_by(method, method_label) %>%
  summarise(
    median_hits_per_study = median(n_hits, na.rm = TRUE),
    studies_with_hits = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

replic_method <- replic_counts %>%
  group_by(method, method_label) %>%
  summarise(
    total_hits = n_distinct(feature),
    replicated_ge2 = sum(R_total >= 2),
    replicated_ge2_cs = sum(R_total >= 2 & consistent_sign_2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

any_sig_genera <- sig_sets %>%
  distinct(method, method_label, feature) %>%
  group_by(method, method_label) %>%
  summarise(n_any = n(), .groups = "drop")

replic_summary <- per_method_summary %>%
  full_join(replic_method, by = c("method", "method_label")) %>%
  full_join(any_sig_genera, by = c("method", "method_label")) %>%
  mutate(
    total_hits = coalesce(total_hits, 0L),
    replicated_ge2 = coalesce(replicated_ge2, 0L),
    replicated_ge2_cs = coalesce(replicated_ge2_cs, 0L),
    n_any = coalesce(n_any, 0L),
    replicability_rate = if_else(n_any > 0, replicated_ge2 / n_any, NA_real_),
    replicability_rate_cs = if_else(n_any > 0, replicated_ge2_cs / n_any, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(replicated_ge2_cs), desc(replicated_ge2), method_label)

replic_table <- replic_summary %>%
  transmute(
    Method = method_label,
    `Median hits/study` = round(median_hits_per_study, 1),
    `Studies with hits` = studies_with_hits,
    `Total hits` = total_hits,
    `Replicated` = replicated_ge2,
    `Replicated consist. sign` = replicated_ge2_cs,
    `Replic. rate` = paste0(round(100 * replicability_rate, 1), "%"),
    `Replic. rate consist.` = paste0(round(100 * replicability_rate_cs, 1), "%")
  )

kable(
  replic_table,
  align = "lrrrrrr",
  caption = paste0("Cross-study replicability (amplicon; q < ", replic_alpha, ").")
)

replic_summary <- replic_summary %>%
  mutate(
    is_aldex3 = grepl("ALDEx3", method_label),
    label_col = if_else(is_aldex3, "ALDEx3 \u03b3=0.3", "Other methods")
  )

pal_replic <- c("ALDEx3 \u03b3=0.3" = "#2166ac", "Other methods" = "#d6604d")

sign_metrics_by_feature <- replic_counts %>%
  filter(R_total >= 2) %>% # only define consistency when a feature appears in >=2 studies
  mutate(
    consistency = pmax(R_pos, R_neg) / R_total, # in [0.5, 1]
    strict = (R_pos == 0L | R_neg == 0L) # all signs identical
  )

sign_consistency_tbl <- sign_metrics_by_feature %>%
  group_by(method, method_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_features = n(),
    sign_consistency_mean = mean(consistency), # each genus counts equally
    sign_consistency_median = median(consistency),
    strict_rate = mean(strict),
    sign_consistency_weighted = weighted.mean(consistency, w = R_total), # optional
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(sign_consistency_mean))

sign_con_table <- sign_consistency_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    Method = method_label,
    `Replicated genera` = n_features,
    `Sign consistency (mean)` = round(sign_consistency_mean, 3),
    `Sign consistency (median)` = round(sign_consistency_median, 3),
    `Strict sign rate` = round(strict_rate, 3),
    `Sign consistency (weighted)` = round(sign_consistency_weighted, 3)
  )

kable(sign_con_table,
  align = "lrrrrr",
  caption = paste0(
    "Global sign consistency per method (amplicon; q < ", replic_alpha, ").\n",
    "Higher = among studies where a genus is significant, the estimated direction agrees more often."
  )
)

tested_sig_per_study <- replic_dat %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, study) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tested = n_distinct(feature),
    n_sig = n_distinct(feature[sig_01]),
    pct_sig = n_sig / n_tested,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
pct_sig_summary <- tested_sig_per_study %>%
  group_by(method, method_label) %>%
  summarise(
    median_pct_sig = median(pct_sig),
    mean_pct_sig = mean(pct_sig),
    min_pct_sig = min(pct_sig),
    max_pct_sig = max(pct_sig),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_pct_sig))

kable(
  pct_sig_summary %>%
    left_join(
      tested_sig_per_study %>%
        group_by(method, method_label) %>%
        summarise(
          `Studies (total)` = n_distinct(study),
          `Studies with ≥1 hit` = sum(n_sig > 0),
          .groups = "drop"
        ),
      by = c("method", "method_label")
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      Method = method_label,
      `Studies (total)` = `Studies (total)`,
      `Studies with ≥1 hit` = `Studies with ≥1 hit`,
      `Mean % significant` = scales::percent(mean_pct_sig, accuracy = 0.1),
      `Median % significant` = scales::percent(median_pct_sig, accuracy = 0.1),
      Range = paste0(
        scales::percent(min_pct_sig, accuracy = 0.1), "–",
        scales::percent(max_pct_sig, accuracy = 0.1)
      )
    ),
  caption = paste0(
    "Percent of tested genera called significant per study (q < ",
    replic_alpha, ")."
  )
)

p_pct_sig <- ggplot(
  tested_sig_per_study,
  aes(x = reorder(method_label, pct_sig, FUN = median), y = pct_sig, fill = grepl("ALDEx3", method_label))
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.7, linewidth = 0.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#2166ac", `FALSE` = "#d6604d"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Discovery inflation across methods",
    subtitle = paste0("Per study: percent of tested genera significant (q < ", replic_alpha, ")."),
    x = NULL, y = "% genera significant"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

print(p_pct_sig)

K_max <- min(19L, max(replic_counts$R_dom, na.rm = TRUE))

rep_depth <- replic_counts %>%
  tidyr::crossing(k = 1:K_max) %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, k) %>%
  summarise(n_genera = sum(R_dom >= k), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(is_aldex3 = grepl("ALDEx3", method_label))

label_df <- rep_depth %>%
  group_by(method_label) %>%
  filter(k == max(k)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(is_aldex3)

drop12 <- rep_depth %>%
  filter(k %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = k, values_from = n_genera, names_prefix = "k") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_drop_1to2 = if_else(k1 > 0, (k1 - k2) / k1, NA_real_),
    is_aldex3 = grepl("ALDEx3", method_label)
  )

aldex_txt <- drop12 %>%
  filter(is_aldex3) %>%
  summarise(txt = paste0("Bayesian PIM: ", scales::percent(pct_drop_1to2, accuracy = 0.1))) %>%
  pull(txt)

others <- drop12 %>%
  filter(!is_aldex3, is.finite(pct_drop_1to2))

others_txt <- paste0(
  "Others (median [range]): ",
  scales::percent(median(others$pct_drop_1to2), accuracy = 0.1),
  " [",
  scales::percent(min(others$pct_drop_1to2), accuracy = 0.1), ", ",
  scales::percent(max(others$pct_drop_1to2), accuracy = 0.1), "]"
)

ann_txt <- paste0("Drop in replication from k=1 to k=2\n", aldex_txt, "\n", others_txt)

x_ann <- K_max + 0.6
y_ann <- max(rep_depth$n_genera, na.rm = TRUE)

p_rep_depth <- ggplot(rep_depth, aes(x = k, y = n_genera, group = method_label)) +
  geom_line(
    data = dplyr::filter(rep_depth, !is_aldex3),
    color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(rep_depth, !is_aldex3),
    color = "grey75", size = 1.8
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = dplyr::filter(rep_depth, is_aldex3),
    color = "#2166ac", linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(rep_depth, is_aldex3),
    color = "#2166ac", size = 2.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = "Bayesian PIM"),
    hjust = 0.75, vjust = -3,
    size = 8, color = "#2166ac",
    fontface = "bold.italic"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = x_ann, y = y_ann,
    label = ann_txt,
    hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
    size = 5,
    color = "grey20"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:K_max,
    limits = c(1, K_max + 0.9),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(rep_depth$n_genera, na.rm = TRUE), by = 50) + 50L,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = "k (Number of studies)",
    y = "Genera significant in \u2265k studies"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18, color = "grey20"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1, color = "grey20"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1, color = "grey20"),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 80, 6, 6)
  )

print(p_rep_depth)

ggsave(
  filename = "replication_depth.pdf",
  plot = p_rep_depth,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 7.0,
  height = 5.0,
  units = "in"
)

# Optional: explicitly grab "unique to 1 study" per method

# ── Pairwise cross-cohort agreement ───────────────────────────────────────────
# For each method m and pair of cohorts (s1, s2), classify every genus g into:
#   S+_{m,s}  : sig (q < 0.1) and beta > 0  → "pos"
#   S-_{m,s}  : sig (q < 0.1) and beta < 0  → "neg"
#   N_{m,s}   : q >= 0.1                     → "nonsig"
#
# Agreement = |S+∩S+| + |S-∩S-| + |N∩N|  /  |T_{s1} ∩ T_{s2}|
# where T_{m,s} = S+_{m,s} ∪ S-_{m,s} ∪ N_{m,s} (all tested genera)
# Denominator is the INTERSECTION of tested genera (not the union).

# Step 1: classify every (method, study, feature) into one of three categories
study_feature_cat <- replic_dat %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      sig_01 & direction == 1L ~ "pos",
      sig_01 & direction == -1L ~ "neg",
      !sig_01 ~ "nonsig"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(method, method_label, study, feature, category) %>%
  distinct()

# Step 2: self-join to enumerate all (s1, s2, feature) triples where the
#         feature was tested in BOTH studies (inner join = intersection)
pair_feature_cat <- study_feature_cat %>%
  inner_join(
    study_feature_cat,
    by = c("method", "method_label", "feature"),
    suffix = c("1", "2"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    study1 = study1, cat1 = category1,
    study2 = study2, cat2 = category2
  ) %>%
  filter(study1 < study2)

# Step 3: for each study pair, count shared genera and agreements
pairwise_agree <- pair_feature_cat %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, study1, study2) %>%
  summarise(
    n_shared = n(), # |T_{s1} ∩ T_{s2}|
    n_agree = sum(cat1 == cat2), # |S+∩S+| + |S-∩S-| + |N∩N|
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    agreement = if_else(n_shared > 0L, n_agree / n_shared, NA_real_),
    is_aldex3 = grepl("ALDEx3", method_label)
  )

# Step 4: per-method summary
agree_method_summary <- pairwise_agree %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, is_aldex3) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs = n(),
    mean_agree = mean(agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_agree = sd(agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_agree = median(agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_agree))

kable(
  agree_method_summary %>%
    transmute(
      Method             = method_label,
      `Study pairs`      = n_pairs,
      `Mean agreement`   = round(mean_agree, 3),
      `SD agreement`     = round(sd_agree, 3),
      `Median agreement` = round(median_agree, 3)
    ),
  caption = paste0(
    "Pairwise cross-cohort agreement per method (amplicon; q < ", replic_alpha, ").\n",
    "Agreement = genera with identical 3-way call (pos/neg/non-sig) in both cohorts, ",
    "divided by genera tested in both cohorts."
  )
)

# Step 5: Boxplot ordered by mean agreement
p_agree <- ggplot(
  pairwise_agree %>%
    mutate(method_label = factor(
      method_label,
      levels = agree_method_summary %>% arrange(mean_agree) %>% pull(method_label)
    )),
  aes(x = method_label, y = agreement, fill = is_aldex3)
) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = is_aldex3),
    width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8, stroke = 0
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    staplewidth   = 0.3,
    linewidth     = 0.4,
    alpha         = 0.7,
    width         = 0.6
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 1.5,
    fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) ifelse(x == "ALDEx3 \u03b3=0.3", "Bayesian PIM", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#B0B0B0", "TRUE" = "#2166ac"), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#707070", "TRUE" = "#053061"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Pairwise Cross-Cohort Agreement (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.border       = element_blank(),
    axis.line          = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks         = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.text          = element_text(color = "black", size = 16),
    plot.margin        = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

print(p_agree)

ggsave(
  "Pairwise_Cohort_Agreement.pdf",
  plot = p_agree,
  width = 180, height = 120, units = "mm", device = cairo_pdf
)




K_max <- min(19L, max(replic_counts$R_total, na.rm = TRUE) + 1L)

replic_counts2 <- replic_counts %>%
  mutate(
    R_same = pmax(R_pos, R_neg),
    is_pim = grepl("ALDEx3|Bayesian PIM|PIM", method_label)
  )

rep_depth_cs <- replic_counts2 %>%
  tidyr::crossing(k = 1:K_max) %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, k) %>%
  summarise(n_genera = sum(R_same >= k), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(is_pim = grepl("ALDEx3|Bayesian PIM|PIM", method_label))

label_df <- rep_depth_cs %>%
  group_by(method_label) %>%
  filter(k == max(k)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(is_pim)

drop12 <- rep_depth_cs %>%
  filter(k %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = k, values_from = n_genera, names_prefix = "k") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_drop_1to2 = if_else(k1 > 0, (k1 - k2) / k1, NA_real_),
```
