```{r cross_study_replicability_amplicon, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
library(Matrix)

method_label_replic <- c(
  aldex3_mem_0p3  = "ALDEx3 \u03b3=0.3",
  edgeR           = "edgeR",
  deseq2          = "DESeq2",
  voom_limma      = "Limma-Voom",
  metagenomeSeq   = "metagenomeSeq",
  linda           = "LinDA",
  ancombc2        = "ANCOM-BC2",
  maaslin2        = "MaAsLin2",
  corncob         = "Corncob",
  lmerSeq         = "lmerSeq",
  nbzimm_nb       = "NBZIMM (NB)",
  nbzimm_zinb     = "NBZIMM (ZINB)"
)
method_levels <- unname(method_label_replic)
method_levels <- method_levels[!is.na(method_levels)]
method_levels <- unique(method_levels)

replic_dat <- bench_long %>%
  filter(method %in% names(method_label_replic)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(q_value), is.finite(estimate)) %>%
  mutate(
    method_label = method_label_replic[method],
    sig_01 = q_value < replic_alpha,
    direction = case_when(
      estimate > 0 ~ 1L,
      estimate < 0 ~ -1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(direction))

all_studies <- sort(unique(as.character(replic_dat$study)))

jaccard_one_study <- function(df_study, method_levels, key_col = "key") {
  df_study <- df_study %>%
    transmute(
      method_label = factor(as.character(method_label), levels = method_levels),
      key = as.character(.data[[key_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(method_label), !is.na(key)) %>%
    distinct(method_label, key)

  m <- length(method_levels)

  if (nrow(df_study) == 0) {
    out <- expand.grid(m1 = method_levels, m2 = method_levels, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    out$jaccard <- NA_real_
    return(out)
  }

  key_levels <- unique(df_study$key)
  p <- length(key_levels)

  i <- as.integer(df_study$method_label)
  j <- match(df_study$key, key_levels)

  X <- sparseMatrix(
    i = i, j = j, x = 1L,
    dims = c(m, p),
    dimnames = list(method_levels, key_levels)
  )

  rs <- Matrix::rowSums(X > 0)
  inter <- as.matrix(Matrix::tcrossprod(X > 0))
  union <- outer(rs, rs, "+") - inter

  jac <- inter / union
  jac[union == 0] <- NA_real_
  diag(jac)[rs > 0] <- 1.0
  diag(jac)[rs == 0] <- NA_real_

  out <- as.data.frame(as.table(jac), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(out) <- c("m1", "m2", "jaccard")
  out
}

compute_jaccard_across_studies <- function(replic_dat,
                                           method_levels,
                                           signed = FALSE,
                                           restrict_to_pim = FALSE,
                                           pim_label = "ALDEx3 \u03b3=0.3",
                                           only_studies_with_pim_hits = TRUE) {
  # significant calls for all methods
  if (!signed) {
    df_sig <- replic_dat %>%
      dplyr::filter(sig_01) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        study = as.character(study),
        method_label = as.character(method_label),
        feature = as.character(feature),
        key = as.character(feature)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct()
  } else {
    df_sig <- replic_dat %>%
      dplyr::filter(sig_01) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        study = as.character(study),
        method_label = as.character(method_label),
        feature = as.character(feature),
        key = paste0(as.character(feature), "||", if_else(direction > 0, "+", "-"))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct()
  }

  # Restrict to Bayesian PIM significant taxa per study (universe U_s)
  study_levels <- sort(unique(as.character(replic_dat$study)))

  if (restrict_to_pim) {
    universe <- df_sig %>%
      dplyr::filter(method_label == pim_label) %>%
      dplyr::select(study, feature) %>%
      dplyr::distinct()

    if (only_studies_with_pim_hits) {
      study_levels <- sort(unique(universe$study))
    }

    # keep only keys whose FEATURE is in the PIM universe for that study
    df_sig <- df_sig %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(universe, by = c("study", "feature"))
  }

  # split by study
  by_study <- split(df_sig, df_sig$study)

  # ensure all studies (or restricted study set) are included with empty frames if missing
  missing_studies <- setdiff(study_levels, names(by_study))
  if (length(missing_studies) > 0) {
    for (s in missing_studies) by_study[[s]] <- df_sig[0, ]
  }

  per_study <- lapply(names(by_study), function(s) {
    tmp <- by_study[[s]] %>% dplyr::select(method_label, key)
    jac_s <- jaccard_one_study(tmp, method_levels, key_col = "key")
    jac_s$study <- s
    jac_s
  })

  per_study_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(per_study) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      jaccard = as.numeric(jaccard),
      m1 = factor(m1, levels = method_levels),
      m2 = factor(m2, levels = method_levels)
    )

  safe_var <- function(x) {
    x <- x[is.finite(x)]
    if (length(x) < 2) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    stats::var(x)
  }

  summary <- per_study_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(m1, m2) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_jaccard = if (all(!is.finite(jaccard))) NA_real_ else mean(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_jaccard = if (all(!is.finite(jaccard))) NA_real_ else median(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_jaccard = if (all(!is.finite(jaccard))) NA_real_ else max(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_jaccard = if (all(!is.finite(jaccard))) NA_real_ else min(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      spread_jaccard = ifelse(is.finite(max_jaccard) & is.finite(min_jaccard),
        max_jaccard - min_jaccard, NA_real_
      ), # range
      var_jaccard = safe_var(jaccard),
      sd_jaccard = sqrt(var_jaccard),
      n_studies = sum(is.finite(jaccard)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  summary
}

plot_jaccard_heatmap <- function(jacc_df,
                                 label_stat = c("median", "mean"),
                                 fill_stat = c("variance", "sd", "range"),
                                 triangle = c("upper", "lower"),
                                 x_position = c("top", "bottom"),
                                 y_position = c("left", "right"),
                                 cluster = TRUE,
                                 show_numbers = TRUE,
                                 as_percent = FALSE,
                                 na_for_clustering = 0,
                                 diag_border = TRUE,
                                 diag_border_linewidth = 0.8,
                                 forced_order = NULL) {
  label_stat <- match.arg(label_stat)
  fill_stat <- match.arg(fill_stat)
  triangle <- match.arg(triangle)
  x_position <- match.arg(x_position)
  y_position <- match.arg(y_position)

  df <- as.data.frame(jacc_df)
  df$m1 <- as.character(df$m1)
  df$m2 <- as.character(df$m2)
  df$median_jaccard <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.vector(df$median_jaccard)))
  df$mean_jaccard <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.vector(df$mean_jaccard)))
  df$spread_jaccard <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.vector(df$spread_jaccard)))
  df$var_jaccard <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.vector(df$var_jaccard)))
  df$sd_jaccard <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.vector(df$sd_jaccard)))

  # collapse duplicates safely
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(m1, m2) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      median_jaccard = if (all(!is.finite(median_jaccard))) NA_real_ else median(median_jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_jaccard = if (all(!is.finite(mean_jaccard))) NA_real_ else mean(mean_jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      spread_jaccard = if (all(!is.finite(spread_jaccard))) NA_real_ else median(spread_jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      var_jaccard = if (all(!is.finite(var_jaccard))) NA_real_ else median(var_jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_jaccard = if (all(!is.finite(sd_jaccard))) NA_real_ else median(sd_jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  method_levels <- NULL
  if (is.factor(jacc_df$m1)) method_levels <- levels(jacc_df$m1)
  if (is.null(method_levels) || length(method_levels) == 0) {
    method_levels <- sort(unique(c(df$m1, df$m2)))
  }

  n <- length(method_levels)
  mkmat <- function(vals) {
    mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n, ncol = n, dimnames = list(method_levels, method_levels))
    ii <- match(df$m1, method_levels)
    jj <- match(df$m2, method_levels)
    ok <- is.finite(ii) & is.finite(jj)
    mat[cbind(ii[ok], jj[ok])] <- vals[ok]
    pmax(mat, t(mat), na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  median_mat <- mkmat(df$median_jaccard)
  diag(median_mat) <- 1
  mean_mat <- mkmat(df$mean_jaccard)
  diag(mean_mat) <- 1
  range_mat <- mkmat(df$spread_jaccard)
  diag(range_mat) <- 0
  var_mat <- mkmat(df$var_jaccard)
  diag(var_mat) <- 0
  sd_mat <- mkmat(df$sd_jaccard)
  diag(sd_mat) <- 0

  stat_mat <- if (label_stat == "median") median_mat else mean_mat
  fill_mat <- switch(fill_stat,
    variance = var_mat,
    sd       = sd_mat,
    range    = range_mat
  )

  ord <- method_levels

  if (!is.null(forced_order)) {
    forced_order <- as.character(forced_order)
    forced_order <- forced_order[forced_order %in% method_levels]
    extras <- setdiff(method_levels, forced_order)
    ord <- c(forced_order, extras)
  } else if (cluster) {
    mat_for_dist <- stat_mat
    mat_for_dist[is.na(mat_for_dist)] <- na_for_clustering
    diag(mat_for_dist) <- 1
    d <- stats::as.dist(1 - mat_for_dist)
    hc <- stats::hclust(d, method = "average")
    ord <- hc$labels[hc$order]
  }

  plot_df <- expand.grid(m1 = ord, m2 = ord, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  i2 <- match(plot_df$m1, rownames(stat_mat))
  j2 <- match(plot_df$m2, colnames(stat_mat))

  plot_df$stat_jaccard <- stat_mat[cbind(i2, j2)]
  plot_df$fill_value <- fill_mat[cbind(i2, j2)]

  plot_df$m1 <- factor(plot_df$m1, levels = ord)
  plot_df$m2 <- factor(plot_df$m2, levels = ord)
  plot_df$xi <- as.integer(plot_df$m1)
  plot_df$yi <- as.integer(plot_df$m2)

  if (triangle == "upper") plot_df <- plot_df[plot_df$xi <= plot_df$yi, , drop = FALSE]
  if (triangle == "lower") plot_df <- plot_df[plot_df$xi >= plot_df$yi, , drop = FALSE]

  eps <- 1e-2
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      lab = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.finite(stat_jaccard) ~ "",
        abs(stat_jaccard) < eps ~ "0",
        abs(stat_jaccard - 1) < eps ~ "1",
        TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", stat_jaccard)
      ),
      is_mid = is.finite(stat_jaccard) & (stat_jaccard > eps) & (stat_jaccard < 1 - eps)
    )

  quote_for_parse <- function(z) {
    z <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", z)
    z <- gsub('"', '\\"', z)
    paste0('"', z, '"')
  }
  axis_lab <- function(x) {
    expr_txt <- vapply(x, function(xx) {
      if (identical(xx, "ALDEx3 \u03b3=0.3")) "bolditalic('Bayesian PIM')" else quote_for_parse(xx)
    }, character(1))
    parse(text = expr_txt)
  }

  # diagonal border: for upper triangle, draw below diagonal; for lower triangle, draw above diagonal
  diag_seg <- NULL
  if (diag_border) {
    if (triangle == "upper") {
      horiz <- data.frame(x = (1:n) - 0.5, xend = (1:n) + 0.5, y = (1:n) - 0.5, yend = (1:n) - 0.5)
      vert <- data.frame(x = (1:(n - 1)) + 0.5, xend = (1:(n - 1)) + 0.5, y = (1:(n - 1)) - 0.5, yend = (1:(n - 1)) + 0.5)
    } else {
      horiz <- data.frame(x = (1:n) - 0.5, xend = (1:n) + 0.5, y = (1:n) + 0.5, yend = (1:n) + 0.5)
      vert <- data.frame(x = (1:(n - 1)) + 0.5, xend = (1:(n - 1)) + 0.5, y = (1:(n - 1)) + 0.5, yend = (1:(n - 1)) + 1.5)
    }
    diag_seg <- rbind(horiz, vert)
  }

  fill_name <- switch(fill_stat,
    variance = "Variance across studies",
    sd       = "SD across studies",
    range    = "Range (max − min)"
  )

  max_fill <- suppressWarnings(max(plot_df$fill_value, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(max_fill) || max_fill <= 0) max_fill <- 1

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = xi, y = yi, fill = fill_value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    {
      if (diag_border) {
        geom_segment(
          data = diag_seg,
          aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          linewidth = diag_border_linewidth,
          color = "grey20"
        )
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    } +
    {
      if (show_numbers) {
        list(
          geom_text(data = subset(plot_df, !is_mid), aes(label = lab), size = 3.6, color = "grey15"),
          geom_text(data = subset(plot_df, is_mid), aes(label = lab), size = 4.4, fontface = "bold", color = "grey15")
        )
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    } +
    coord_fixed() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:n, labels = axis_lab(ord), position = x_position, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:n, labels = axis_lab(ord), position = y_position, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("white", "#c6dbef", "#6baed6", "#2171b5"),
      na.value = "grey92",
      limits = c(0, max_fill),
      name = fill_name
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
      barheight = unit(45, "mm"),
      barwidth = unit(4.5, "mm"),
      ticks.colour = "grey20",
      frame.colour = "grey20"
    )) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.top = if (x_position == "top") element_line(linewidth = 1) else element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = if (x_position == "bottom") element_line(linewidth = 1) else element_blank(),
      axis.line.y.left = if (y_position == "left") element_line(linewidth = 1) else element_blank(),
      axis.line.y.right = if (y_position == "right") element_line(linewidth = 1) else element_blank(),
      axis.text.x.top = if (x_position == "top") element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 14, color = "grey20") else element_blank(),
      axis.text.x.bottom = if (x_position == "bottom") element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 14, color = "grey20") else element_blank(),
      axis.text.y.left = if (y_position == "left") element_text(size = 14, color = "grey20") else element_blank(),
      axis.text.y.right = if (y_position == "right") element_text(size = 14, color = "grey20") else element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4, unit = "mm")
    )
}

print_max_between_methods <- function(jacc_df, label, top_n = 10) {
  df <- as.data.frame(jacc_df)

  df$m1 <- as.character(df$m1)
  df$m2 <- as.character(df$m2)
  df$max_jaccard <- as.numeric(df$max_jaccard)
  df$median_jaccard <- as.numeric(df$median_jaccard)
  df$spread_jaccard <- as.numeric(df$spread_jaccard)
  df$n_studies <- as.integer(df$n_studies)

  df <- df[df$m1 != df$m2 & is.finite(df$max_jaccard), , drop = FALSE]

  cat("\n", label, "\n", sep = "")
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No finite between-method maxima.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  ord <- order(df$max_jaccard, decreasing = TRUE)
  best <- df[ord[1], , drop = FALSE]

  cat(sprintf(
    "Max between-method Jaccard across studies: %.3f (%s vs %s)\n",
    best$max_jaccard[1], best$m1[1], best$m2[1]
  ))

  k <- min(top_n, length(ord))
  top <- df[ord[seq_len(k)], c("m1", "m2", "max_jaccard", "median_jaccard", "spread_jaccard", "n_studies"), drop = FALSE]

  cat(sprintf("Top %d method-pairs by max Jaccard (max, median, spread, n_studies):\n", k))
  print(top, row.names = FALSE)

  invisible(NULL)
}

get_jaccard_cluster_order <- function(jacc_df,
                                      label_stat = c("median", "mean"),
                                      na_for_clustering = 0) {
  label_stat <- match.arg(label_stat)

  df <- as.data.frame(jacc_df)
  df$m1 <- as.character(df$m1)
  df$m2 <- as.character(df$m2)

  # pick the statistic used for clustering
  if (label_stat == "median") {
    stat <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.vector(df$median_jaccard)))
  } else {
    stat <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.vector(df$mean_jaccard)))
  }

  method_levels <- NULL
  if (is.factor(jacc_df$m1)) method_levels <- levels(jacc_df$m1)
  if (is.null(method_levels) || length(method_levels) == 0) {
    method_levels <- sort(unique(c(df$m1, df$m2)))
  }

  n <- length(method_levels)
  mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n, ncol = n, dimnames = list(method_levels, method_levels))

  ii <- match(df$m1, method_levels)
  jj <- match(df$m2, method_levels)
  ok <- is.finite(ii) & is.finite(jj)

  mat[cbind(ii[ok], jj[ok])] <- stat[ok]

  mat <- pmax(mat, t(mat), na.rm = TRUE)
  diag(mat) <- 1

  mat_for_dist <- mat
  mat_for_dist[is.na(mat_for_dist)] <- na_for_clustering
  diag(mat_for_dist) <- 1

  d <- stats::as.dist(1 - mat_for_dist)
  hc <- stats::hclust(d, method = "average")
  hc$labels[hc$order]
}

jacc_sgn <- compute_jaccard_across_studies(replic_dat, method_levels, signed = TRUE)
print_max_between_methods(jacc_sgn, "SIGNED (feature + direction)", 50)
p_jaccard_signed <- plot_jaccard_heatmap(jacc_sgn, label_stat = "mean", fill_stat = "range")
print(p_jaccard_signed)

# ---------- save PDFs ----------
ggsave("method_agreement_jaccard_signed.pdf", p_jaccard_signed, device = cairo_pdf, width = 12, height = 7, units = "in")

pim_label <- method_label_replic[["aldex3_mem_0p3"]] # "ALDEx3 γ=0.3"

compute_pim_universe_recall <- function(
  replic_dat,
  pim_label,
  method_col = "method_label",
  study_col = "study",
  feature_col = "feature",
  sig_col = "sig_01",
  dir_col = "direction",
  forced_order = NULL,
  only_studies_with_pim_hits = TRUE
) {
  # signed token: "Genus:+"/"Genus:-"
  make_tokens <- function(df) {
    df <- df %>%
      filter(.data[[sig_col]] == TRUE) %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[feature_col]]), !is.na(.data[[dir_col]])) %>%
      mutate(.tok = paste0(.data[[feature_col]], ":", ifelse(.data[[dir_col]] > 0, "+", "-")))
    unique(df$.tok)
  }

  studies <- sort(unique(replic_dat[[study_col]]))
  all_methods <- sort(unique(replic_dat[[method_col]]))
  other_methods <- setdiff(all_methods, pim_label)

  out <- list()

  for (s in studies) {
    df_s <- replic_dat %>% filter(.data[[study_col]] == s)

    S_pim <- make_tokens(df_s %>% filter(.data[[method_col]] == pim_label))
    n_pim <- length(S_pim)

    if (only_studies_with_pim_hits && n_pim == 0) next

    for (m in other_methods) {
      S_m <- make_tokens(df_s %>% filter(.data[[method_col]] == m))

      k <- if (n_pim == 0) NA_integer_ else length(intersect(S_pim, S_m))
      recall <- if (n_pim == 0) NA_real_ else (k / n_pim)

      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
        study = s,
        method = m,
        recall = recall,
        k = k,
        n_pim = n_pim,
        label = ifelse(is.na(recall), "", paste0(k, "/", n_pim))
      )
    }
  }

  df_out <- bind_rows(out)

  # order methods to match your main clustering if provided
  if (!is.null(forced_order)) {
    keep <- intersect(forced_order, other_methods)
    keep <- c(keep, setdiff(other_methods, keep))
    df_out$method <- factor(df_out$method, levels = keep)
  } else {
    df_out$method <- factor(df_out$method, levels = other_methods)
  }

  # keep study order as it appears in df_out
  df_out$study <- factor(df_out$study, levels = unique(df_out$study))

  df_out
}

plot_pim_universe_heatmap <- function(df_pim, title = NULL) {
  ggplot(df_pim, aes(x = study, y = method, fill = recall)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "red",
      high = "grey90",
      limits = c(0, 1),
      na.value = "white",
      name = "Recall"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL, y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)
    )
}

library(ComplexUpset)

make_upset_for_method <- function(sig_sets_3, method_key, method_label, pim_studies,
                                  consistent_only = FALSE) {
  df <- sig_sets_3 %>%
    filter(method == method_key) %>%
    mutate(study = factor(as.character(study), levels = pim_studies))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        labs(title = method_label, subtitle = "No significant genera in these 3 studies")
    )
  }

  if (consistent_only) {
    keep_feats <- df %>%
      group_by(feature) %>%
      summarise(
        R_pos = sum(direction == 1L),
        R_neg = sum(direction == -1L),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      filter(R_pos == 0L | R_neg == 0L) %>%
      select(feature)

    df <- df %>% semi_join(keep_feats, by = "feature")

    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(
        ggplot() +
          theme_void() +
          labs(title = method_label, subtitle = "No sign-consistent significant genera in these 3 studies")
      )
    }
  }

  wide <- df %>%
    distinct(feature, study) %>%
    mutate(present = TRUE) %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      feature,
      study = factor(pim_studies, levels = pim_studies),
      fill = list(present = FALSE)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = present)

  study_cols <- pim_studies

  p <- ComplexUpset::upset(
    wide,
    intersect = study_cols,
    min_size = 0,
    base_annotations = list(
      "Intersection size" = ComplexUpset::intersection_size()
    ),
    set_sizes = ComplexUpset::upset_set_size()
  ) +
    labs(
      title = method_label,
      subtitle = if (consistent_only) "Significant genera with strict sign consistency" else "Significant genera (q < threshold)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  p
}

# 4) For each method+genus, compute replication + sign counts within these 3 studies

    R_total = n_distinct(study),
    R_pos   = sum(direction == 1L),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

    values_from = present,
```

```{r aldex3_gamma_heatmap_amplicon}
scale_radius_mm <- function(nlq) {
  nlq <- max(min(nlq, nlq_max), nlq_min)
  t <- (nlq - nlq_min) / (nlq_max - nlq_min)
  r_min_mm + t * (r_max_mm - r_min_mm)
}

dot_breaks <- unique(round(c(nlq_min, (nlq_min + nlq_max) / 2, nlq_max), 2))
dot_sizes <- unit(vapply(dot_breaks, scale_radius_mm, numeric(1)), "mm")

dot_legend <- Legend(
  title = expression(-log[10](q)),
  labels = format(dot_breaks, trim = TRUE),
  type = "points",
  pch = 16,
  size = dot_sizes,
  legend_gp = gpar(col = "black", fill = "black")
)

sig_legend <- Legend(
  title = "",
  labels = c("q < 0.05", expression(0.05 <= q ~ "<" ~ 0.10)),
  type = "points",
  pch = 16,
  size = unit(2, "mm"),
  legend_gp = gpar(col = c("black", "grey60"), fill = c("black", "grey60"))
)

sp_obs <- bench_long %>%
  filter(study %in% sig_studies_3, feature %in% rownames(mat_eff)) %>%
  group_by(study, feature) %>%
  summarise(
    taxa_sparsity_pct = {
      v <- taxa_sparsity_pct[is.finite(taxa_sparsity_pct)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )
sp_df <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  study = sig_studies_3,
  feature = rownames(mat_eff)
) %>%
  left_join(sp_obs, by = c("study", "feature")) %>%
  mutate(taxa_sparsity_pct = ifelse(is.na(taxa_sparsity_pct), 100, taxa_sparsity_pct))
col_fun_sp <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 50, 100), c("white", "grey70", "black"))
ht_list <- NULL

for (k in seq_along(sig_studies_3)) {
  st <- sig_studies_3[k]
  cols_st <- grep(paste0("^", st, "__"), colnames(mat_eff), value = TRUE)

  mat_eff_st <- mat_eff[, cols_st, drop = FALSE]
  mat_q_st <- mat_q[, cols_st, drop = FALSE]
  mat_nlq_st <- mat_nlq[, cols_st, drop = FALSE]

  gamma_labels <- paste0("ALDEx3 \u03B3=", sub("^.*__", "", cols_st))

  ht_lfc <- Heatmap(
    mat_eff_st,
    name = if (k == 1) "LFC" else paste0("LFC_", k),
    col = col_fun_lfc,
    na_col = "grey92",
    row_order = row_order,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    show_row_names = FALSE,
    row_names_side = "right",
    show_column_names = TRUE,
    column_labels = gamma_labels,
    column_names_rot = 45,
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.4),
    border = FALSE,
    column_title = st,
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "LFC",
      at = c(-lim, 0, lim),
      labels = c(sprintf("%.2f", -lim), "0", sprintf("%.2f", lim))
    ),
    show_heatmap_legend = (k == 1),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      qv <- mat_q_st[i, j]

      # Show dots for q < 0.10, with color by band
      if (is.finite(qv) && !is.na(qv) && qv < q_show_max) {
        nlq <- mat_nlq_st[i, j]
        if (is.finite(nlq) && !is.na(nlq)) {
          dot_fill <- if (qv < alpha) "black" else "grey60"
          grid.circle(
            x, y,
            r = unit(scale_radius_mm(nlq), "mm"),
            gp = gpar(fill = dot_fill, col = NA)
          )
        }
      }
    }
  )

  sp_vec <- sp_df %>%
    filter(study == st) %>%
    select(feature, taxa_sparsity_pct) %>%
    distinct()

  sp_vals <- sp_vec$taxa_sparsity_pct[match(rownames(mat_eff), sp_vec$feature)]
  sp_vals[is.na(sp_vals)] <- 100

  mat_sp_st <- matrix(sp_vals, ncol = 1)
  rownames(mat_sp_st) <- rownames(mat_eff)
  colnames(mat_sp_st) <- "Sparsity"

  ht_sp <- Heatmap(
    mat_sp_st,
    name = if (k == 1) "Sparsity (%)" else paste0("Sparsity (%)_", k),
    col = col_fun_sp,
    na_col = "grey92",
    row_order = row_order,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    show_row_names = (k == length(sig_studies_3)),
    row_names_side = "right",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    show_column_names = TRUE,
    column_names_rot = 45,
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.4),
    border = FALSE,
    width = unit(10, "mm"),
    show_heatmap_legend = (k == 1),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Sparsity (%)",
      at = c(0, 50, 100),
      labels = c("0", "50", "100")
    ),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      v <- mat_sp_st[i, j]
      if (is.finite(v) && !is.na(v)) {
        txt <- sprintf("%.0f", v)
        txt_col <- if (v >= 70) "white" else "black"
        grid.text(txt, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, col = txt_col))
      }
    }
  )

  if (is.null(ht_list)) {
    ht_list <- ht_lfc + ht_sp
  } else {
    ht_list <- ht_list + ht_lfc + ht_sp
  }
}

pdf("Aldex3hits_heatmap.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
draw(
  ht_list,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_list = list(dot_legend, sig_legend)
)
dev.off()

keep_gammas <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0)
if (!exists("sig_studies_3")) stop("sig_studies_3 not found (needs your 3 studies).")
collapsed <- bench_long %>%
  filter(study %in% sig_studies_3) %>%
  filter(str_detect(method, "^aldex3_mem_")) %>%
  mutate(
    gamma = case_when(
      method == "aldex3_mem_0p1" ~ 0.1,
      method == "aldex3_mem_0p3" ~ 0.3,
      method == "aldex3_mem_0p5" ~ 0.5,
      method == "aldex3_mem_1" ~ 1.0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(gamma %in% keep_gammas) %>%
  group_by(study, feature, gamma) %>%
  summarise(
    LFC = {
      v <- estimate[is.finite(estimate)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    q = {
      v <- q_value[is.finite(q_value)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else min(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

feature_universe <- collapsed %>%
  distinct(feature) %>%
  pull(feature)

grid_all <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  study = sig_studies_3,
  feature = feature_universe,
  gamma = keep_gammas
) %>%
  left_join(collapsed, by = c("study", "feature", "gamma")) %>%
  mutate(
    study = factor(study, levels = sig_studies_3),
    gamma = factor(gamma, levels = keep_gammas),
    sgn = case_when(
      is.na(LFC) ~ NA_integer_,
      LFC > 0 ~ 1L,
      LFC < 0 ~ -1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  )

thresholds <- tibble(
  thr = c(0.10, 0.05),
  thr_label = c("q < 0.10", "q < 0.05")
)

feat_thr <- thresholds %>%
  tidyr::crossing(grid_all %>% select(study, feature, gamma, q, sgn)) %>%
  mutate(hit = is.finite(q) & !is.na(q) & (q < thr)) %>%
  group_by(thr_label, thr, feature, gamma) %>%
  summarise(
    k_hit_num = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
    sign_group = {
      if (k_hit_num <= 1) {
        "one-study hit"
      } else {
        vals <- sgn[hit & !is.na(sgn) & sgn != 0L]
        if (length(vals) >= 2 && length(unique(vals)) == 1) {
          if (unique(vals) == 1L) "both positive" else "both negative"
        } else if (length(vals) >= 2 && length(unique(vals)) > 1) {
          "mixed sign"
        } else {
          "one-study hit"
        }
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    k_hit = factor(
      k_hit_num,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("hit in 1 study", "hit in 2 studies")
    ),
    thr_label = factor(thr_label, levels = c("q < 0.10", "q < 0.05")),
    gamma = factor(gamma, levels = keep_gammas),
    sign_group = factor(
      sign_group,
      levels = c("both positive", "both negative", "mixed sign", "one-study hit")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(k_hit_num %in% c(1, 2))

print(
  thresholds %>% filter(thr_label == "q < 0.10") %>%
    tidyr::crossing(grid_all %>% select(study, feature, gamma, q, sgn)) %>%
    mutate(hit = is.finite(q) & !is.na(q) & (q < 0.10)) %>%
    group_by(feature, gamma) %>%
    summarise(
      hit_studies = paste(study[hit], collapse = ","),
      signs = paste(sgn[hit], collapse = ","),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(str_count(hit_studies, ",") == 1) %>%
    arrange(gamma, feature)
)

count_df <- feat_thr %>%
  group_by(thr_label, gamma, k_hit, sign_group) %>%
  summarise(n_taxa = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    thr_label = factor(c("q < 0.10", "q < 0.05"), levels = c("q < 0.10", "q < 0.05")),
    gamma = factor(keep_gammas, levels = keep_gammas),
    k_hit = factor(c("hit in 1 study", "hit in 2 studies"),
      levels = c("hit in 1 study", "hit in 2 studies")
    ),
    sign_group = factor(c("both positive", "both negative", "mixed sign"),
      levels = c("both positive", "both negative", "mixed sign")
    ),
    fill = list(n_taxa = 0)
  )

p <- ggplot(count_df, aes(x = gamma, y = n_taxa, fill = sign_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85, color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.25) +
  facet_grid(thr_label ~ k_hit, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "both positive" = "#2166ac", # blue
      "both negative" = "#b2182b", # red
      "mixed sign"    = "black",
      "one-study hit" = "grey75"
    ),
    name = "LFC sign agreement"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(gamma),
    y = "Number of taxa",
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p)
ggsave("aldex3_hits_counts_signagreement_amp.png", p, width = 7.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 600)

cat("\n=== q < 0.10, hit in 2 studies, gamma = 0.3: BOTH POSITIVE ===\n")
print(

    filter(thr_label == "q < 0.10", gamma == 0.3, k_hit == "hit in 2 studies", sign_group == "both positive") %>%
    arrange(feature) %>% pull(feature) %>% unique()
)

# \textbf{FAPROTAX trait enrichment (autism vs.\ control).}
# Genera were annotated to FAPROTAX traits and tested for enrichment of differential-abundance signals.
# For each genus $g$, we computed an autism--control log fold change $\mathrm{LFC}(g)$.
# To reduce sensitivity to outliers and rare genera, we defined a genus score
# \[
# \mathrm{score}(g)
# =
# \mathrm{sign}\!\bigl(\mathrm{LFC}(g)\bigr)\;
# \mathrm{rank}\!\Bigl(\bigl|\mathrm{LFC}(g)\bigr|\Bigr)\;
# w(g),
# \]
# where $\mathrm{rank}(|\mathrm{LFC}(g)|)$ is the rank of the absolute log fold change among genera within the study
# (larger rank indicates a more extreme effect) and $w(g)\in[0,1]$ is a scaled weight based on the mean relative abundance
# of genus $g$ across samples.
# For each trait $T$ with member set $G_T$, we report
# \[
# \texttt{mean\_score}(T) \;=\; \frac{1}{|G_T|}\sum_{g\in G_T}\mathrm{score}(g),
# \]
# so $\texttt{mean\_score}(T) > 0$ indicates enrichment among genera increased in autism, and
# $\texttt{mean\_score}(T) < 0$ indicates enrichment among genera increased in controls.
# Significance was assessed by a two-sided permutation test: for each trait size $m=|G_T|$,
# we compared the observed $\texttt{mean\_score}(T)$ to the distribution of mean scores from random sets of $m$ genera,
# yielding a two-sided $p$-value (\texttt{p\_two}); $q$-values were obtained by FDR correction across traits within each study.
# For interpretability, we also report
# \[
# \texttt{mean\_LFC\_raw}(T) \;=\; \frac{1}{|G_T|}\sum_{g\in G_T}\mathrm{LFC}(g),
# \]
# the average autism--control log fold change across trait member genera.

stopifnot(inherits(tree, "phylo"))
stopifnot(is.data.frame(taxonomy))

method_keep <- "aldex3_mem_0p3"
topN <- 100
q_black <- 0.05
q_grey <- 0.10

# ---------- helpers ----------
clean_rank <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "^d__|^p__|^c__|^o__|^f__|^g__", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "^Domain__|^Phylum__|^Class__|^Order__|^Family__|^Genus__", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[x == "" | is.na(x)] <- NA_character_
  x
}

# ---------- 1) summarize LFC + q per study x feature ----------
lfc_tbl <- bench_long %>%
  filter(method == method_keep) %>%
  group_by(study, feature) %>%
  summarise(
    LFC = {
      v <- estimate[is.finite(estimate)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else median(v)
    },
    q = {
      v <- q_value[is.finite(q_value)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else min(v)
    },
    sparsity = {
      v <- sample_sparsity_median_pct[is.finite(sample_sparsity_median_pct)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else median(v)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

all_studies <- sort(unique(lfc_tbl$study))


# Assumes you already have: bench_long, taxonomy, method_keep
stopifnot(exists("bench_long"), exists("taxonomy"), exists("method_keep"))

# ---- helpers (same logic as your earlier code) ----
clean_genus <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_replace(x, "^Genus__", "")
  x <- str_replace(x, "^g__", "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  str_squish(x)
}

pick_first_non_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else x[1]
}

canon_genus_key <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_replace(x, "^Genus__", "")
  x <- str_replace(x, "^g__", "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "[/\\-]", " ")
  x <- str_replace(x, "(sensu stricto) [0-9]+$", "\\1")
  x <- str_squish(x)
  x[x == "" | is.na(x)] <- NA_character_
  x
}


canon_rank_key <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "^d__|^p__|^c__|^o__|^f__|^g__", "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "^Domain__|^Phylum__|^Class__|^Order__|^Family__|^Genus__", "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  x <- str_replace(x, " [A-Z] [0-9]+$", "")
  x <- str_squish(x)
  x[x == "" | is.na(x)] <- NA_character_
  x
}

# ---- 1) per-study summary for ALL features for this method ----
lfc_tbl_all <- bench_long %>%
  filter(method == method_keep) %>%
  group_by(study, feature) %>%
  summarise(
    LFC = {
      v <- estimate[is.finite(estimate)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else median(v)
    },
    q = {
      v <- q_value[is.finite(q_value)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else min(v)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- 2) collapse to genus_key across studies (this is what we rank) ----
genus_stats <- lfc_tbl_all %>%
  mutate(
    Genus_clean = clean_genus(feature),
    Genus_key   = canon_genus_key(Genus_clean)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Genus_key)) %>%
  group_by(Genus_key) %>%
  summarise(
    Genus_display = pick_first_non_na(Genus_clean),
    med_LFC = {
      v <- LFC[is.finite(LFC)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else median(v)
    },
    best_q = {
      v <- q[is.finite(q)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else min(v)
    },
    n_studies = sum(is.finite(LFC)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    best_q = ifelse(is.na(best_q) | !is.finite(best_q), 1, best_q),
    # Ranking statistic S_g for genus g:
    # S_g = sign(med_LFC_g) * (-log10(best_q_g))
    # Positive = enriched toward +LFC end, negative = toward -LFC end.
    stat = sign(med_LFC) * (-log10(best_q))
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(stat))

# ---- 3) map genus_key -> Phylum using taxonomy ----
stopifnot(all(c("Genus", "Phylum") %in% names(taxonomy)))

tax_map <- taxonomy %>%
  transmute(
    Genus_key = canon_genus_key(clean_genus(Genus)),
    Phylum    = canon_rank_key(Phylum)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Genus_key)) %>%
  group_by(Genus_key) %>%
  summarise(
    Phylum = pick_first_non_na(Phylum),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

genus_stats <- genus_stats %>%
  left_join(tax_map, by = "Genus_key") %>%
  mutate(Phylum = ifelse(is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "", "Unknown", Phylum))

min_set_size <- 3

sets <- genus_stats %>%
  filter(Phylum != "Unknown") %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(members = list(unique(Genus_key)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(lengths(members) >= min_set_size)

pathways <- setNames(sets$members, sets$Phylum)

# Ranked vector: names are Genus_key, values are stat
stats_vec <- genus_stats$stat
names(stats_vec) <- genus_stats$Genus_key
stats_vec <- sort(stats_vec, decreasing = TRUE)

# Use fgsea if installed (fast + standard). Otherwise stop with a clear message.
if (!requireNamespace("fgsea", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install fgsea to run GSEA-like enrichment: install.packages('fgsea')")
}

fg <- fgsea::fgseaMultilevel(
  pathways = pathways,
  stats    = stats_vec,
  minSize  = min_set_size,
  maxSize  = 50000
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Enriched toward +LFC", "Enriched toward -LFC"),
    neglog10FDR = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300))
  )

# ---- 5) lollipop plot of top enriched phyla in each direction ----
top_k <- 15
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  fg %>% filter(NES > 0) %>% slice_min(padj, n = top_k),
  fg %>% filter(NES < 0) %>% slice_min(padj, n = top_k)
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Phylum = pathway) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Phylum = reorder(Phylum, NES))

fg_plot <- fg %>%
  mutate(
    TaxonSet = pathway,
    Direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Autism", "Control"),
    neglog10FDR = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300))
  )

gg <- ggplot(fg_plot, aes(x = NES, y = reorder(TaxonSet, NES))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NES, yend = reorder(TaxonSet, NES))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = size, alpha = neglog10FDR)) +
  labs(
    x = "Enrichment Score",
    y = "Phylum set",
    size = "Set size (number of genera)",
    alpha = "-log10(FDR)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave(
  filename = "phylum_gsea_lollipop.png",
  plot     = gg,
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7,
  units    = "in",
  dpi      = 300
)

# Full table:
fg

# ---------- 2) choose taxa_keep: all q<0.05 first, then fill with q<0.10 ----------
taxon_rank <- lfc_tbl %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  summarise(
    best_q  = suppressWarnings(min(q[is.finite(q)], na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_abs = suppressWarnings(max(abs(LFC[is.finite(LFC)]), na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    best_q  = ifelse(is.infinite(best_q), NA_real_, best_q),
    max_abs = ifelse(is.infinite(max_abs), NA_real_, max_abs),
    any05   = is.finite(best_q) & (best_q < q_black),
    any10   = is.finite(best_q) & (best_q < q_grey)
  )

sig05 <- taxon_rank %>%
  filter(any05) %>%
  arrange(best_q, desc(max_abs)) %>%
  pull(feature)

if (length(sig05) > topN) {
  taxa_keep <- sig05[seq_len(topN)]
} else {
  remaining <- taxon_rank %>%
    filter(!feature %in% sig05) %>%
    arrange(desc(any10), best_q, desc(max_abs)) %>%
    pull(feature)
  need <- topN - length(sig05)
  taxa_keep <- c(sig05, head(remaining, need))
}

# ---------- 3) build LFC and q matrices (rows = features, cols = studies) ----------
mat_lfc <- lfc_tbl %>%
  filter(feature %in% taxa_keep) %>%
  select(feature, study, LFC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = LFC) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(mat_lfc) <- mat_lfc$feature
mat_lfc$feature <- NULL
mat_lfc <- as.matrix(mat_lfc)[, all_studies, drop = FALSE]

mat_q <- lfc_tbl %>%
  filter(feature %in% taxa_keep) %>%
  select(feature, study, q) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = q) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(mat_q) <- mat_q$feature
mat_q$feature <- NULL
mat_q <- as.matrix(mat_q)[, all_studies, drop = FALSE]
feat_raw <- rownames(mat_lfc)
row_key <- canon_genus_key(clean_genus(feat_raw))
row_labels_vec <- clean_genus(feat_raw)
names(row_labels_vec) <- row_key
rownames(mat_lfc) <- row_key
rownames(mat_q) <- row_key

# ---------- 4) column clustering (cluster columns, hide dendrogram later) ----------
mat_imp <- mat_lfc
for (i in seq_len(nrow(mat_imp))) {
  bad <- !is.finite(mat_imp[i, ])
  if (any(bad)) mat_imp[i, bad] <- 0
}
col_dend <- as.dendrogram(hclust(dist(t(mat_imp)), method = "complete"))
col_order <- labels(col_dend)

# ---------- 5) left taxonomy bars (Only Phylum) ----------
needed_cols <- c("Genus", "Family", "Order", "Class", "Phylum")
missing_cols <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(taxonomy))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) stop("taxonomy is missing columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
if (!("Domain" %in% names(taxonomy))) taxonomy$Domain <- NA_character_

# Only compute taxonomy mappings for the genera we actually plot
g_plot_key <- canon_genus_key(clean_genus(rownames(mat_lfc)))

tax_sub_for_anno <- taxonomy %>%
  mutate(
    Genus_key = canon_genus_key(Genus),
    Family    = canon_rank_key(Family),
    Order     = canon_rank_key(Order),
    Class     = canon_rank_key(Class),
    Phylum    = canon_rank_key(Phylum),
    Domain    = canon_rank_key(Domain)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Genus_key), Genus_key %in% g_plot_key)

tax_map_genus <- tax_sub_for_anno %>%
  group_by(Genus_key) %>%
  summarise(
    Domain = pick_first_non_na(Domain),
    Phylum = pick_first_non_na(Phylum),
    Class = pick_first_non_na(Class),
    Order = pick_first_non_na(Order),
    Family = pick_first_non_na(Family),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

anno_df <- data.frame(
  feature = rownames(mat_lfc),
  Genus = canon_genus_key(clean_genus(rownames(mat_lfc))),
  Genus_key = canon_genus_key(clean_genus(rownames(mat_lfc))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  left_join(tax_map_genus, by = "Genus_key") %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum = ifelse(is.na(Phylum), "Unknown", Phylum),
    Class  = ifelse(is.na(Class), "Unknown", Class),
    Order  = ifelse(is.na(Order), "Unknown", Order),
    Family = ifelse(is.na(Family), "Unknown", Family)
  )

rownames(anno_df) <- anno_df$feature
ranks_to_show <- c("Phylum")

make_named_colors <- function(vals) {
  u <- sort(unique(vals))
  cols <- viridis::viridis(length(u))
  names(cols) <- u
  cols
}

rank_cols <- lapply(ranks_to_show, function(rk) make_named_colors(anno_df[[rk]]))
names(rank_cols) <- ranks_to_show

row_ha_left <- rowAnnotation(
  df = anno_df[, ranks_to_show, drop = FALSE],
  col = rank_cols,
  show_annotation_name = TRUE,
  show_legend = FALSE,
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  simple_anno_size = unit(2.3, "mm")
)

# ---------- 6) Row Dendrogram (Phylogeny) ----------
phy_full <- tree
if (is.null(phy_full$edge.length)) phy_full$edge.length <- rep(1, nrow(phy_full$edge))
stopifnot("Feature ID" %in% names(taxonomy))

tip_genus_map <- taxonomy %>%
  transmute(
    tip = as.character(.data[["Feature ID"]]),
    genus_key = canon_genus_key(.data[["Genus"]])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tip), !is.na(genus_key), genus_key %in% g_plot_key)

tips_needed <- intersect(tip_genus_map$tip, phy_full$tip.label)

if (length(tips_needed) < 3) {
  stop("Fewer than 3 tips found in taxonomy tree. Check matching logic.")
} else {
  phy_tree <- ape::keep.tip(phy_full, tips_needed)
  depth <- ape::node.depth.edgelength(phy_tree)
  tip_id <- setNames(seq_along(phy_tree$tip.label), phy_tree$tip.label)

  tips_by_genus <- split(tip_genus_map$tip, tip_genus_map$genus_key)

  rep_tip <- vapply(intersect(names(tips_by_genus), g_plot_key), function(gk) {
    tips <- intersect(as.character(tips_by_genus[[gk]]), phy_tree$tip.label)
    if (length(tips) == 0) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }
    if (length(tips) == 1) {
      return(tips)
    }

    idx <- unname(tip_id[tips])
    m <- ape::getMRCA(phy_tree, idx)
    if (is.null(m) || length(m) == 0 || is.na(m)) {
      return(tips[1])
    }

    d <- depth[idx] - depth[m]
    tips[which.min(d)]
  }, character(1))

  rep_tip <- rep_tip[!is.na(rep_tip)]
  g_used <- names(rep_tip)

  if (length(rep_tip) < 3) {
    stop("Fewer than 3 representative tips found for clustering.")
  } else {
    genus_tree <- ape::keep.tip(phy_tree, unname(rep_tip))
    genus_tree$tip.label <- g_used[match(genus_tree$tip.label, rep_tip)]
    keep_rows <- intersect(rownames(mat_lfc), genus_tree$tip.label)
    cat("keep_rows:", length(keep_rows), "\n")

    if (length(keep_rows) < nrow(mat_lfc)) {
      mat_lfc <- mat_lfc[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
      mat_q <- mat_q[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
      mat_imp <- mat_imp[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
      anno_df <- anno_df[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
      genus_tree <- ape::keep.tip(genus_tree, keep_rows)
    }

    genus_tree <- ape::ladderize(genus_tree, right = FALSE)
    genus_tree_u <- ape::compute.brlen(genus_tree, method = "Grafen")
    genus_tree_u <- ape::ladderize(genus_tree_u, right = FALSE)
    hc_phy <- ape::as.hclust.phylo(genus_tree_u)
    row_dend <- as.dendrogram(hc_phy)
  }
}

# ---------- 7) color scale ----------
abs_vals <- abs(mat_lfc[is.finite(mat_lfc)])
lim <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(abs_vals, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))
if (!is.finite(lim) || lim == 0) lim <- max(abs_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(lim) || lim == 0) lim <- 1
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-lim, 0, lim), c("#b2182b", "white", "#2166ac"))

rownames(technical_summary) <- technical_summary$Study

# ---------- 8) Study Characteristics ----------
metrics_by_study <- list()
for (study_name in all_studies) {
  if (!study_name %in% names(out)) next
  meta <- out[[study_name]]$metadata
  if (is.null(meta)) next

  st_col <- intersect(names(meta), c("Status", "status"))
  if (length(st_col) > 0) {
    grp <- tolower(as.character(meta[[st_col[1]]]))
    n_asd <- sum(grp %in% c("autism", "asd", "case"), na.rm = TRUE)
    n_con <- sum(grp %in% c("control", "td", "neuro", "healthy"), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    n_asd <- NA
    n_con <- NA
  }

  # Updated to take from technical_summary df
  ts_idx <- match(study_name, technical_summary$Study)

  platform <- if (!is.na(ts_idx)) technical_summary$SeqPlatform[ts_idx] else "Unknown"
  region <- if (!is.na(ts_idx)) technical_summary$SeqRegion[ts_idx] else "Unknown"
  location <- if (!is.na(ts_idx)) technical_summary$Location[ts_idx] else "Unknown"

  if (is.na(platform)) platform <- "Unknown"
  if (is.na(region)) region <- "Unknown"
  if (is.na(location)) location <- "Unknown"

  metrics_by_study[[study_name]] <- tibble(
    study = study_name,
    N_ASD = n_asd,
    N_Control = n_con,
    Platform = platform,
    Region = region,
    Location = location,
    Sparsity = {
      sp_val <- anno_study %>%
        filter(study == study_name) %>%
        summarise(m = suppressWarnings(max(sparsity_mean_pct, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
        pull(m)
      if (length(sp_val) == 0 || !is.finite(sp_val)) NA_real_ else sp_val
    },
    n_genera = {
      lfc_tbl %>%
        filter(study == study_name) %>%
        nrow()
    }
  )
}

study_stats <- bind_rows(metrics_by_study) %>%
  right_join(tibble(study = all_studies), by = "study") %>%
  mutate(
    N_ASD = ifelse(is.na(N_ASD), 0, N_ASD),
    N_Control = ifelse(is.na(N_Control), 0, N_Control),
    Total_N = N_ASD + N_Control,
    Platform = ifelse(is.na(Platform) | Platform == "", "Unknown", Platform),
    Region = ifelse(is.na(Region) | Region == "", "Unknown", Region),

# - \(p_t\) is the **fraction of studies where the taxon has a positive effect**, meaning:
#   \[
#   p_t = \frac{1}{n_{\text{avail},t}} \sum_s \mathbf{1}\{LFC_{s,t} > 0\}
#   \]
#   where \(n_{\text{avail},t}\) is the number of studies where the taxon has an available (finite) effect size, and \(\mathbf{1}\{\cdot\}\) equals 1 if the condition is true and 0 otherwise.
#
# - Interpretation:
#   - \(p_t = 0.5\): split evenly, **no sign consistency**.
#   - \(p_t > 0.5\): **more studies are positive than negative** (more “higher in autism”, given your sign convention).
#   - \(p_t < 0.5\): **more studies are negative than positive**.
#
# - When \(p_t\) is based on many studies (large \(n_{\text{avail},t}\)), you stop getting forced 0/1 values.
#   If most of the histogram mass is near \(0.5\), that means:
#   - For most well-measured taxa, the sign **flips across studies** a lot.
#   - Only a smaller set of taxa show moderate sign tendency (like \(0.65\)–\(0.75\) or \(0.25\)–\(0.35\)).
#
# - Bottom line: the **direction (sign) is not very reproducible for most taxa** once you only look at taxa that are measured consistently across studies.

min_overlap <- 30
mat_all <- lfc_tbl %>%
  mutate(LFC = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(LFC))) %>%
  select(feature, study, LFC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = LFC) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(mat_all) <- mat_all$feature
mat_all$feature <- NULL
mat_all <- as.matrix(mat_all)
mat_all <- mat_all[, all_studies, drop = FALSE]
cor_mat <- matrix(NA_real_,
  nrow = length(all_studies), ncol = length(all_studies),
  dimnames = list(all_studies, all_studies)
)
overlap_mat <- matrix(0L,
  nrow = length(all_studies), ncol = length(all_studies),
  dimnames = list(all_studies, all_studies)
)

for (i in seq_along(all_studies)) {
  for (j in seq_along(all_studies)) {
    a <- mat_all[, i]
    b <- mat_all[, j]
    ok <- is.finite(a) & is.finite(b)
    overlap_mat[i, j] <- sum(ok)

    if (overlap_mat[i, j] >= min_overlap) {
      cor_mat[i, j] <- suppressWarnings(cor(a[ok], b[ok], method = "spearman"))
    }
  }
}

cor_for_cluster <- cor_mat
cor_for_cluster[is.na(cor_for_cluster)] <- 0
hc_cor <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_for_cluster), method = "average")
ht_cor <- Heatmap(
  cor_mat,
  name = "Spearman\ncorr",
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#b2182b", "white", "#2166ac")),
  na_col = "grey92",
  cluster_rows = hc_cor,
  cluster_columns = hc_cor,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 45
)

pdf("study_pair_spearman_corr_heatmap_min60.pdf", width = 9, height = 8)
draw(ht_cor, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()

sign_sim <- matrix(NA_real_,
  nrow = length(all_studies), ncol = length(all_studies),
  dimnames = list(all_studies, all_studies)
)
overlap_sign <- matrix(0L,
  nrow = length(all_studies), ncol = length(all_studies),
  dimnames = list(all_studies, all_studies)
)

for (i in seq_along(all_studies)) {
  for (j in seq_along(all_studies)) {
    a <- mat_all[, i]
    b <- mat_all[, j]

    ok <- is.finite(a) & is.finite(b)
    sa <- sign(a[ok])
    sb <- sign(b[ok])

    keep <- (sa != 0) & (sb != 0)
    overlap_sign[i, j] <- sum(keep)

    if (overlap_sign[i, j] >= min_overlap) {
      agree <- mean(sa[keep] == sb[keep])
      sign_sim[i, j] <- 2 * agree - 1
    }
  }
}

sim_for_cluster <- sign_sim
sim_for_cluster[is.na(sim_for_cluster)] <- 0
hc_sign <- hclust(as.dist(1 - sim_for_cluster), method = "average")

ht_sign <- Heatmap(
  sign_sim,
  name = "Sign\nsimilarity",
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#b2182b", "white", "#2166ac")),
  na_col = "grey92",
  cluster_rows = hc_sign,
  cluster_columns = hc_sign,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 45
)

pdf("study_pair_sign_similarity_heatmap_min60.pdf", width = 9, height = 8)
draw(ht_sign, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()


# Interpretation of cor_mat[i, j] (Spearman correlation of LFC vectors):
# Across the taxa we can compare in both studies, do taxa that are more positive
# in study s1 also tend to be more positive in study s2 (and similarly for negative)?
#
#   corr ~ +1 : taxa tend to move in the same direction across the two studies
#              (consistent ordering of LFC across taxa)
#   corr ~  0 : little / no relationship between the two studies' LFC patterns
#   corr ~ -1 : taxa tend to reverse direction across the two studies

flip_mat <- matrix(NA_real_,
  nrow = length(all_studies), ncol = length(all_studies),
  dimnames = list(all_studies, all_studies)
)
for (i in seq_along(all_studies)) {
  for (j in seq_along(all_studies)) {
    a <- mat_all[, i]
    b <- mat_all[, j]
    ok <- is.finite(a) & is.finite(b) & (a != 0) & (b != 0)
    if (sum(ok) >= min_overlap) {
      flip_mat[i, j] <- mean((a[ok] * b[ok]) < 0)
    }
  }
}
ht_flip <- Heatmap(
  flip_mat,
  name = "sign flip\nfraction",
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "grey60", "black")),
  na_col = "grey92",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 45
)
pdf("study_pair_sign_flip_fraction_heatmap.pdf", width = 9, height = 8)
draw(ht_flip, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()

# For each study pair (s, s_prime), and each taxon t with LFC values in both studies:
#
#   Let L_{s,t}      = LFC for taxon t in study s
#       L_{s_prime,t}= LFC for taxon t in study s_prime
#
#   Define:
#     - "same sign" if (L_{s,t} > 0 AND L_{s_prime,t} > 0) OR (L_{s,t} < 0 AND L_{s_prime,t} < 0)
#     - "flip sign" if one is > 0 and the other is < 0
#     - ignore exact zeros (LFC == 0) and ignore missing/non-finite values
#
# Then compute the flip fraction:
#
#   flip_fraction(s, s_prime) =
#       #{ t : L_{s,t} * L_{s_prime,t} < 0 }
#       ------------------------------------
#       #{ t : L_{s,t} and L_{s_prime,t} are finite and both nonzero }
#
# where #{ ... } means "number of taxa t such that the condition holds".

alpha <- 0.05
E <- 1 # target |LFC|

power_df <- bench_long %>%
  filter(is.finite(se), se > 0, is.finite(estimate)) %>%
  group_by(method, study) %>%
  mutate(
    p_sim = 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(E / se)),
    q_sim = p.adjust(p_sim, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_taxa_with_se = n(),
    power_hat = mean(q_sim < alpha, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_power <- ggplot(power_df, aes(x = study, y = method, fill = power_hat)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(power_hat), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", power_hat))),
    size = 2.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(limits = c(0, 1), na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Estimated detection fraction if true |LFC| = ", E),
    subtitle = paste0("Computed from se, then BH within each study-method, threshold q < ", alpha),
    x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "power_hat"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave("empirical_power_hat_heatmap.png", p_power, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)
print(p_power)


# --- DIAGNOSTIC: Heterogeneity of Noise ---
# 1. Distribution of SE per study (showing the "clean subset" tail)
se_cutoff <- E / qnorm(1 - (alpha / 2)) # Approx 0.51 for alpha=0.05, E=1
# Reasoning: Z = E/SE. For p < 0.05, we need Z > 1.96. So E/SE > 1.96 => SE < E/1.96.

se_df <- bench_long %>%
  filter(method == "aldex3_mem_0p3") %>% # Focus on one method for clarity
  filter(is.finite(se), se > 0, se < 2) # Zoom in on the relevant range

# Check if ggridges is installed, otherwise use boxplot fallback
if (requireNamespace("ggridges", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p_se_dist <- ggplot(se_df, aes(x = se, y = reorder(study, se, FUN = median, decreasing = TRUE), fill = study)) +
    ggridges::geom_density_ridges(scale = 2, alpha = 0.7, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = se_cutoff, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    annotate("text",
      x = se_cutoff, y = length(unique(se_df$study)) + 2,
      label = paste0("50% Power threshold\n(SE < ", round(se_cutoff, 2), ")"),
      color = "red", hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of Standard Errors (SE) by Study",
      subtitle = "Method: ALDEx3 (gamma=0.3). Left of red line = 'Detectable' (Power > 50% for LFC=1)",
      x = "Standard Error (SE)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
} else {
  p_se_dist <- ggplot(se_df, aes(x = se, y = reorder(study, se, FUN = median, decreasing = TRUE), fill = study)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = se_cutoff, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of Standard Errors (SE) by Study",
      subtitle = "Method: ALDEx3 (gamma=0.3). Left of red line = 'Detectable'",
      x = "Standard Error (SE)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

method_is_gamma_0p3 <- function(df) {
  if ("gamma" %in% colnames(df)) {
    return(df$gamma == 0.3)
  }
  if ("method" %in% colnames(df)) {
    m <- as.character(df$method)
    return(grepl("0p3|0\\.3", m))
  }
  stop("bench_long must have either a 'gamma' column or a 'method' column to identify gamma=0.3.")
}

get_q_vec <- function(df) {
  if ("q_value" %in% colnames(df)) {
    return(df$q_value)
  }
  if ("q" %in% colnames(df)) {
    return(df$q)
  }
  if ("qval" %in% colnames(df)) {
    return(df$qval)
  }
  stop("bench_long needs a q-value column named one of: q_value, q, qval.")
}

fuzzy_match_genus <- function(genus_name, feature_vec) {
  candidates <- c(
    paste0("g__", genus_name),
    paste0("Genus__", genus_name),
    genus_name,
    paste0("g__", gsub("/", "_", genus_name))
  )

  for (cand in candidates) {
    if (cand %in% feature_vec) {
      return(cand)
    }
  }

  # Try case-insensitive partial match
  pattern <- paste0("(g__|Genus__)?", gsub("/", "[/_]", genus_name))
  matches <- grep(pattern, feature_vec, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(matches) > 0) {
    return(matches[1])
  }

  return(NA_character_)
}

collapse_refs <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  x <- unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- x[nzchar(x) & !is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  paste(unique(x), collapse = "; ")
}

    paste0("g__", genus_name),

  )

# ---- 0) helper: standardize trend strings ----
std_trend <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\\s+", " ")
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    x == "" ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "^inc") ~ "Increased",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "^dec") ~ "Decreased",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "mixed") ~ "Mixed",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

    Trend_in_ASD = ifelse(str_detect(Trend_in_ASD, "^Mixed"), "Mixed", Trend_in_ASD),
    genus = ifelse(Level == "Genus", Taxon, word(Taxon, 1)),
    feature = paste0("g__", genus),
    Taxon = str_trim(Taxon),
    Specific_Resources = str_trim(Specific_Resources)
  )

# ---- 2) merge into your genus table (microbe_info_all) ----
# (microbe_info_all is one row per genus. we only join genus-level rows from Table3)
lit_table3_genus <- lit_table3 %>%
  filter(Level == "Genus") %>%
  select(
    genus, feature,
    Tbl3_Phylum = Phylum,
    Tbl3_Taxon = Taxon,
    Tbl3_Level = Level,
    Tbl3_Trend = Trend_in_ASD,
    Tbl3_Citations = Specific_Resources
  )

microbe_info_unified <- microbe_info_all %>%
  left_join(lit_table3_genus, by = c("genus", "feature")) %>%
  mutate(
    # pick a single trend, priority: your microbe_info_all Trend_in_literature -> Table2 -> Table3
    Trend_unified = dplyr::coalesce(
      Trend_in_literature,
      T2_overall,
      Tbl3_Trend
    ),
    Trend_unified = std_trend(Trend_unified),

    # quick conflict flags (only when both exist)
    Conflict_vs_Table3 = case_when(
      is.na(Trend_in_literature) | is.na(Tbl3_Trend) ~ NA_character_,
      Trend_in_literature == Tbl3_Trend ~ "No conflict",
      Tbl3_Trend == "Mixed" ~ "Table3 reports mixed",
      Trend_in_literature == "Mixed" ~ "Primary reports mixed",
      TRUE ~ "Conflict"
    )
  ) %>%
  # formatted display cols
  transmute(
    genus, feature,
    Trend_in_literature,
    T2_overall,
    Tbl3_Trend,
    Trend_unified,
    Phylum,
    Tbl3_Phylum,
    Mechanism_of_Action,
    Key_References,

    # Table2 evidence
    T2_has_up, T2_has_down,
    T2_up_num_studies, T2_down_num_studies,
    T2_up_refs, T2_down_refs,
    T2_after_intervention,

    # Table3 evidence
    Tbl3_Citations,
    Conflict_vs_T2,
    Conflict_vs_Table3
  ) %>%
  arrange(genus)

microbe_info_all <- microbe_info_unified

microbe_info_all$Trend_in_literature <- NULL
microbe_info_all$Trend_in_literature <- microbe_info_all$Trend_unified

x <- bench_long %>%
  filter(method == method_keep, feature %in% targets_genus, term == term_keep) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(estimate > 0, "increased", "decreased")) %>%

meta_summary <- x %>%
  group_by(feature, genus) %>%
  summarise(
    num_studies = n(),
    n_total = sum(n_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_studies_pos = sum(estimate > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_studies_neg = sum(estimate < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_studies_q_le_0p05 = sum(q_value <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_studies_q_le_0p10 = sum(q_value <= 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_studies_q_le_0p15 = sum(q_value <= 0.15, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_studies_q_le_0p20 = sum(q_value <= 0.20, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_q = min(q_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_effect = min(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_effect = as.numeric(quantile(estimate, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)),
    q50_effect = as.numeric(quantile(estimate, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)),
    q75_effect = as.numeric(quantile(estimate, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)),
    max_effect = max(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_effect = q75_effect - q25_effect,
    meta_est = sum(estimate * (1 / (se^2)), na.rm = TRUE) / sum((1 / (se^2)), na.rm = TRUE),
    meta_se = sqrt(1 / sum((1 / (se^2)), na.rm = TRUE)),
    meta_ci_l = meta_est - 1.96 * meta_se,
    meta_ci_u = meta_est + 1.96 * meta_se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(microbe_info_all, by = c("feature", "genus"))

print(meta_summary)
```

```{r amplicon all meta}
# ============================================================
# TOTAL DROP-IN: ALDEx3 random-effects meta-analysis
# + moderators: demo_adj, family_adj, clinical_adj (one-at-a-time)
# + hybrid k>=2 pooled effects, k>=3 heterogeneity/robustness
# + prediction intervals (uses stats::predict, NOT metafor::predict)
#
# REQUIRED INPUT:
#   bench_long with columns:
#     study, method, feature, estimate, se
#
# YOU MUST PROVIDE (study-level metadata):
#   A data.frame/tibble called study_covs with columns:
#     study, demo_adj, family_adj, clinical_adj
#
# Where:
#   demo_adj     = 0/1  (1 if age and/or sex included)
#   family_adj   = 0/1  (1 if sibling/matched/paired/random effect accounted)
#   clinical_adj = 0/1  (1 if GI/antibiotics/meds/etc included)
#
# OUTPUT:
#   meta_results_df : pooled + PI + heterogeneity + FDR + robust + moderator tests
#   p1              : pooled effects dot-heatmap across γ
#   p2              : robustness scatter (FDR vs I^2) with k<3 flag
#   writes: "MetaAnalysis_ALDEx3_Robustness_Landscape.pdf"
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggrepel)
  library(metafor)
  library(scales)
})

aldex_methods <- c("aldex3_mem_0p1", "aldex3_mem_0p3", "aldex3_mem_0p5", "aldex3_mem_1")
method_labels <- c(
  "aldex3_mem_0p1" = "ALDEx3 γ=0.1",
  "aldex3_mem_0p3" = "ALDEx3 γ=0.3",
  "aldex3_mem_0p5" = "ALDEx3 γ=0.5",
  "aldex3_mem_1"   = "ALDEx3 γ=1"
)
method_order <- c("ALDEx3 γ=0.1", "ALDEx3 γ=0.3", "ALDEx3 γ=0.5", "ALDEx3 γ=1")

study_covs <- data.frame(
  study = character(0),
  demo_adj = integer(0),
  family_adj = integer(0),
  clinical_adj = integer(0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in names(out)) {
  f_txt <- paste(deparse(out[[i]]$design), collapse = " ")
  f_txt <- tolower(f_txt)
  f_txt <- gsub("\\bstatus\\b", "", f_txt)
  demo_adj <- as.integer(
    grepl("\\bage\\b", f_txt) |
      grepl("\\bsex\\b", f_txt) |
      grepl("\\bgender\\b", f_txt)
  )
  family_adj <- as.integer(
    grepl("\\|", f_txt) |
      grepl("match_ids", f_txt)
  )
  tmp <- f_txt
  tmp <- gsub("\\bage\\b", "", tmp)
  tmp <- gsub("\\bsex\\b", "", tmp)
  tmp <- gsub("\\bgender\\b", "", tmp)
  tmp <- gsub("\\([^\\)]*\\|[^\\)]*\\)", "", tmp)
  tmp <- gsub("[\\+~]", "", tmp)
  tmp <- gsub("\\s+", " ", tmp)
  tmp <- trimws(tmp)
  clinical_adj <- as.integer(nchar(tmp) > 0)
  study_covs <- rbind(
    study_covs,
    data.frame(
      study = i,
      demo_adj = demo_adj,
      family_adj = family_adj,
      clinical_adj = clinical_adj,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}

bench_long2 <- bench_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(study_covs, by = "study")

if (any(is.na(bench_long2$demo_adj))) warning("Some studies missing demo_adj after join")
if (any(is.na(bench_long2$family_adj))) warning("Some studies missing family_adj after join")
if (any(is.na(bench_long2$clinical_adj))) warning("Some studies missing clinical_adj after join")

prepare_meta_data_strict <- function(df, keep_methods) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  if (!("se" %in% names(df))) {
    stop("No 'se' column found. Strict meta-analysis requires study-level SE.")
  }
  out <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(method %in% keep_methods) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      estimate = as.numeric(estimate),
      se       = as.numeric(se),
      vi       = se^2
    )
  before_n <- nrow(out)
  out <- out %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(study), !is.na(method), !is.na(feature),
      is.finite(estimate),
      is.finite(se), se > 0,
      is.finite(vi), vi > 0
    )
  after_n <- nrow(out)
  message(
    "ALDEx3-only rows kept (have SE): ", after_n, " / ", before_n,
    "  (dropped: ", before_n - after_n, ")"
  )
  if (after_n == 0) stop("No rows left after requiring SE > 0.")
  out
}
bench_meta <- prepare_meta_data_strict(bench_long2, keep_methods = aldex_methods)
collapse_within_study <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(method, feature, study) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      estimate = {
        w <- 1 / vi
        sum(w * estimate) / sum(w)
      },
      vi = 1 / sum(1 / vi),
      demo_adj = dplyr::first(demo_adj),
      family_adj = dplyr::first(family_adj),
      clinical_adj = dplyr::first(clinical_adj),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

bench_meta_collapsed <- collapse_within_study(bench_meta)
safe_predict_pi <- function(fit) {
  pr <- tryCatch(stats::predict(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(pr)) {
    return(list(pi.lb = NA_real_, pi.ub = NA_real_))
  }
  pi_lb <- if ("pi.lb" %in% names(pr)) as.numeric(pr$pi.lb) else NA_real_
  pi_ub <- if ("pi.ub" %in% names(pr)) as.numeric(pr$pi.ub) else NA_real_
  list(pi.lb = pi_lb, pi.ub = pi_ub)
}
safe_mod_test <- function(sub_dat, mod_var) {
  if (!(mod_var %in% names(sub_dat))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  dat <- sub_dat %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[mod_var]]))
  if (nrow(dat) < 3) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  if (length(unique(dat[[mod_var]])) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  fitm <- tryCatch(
    metafor::rma(
      yi = estimate, vi = vi,
      mods = stats::as.formula(paste0("~ ", mod_var)),
      data = dat, method = "REML"
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(fitm)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  as.numeric(fitm$QMp)
}
run_meta_per_method_hybrid <- function(full_data,
                                       min_pool_studies = 2L,
                                       min_hetero_studies = 3L) {
  methods_list <- sort(unique(full_data$method))
  all_results <- list()

  message("Starting meta-analysis (ALDEx3 only; hybrid k>=2 pool, k>=3 heterogeneity claims)...")

  for (m in methods_list) {
    method_data <- full_data %>% dplyr::filter(method == m)
    valid_features <- method_data %>%
      dplyr::count(feature, name = "n_studies") %>%
      dplyr::filter(n_studies >= min_pool_studies) %>%
      dplyr::pull(feature)

    if (length(valid_features) == 0) {
      message("  ", m, ": no features with >= ", min_pool_studies, " studies")
      next
    }
    res_list <- lapply(valid_features, function(f) {
      sub_dat <- method_data %>% dplyr::filter(feature == f)
      sub_dat <- sub_dat %>% dplyr::distinct(study, .keep_all = TRUE)
      k <- nrow(sub_dat)
      if (k < min_pool_studies) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      fit0 <- tryCatch(
        metafor::rma(yi = estimate, vi = vi, data = sub_dat, method = "REML"),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(fit0)) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      pi <- safe_predict_pi(fit0)
      p_demo <- safe_mod_test(sub_dat, "demo_adj")
      p_family <- safe_mod_test(sub_dat, "family_adj")
      p_clinical <- safe_mod_test(sub_dat, "clinical_adj")
      data.frame(
        method = m,
        feature = f,
        n_studies = as.integer(fit0$k),
        est_global = as.numeric(fit0$beta[1]),
        se_global = as.numeric(fit0$se),
        p_global = as.numeric(fit0$pval),
        ci_lower = as.numeric(fit0$ci.lb),
        ci_upper = as.numeric(fit0$ci.ub),
        tau2 = as.numeric(fit0$tau2),
        i2 = as.numeric(fit0$I2),
        pi_lower = pi$pi.lb,
        pi_upper = pi$pi.ub,
        hetero_ok = (as.integer(fit0$k) >= min_hetero_studies),
        p_mod_demo = p_demo,
        p_mod_family = p_family,
        p_mod_clinical = p_clinical,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })

    method_df <- do.call(rbind, res_list)

    if (!is.null(method_df) && nrow(method_df) > 0) {
      all_results[[m]] <- method_df
      message("  ", m, ": pooled ", nrow(method_df), " features")
    } else {
      message("  ", m, ": pooled 0 features")
    }
  }

  final_df <- do.call(rbind, all_results)
  if (is.null(final_df) || nrow(final_df) == 0) {
    stop("Meta-analysis produced no results. Likely too few studies after SE filtering.")
  }

  final_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(method) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(q_global = p.adjust(p_global, method = "BH")) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      robust = (q_global < 0.05) & hetero_ok & (i2 < 25)
    )
}

add_pi_if_missing <- function(row) {
  if (!is.na(row$pi_lower) && !is.na(row$pi_upper)) {
    return(row)
  }

  mu_hat <- as.numeric(row$est_global)
  se_mu <- as.numeric(row$se_global)
  tau2 <- as.numeric(row$tau2)

  if (!is.finite(mu_hat) || !is.finite(se_mu) || se_mu <= 0 || !is.finite(tau2) || tau2 < 0) {
    row$pi_lower <- NA_real_
    row$pi_upper <- NA_real_
    return(row)
  }

  half <- 1.96 * sqrt(tau2 + se_mu^2)
  row$pi_lower <- mu_hat - half
  row$pi_upper <- mu_hat + half
  row
}

forest_plot_from_results <- function(feature_id,
                                     method_id,
                                     meta_results_df,
                                     bench_meta_collapsed,
                                     outfile = NULL) {
  pooled <- meta_results_df %>%
    filter(method == method_id, feature == feature_id) %>%
    slice(1)

  if (nrow(pooled) == 0) stop("No pooled result found for this (method, feature).")

  if (!("pi_lower" %in% names(pooled))) pooled$pi_lower <- NA_real_
  if (!("pi_upper" %in% names(pooled))) pooled$pi_upper <- NA_real_
  pooled <- add_pi_if_missing(pooled)

  stud <- bench_meta_collapsed %>%
    filter(method == method_id, feature == feature_id) %>%
    distinct(study, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      se = sqrt(vi),
      ci_lower = estimate - 1.96 * se,
      ci_upper = estimate + 1.96 * se,
      weight = 1 / vi
    ) %>%
    arrange(weight) %>%
    mutate(study = factor(study, levels = study))

  k <- nrow(stud)
  if (k == 0) stop("No study-level rows found for this (method, feature).")

  pooled_row <- tibble(
    study = factor("Pooled (REML)", levels = c(levels(stud$study), "Pooled (REML)")),
    estimate = pooled$est_global,
    ci_lower = pooled$ci_lower,
    ci_upper = pooled$ci_upper,
    se = pooled$se_global,
    vi = pooled$se_global^2,
    weight = NA_real_
  )

  plot_df <- bind_rows(
    stud %>%
      transmute(study, estimate, ci_lower, ci_upper, type = "study"),
    pooled_row %>%
      transmute(study, estimate, ci_lower, ci_upper, type = "pooled")
  )

  pi_df <- tibble(
    y = "Prediction interval",
    x1 = pooled$pi_lower,
    x2 = pooled$pi_upper
  )

  x_all <- c(plot_df$ci_lower, plot_df$ci_upper, pooled$pi_lower, pooled$pi_upper)
  x_all <- x_all[is.finite(x_all)]
  xr <- range(x_all)
  pad <- 0.10 * diff(xr)
  xlim <- xr + c(-pad, pad)

  ttl <- paste0(method_id, " | ", feature_id, " (k = ", k, ")")
  subttl <- paste0(
    "Pooled = ", signif(pooled$est_global, 4),
    "  [", signif(pooled$ci_lower, 4), ", ", signif(pooled$ci_upper, 4), "]",
    "   I2 = ", signif(pooled$i2, 3),
    "   q = ", signif(pooled$q_global, 3)
  )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(y = study, x = estimate)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper, linewidth = (type == "pooled")),
      height = 0.2, alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(size = (type == "pooled")), shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.4) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 2.0, `TRUE` = 3.2), guide = "none") +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.4, `TRUE` = 0.9), guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim) +
    labs(
      title = ttl, subtitle = subttl,
      x = "Effect estimate (study-level ALDEx3 scale) with 95% CI",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  if (is.finite(pooled$pi_lower) && is.finite(pooled$pi_upper)) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("segment",
        x = pooled$pi_lower, xend = pooled$pi_upper,
        y = 0.5, yend = 0.5, linewidth = 1.0
      ) +
      annotate("text",
        x = xlim[1], y = 0.5, label = "Prediction interval", hjust = 0,
        size = 3.2
      )
  }

  if (!is.null(outfile)) {
    ggsave(outfile, p, width = 8.5, height = 11)
  }

  p
}

forest_pdf_top_taxa_from_results <- function(method_id,
                                             meta_results_df,
                                             bench_meta_collapsed,
                                             top_n = 10,
                                             require_robust = TRUE,
                                             pdf_file = "ForestPlots_TopTaxa.pdf") {
  sel <- meta_results_df %>%
    filter(method == method_id)

  if (require_robust && ("robust" %in% names(sel))) {
    sel <- sel %>% filter(robust)
  }

  feats <- sel %>%
    arrange(q_global) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    pull(feature)

  if (length(feats) == 0) stop("No taxa selected. (Maybe require_robust=TRUE is too strict?)")

  pdf(pdf_file, width = 8.5, height = 11)
  on.exit(dev.off(), add = TRUE)

  for (f in feats) {
    print(
      forest_plot_from_results(
        feature_id = f,
        method_id = method_id,
        meta_results_df = meta_results_df,
        bench_meta_collapsed = bench_meta_collapsed,
        outfile = NULL
      )
    )
  }

  message("Wrote: ", pdf_file)
  invisible(feats)
}
```

```{r Metagenomic Data from Morton et al.2023}
lineages_to_rank_table <- function(lin_df,
                                   feature_col = "Feature ID",
                                   lineage_col = "lineage") {
  pieces <- strsplit(lin_df[[lineage_col]], ";", fixed = TRUE)
  pull <- function(v, prefix) {
    v <- trimws(v)
    hit <- v[startsWith(v, prefix)]
    if (length(hit) == 0) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }
    out <- sub(prefix, "", hit[1], fixed = TRUE)
    out <- trimws(out)
    if (out %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>")) NA_character_ else out
  }
  out <- data.frame(
    check.names = FALSE,
    `Feature ID` = lin_df[[feature_col]],
    Domain = vapply(pieces, pull, character(1), prefix = "d__"),
    Phylum = vapply(pieces, pull, character(1), prefix = "p__"),
    Class = vapply(pieces, pull, character(1), prefix = "c__"),
    Order = vapply(pieces, pull, character(1), prefix = "o__"),
    Family = vapply(pieces, pull, character(1), prefix = "f__"),
    Genus = vapply(pieces, pull, character(1), prefix = "g__"),
    Species = vapply(pieces, pull, character(1), prefix = "s__"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out
}
```
