make_study_list <- function(
  counts_meta,
  meta,
  taxonomy,
  study_col = "BioProject",
  sample_col = "sampleid",
  feature_col = "Feature ID",
  ranks = c("Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"),
  unassigned_prefix = "Unassigned_",
  drop_all_zero_features = TRUE,
  min_samples = 1L
) {
  Y <- as.matrix(counts_meta)
  storage.mode(Y) <- "numeric"
  if (is.null(rownames(Y))) stop("counts_meta must have rownames = feature IDs (WoL IDs).")
  if (is.null(colnames(Y))) stop("counts_meta must have colnames = sample IDs.")
  meta <- as.data.frame(meta, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (!study_col %in% names(meta)) stop("meta missing column: ", study_col)
  if (!sample_col %in% names(meta)) stop("meta missing column: ", sample_col)
  meta[[study_col]] <- trimws(as.character(meta[[study_col]]))
  meta[[sample_col]] <- trimws(as.character(meta[[sample_col]]))
  keep_meta <- meta[[sample_col]] %in% colnames(Y)
  meta2 <- meta[keep_meta, , drop = FALSE]
  study_ids <- unique(meta2[[study_col]])
  study_ids <- study_ids[!is.na(study_ids) & study_ids != ""]
  out <- vector("list", length(study_ids))
  names(out) <- study_ids
  for (i in seq_along(study_ids)) {
    sid <- study_ids[i]
    meta_s <- meta2[meta2[[study_col]] == sid, , drop = FALSE]
    samp_s <- unique(meta_s[[sample_col]])
    samp_s <- samp_s[samp_s %in% colnames(Y)]
    if (length(samp_s) < min_samples) {
      out[[sid]] <- NULL
      next
    }
    Y_s <- Y[, samp_s, drop = FALSE]
    if (drop_all_zero_features) {
      keep_feat <- rowSums(Y_s != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
      Y_s <- Y_s[keep_feat, , drop = FALSE]
    }
    rank_res <- make_rank_mats_from_taxonomy(
      Y = Y_s,
      taxonomy = taxonomy,
      feature_col = feature_col,
      ranks = ranks,
      unassigned_prefix = unassigned_prefix
    )
    out[[sid]] <- list(
      metadata = meta_s,
      counts = Y_s,
      counts_by_rank = rank_res$mats,
      mapping = rank_res$mapping
    )
  }
  out <- out[!vapply(out, is.null, logical(1))]
  attr(out, "summary") <- data.frame(
    study = names(out),
    n_samples = vapply(out, function(x) ncol(x$counts), integer(1)),
    n_features = vapply(out, function(x) nrow(x$counts), integer(1)),
    n_unmapped = vapply(out, function(x) x$mapping$n_unmapped, integer(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out
}


meta_out <- make_study_list(
  counts_meta = mat,
  meta = metadata,
  taxonomy = gtdb_tax
)

meta_out$PRJNA516054$design <- ~ Status + Age + Sex
meta_out$PRJNA451479$design <- ~ Status + Sex
meta_out$PRJEB23052$design <- ~ Status + Sex

fix_meta <- function(df) {
  df$Status <- factor(trimws(as.character(df$Status)))
  df$Status <- stats::relevel(df$Status, ref = "Control")

  if ("Age" %in% names(df)) df$Age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$Age))

  df$Sex <- factor(trimws(as.character(df$Sex)))
  df
}

meta_out$PRJNA516054$metadata <- fix_meta(meta_out$PRJNA516054$metadata)
meta_out$PRJNA451479$metadata <- fix_meta(meta_out$PRJNA451479$metadata)
meta_out$PRJEB23052$metadata <- fix_meta(meta_out$PRJEB23052$metadata)

bucket_unassigned <- function(counts, unassigned_prefix = "Unassigned_") {
  if (is.data.frame(counts)) counts <- as.matrix(counts)
  if (!is.matrix(counts)) stop("counts must be a matrix/data.frame.")
  if (is.null(rownames(counts))) stop("counts must have rownames.")
  storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric"

  nm <- rownames(counts)
  nm[startsWith(nm, unassigned_prefix)] <- "Unassigned"

  out <- rowsum(counts, group = nm, reorder = FALSE)
  out <- as.matrix(out)
  storage.mode(out) <- "numeric"
  out
}

# ---------- Build two analysis objects (genus + species) ----------
meta_out_genus <- meta_out
meta_out_species <- meta_out

for (bp in names(meta_out_genus)) {
  gmat <- meta_out_genus[[bp]]$counts_by_rank$Genus
  if (is.null(gmat)) next
  meta_out_genus[[bp]]$counts <- bucket_unassigned(gmat, unassigned_prefix = "Unassigned_")
}

for (bp in names(meta_out_species)) {
  smat <- meta_out_species[[bp]]$counts_by_rank$Species
  if (is.null(smat)) next
  meta_out_species[[bp]]$counts <- bucket_unassigned(smat, unassigned_prefix = "Unassigned_")
}

  if (is.null(pf$by_method)) next
  bad <- names(pf$by_method)[!unlist(pf$by_method)]

  if (is.null(pf$by_method)) next

  pivot_longer(-study, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(
    value_scaled = {
      v <- value
      if (all(is.na(v))) {
        0
      } else {
        rng <- range(v, na.rm = TRUE)
        if (!is.finite(rng[1]) || !is.finite(rng[2]) || rng[1] == rng[2]) 0 else (v - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
      }
    },
    label = case_when(
      is.na(value) ~ "NA",
      metric == "Sparsity (%)" ~ paste0(round(value, 0)),
      TRUE ~ format(as.integer(round(value, 0)), big.mark = ",")
    ),
    label_color = ifelse(value_scaled >= 0.60, "white", "black")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

N_STUDIES <- length(unique(bench_long$study))

N_REPS <- 1000

avg_sig_per_study_method <- bench_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(q_value < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study, method) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_sig = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(method) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(avg_sig_per_study = mean(n_sig, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

run_random_sim <- function(method_name, avg_n_sig) {
  p_sig_feature <- avg_n_sig / N_FEATURES
  sim_mat <- matrix(
    rbinom(N_FEATURES * N_STUDIES, size = 1, prob = p_sig_feature),
    nrow = N_FEATURES,
    ncol = N_STUDIES
  )
  consistency_vector <- rowSums(sim_mat)
  sim_counts <- as.data.frame(table(consistency_vector)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(n_studies = consistency_vector, count = Freq) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(n_studies = as.numeric(as.character(n_studies))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_studies > 0)
  return(sim_counts)
}

random_consistency_list <- list()

for (m in unique(avg_sig_per_study_method$method)) {
  avg_n_sig <- avg_sig_per_study_method$avg_sig_per_study[avg_sig_per_study_method$method == m]

  if (is.na(avg_n_sig) || avg_n_sig <= 1) next

  sim_results <- map_dfr(1:N_REPS, ~ run_random_sim(m, avg_n_sig)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(n_studies) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(count = mean(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(method = m, type = "Random")

  random_consistency_list[[m]] <- sim_results
}

alpha <- 0.05

}

aldex3 <- bench_long %>%
  filter(str_detect(method, "^aldex3_mem_")) %>%
  mutate(
    gamma = case_when(
      method == "aldex3_mem_0p1" ~ 0.1,
      method == "aldex3_mem_0p3" ~ 0.3,
      method == "aldex3_mem_0p5" ~ 0.5,
      method == "aldex3_mem_1" ~ 1.0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    sig = is.finite(q_value) & !is.na(q_value) & (q_value < alpha)
  ) %>%
  filter(gamma %in% keep_gammas)

study_rank <- aldex3 %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sig = sum(sig, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_sig = any(sig, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(any_sig) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sig), study)

sig_studies_3 <- head(study_rank$study, 3)
if (length(sig_studies_3) < 1) stop("No studies have significant taxa under q < alpha.")
if (length(sig_studies_3) < 3) message("Only ", length(sig_studies_3), " studies have any significant taxa. Plotting those.")

  filter(study %in% sig_studies_3) %>%
  group_by(study, feature, gamma) %>%
  summarise(
    estimate = {
      v <- estimate[is.finite(estimate)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    q_value = {
      v <- q_value[is.finite(q_value)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else min(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = is.finite(q_value) & !is.na(q_value) & (q_value < alpha),
    neglog10q = ifelse(is.finite(q_value) & !is.na(q_value), -log10(pmax(q_value, 1e-300)), NA_real_)
  )

  m <- median(vv, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(m)) 0 else m
})
for (i in seq_len(nrow(mat_imp))) {
  bad <- !is.finite(mat_imp[i, ])
  mat_imp[i, bad] <- row_med[i]
}
row_order <- hclust(dist(mat_imp))$order

if (!is.finite(lim) || lim == 0) lim <- max(abs_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(lim) || lim == 0) lim <- 1
col_fun_lfc <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-lim, 0, lim), c("#b2182b", "white", "#2166ac"))

r_min_mm <- 0.6
r_max_mm <- 2.2

nlq_vals <- mat_nlq[is.finite(mat_nlq) & is.finite(mat_q) & (mat_q < q_show_max)]
nlq_min <- suppressWarnings(min(nlq_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
nlq_max <- suppressWarnings(max(nlq_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
if (!is.finite(nlq_min) || !is.finite(nlq_max) || nlq_max <= nlq_min) {
  nlq_min <- 1
  nlq_max <- 5
}

scale_radius_mm <- function(nlq) {
  nlq <- max(min(nlq, nlq_max), nlq_min)
  t <- (nlq - nlq_min) / (nlq_max - nlq_min)
  r_min_mm + t * (r_max_mm - r_min_mm)
}

dot_breaks <- unique(round(c(nlq_min, (nlq_min + nlq_max) / 2, nlq_max), 2))
dot_sizes <- unit(vapply(dot_breaks, scale_radius_mm, numeric(1)), "mm")

dot_legend <- Legend(
  title = expression(-log[10](q)),
  labels = format(dot_breaks, trim = TRUE),
  type = "points",
  pch = 16,
  size = dot_sizes,
  legend_gp = gpar(col = "black", fill = "black")
)

sig_legend <- Legend(
  title = "",
  labels = c("q < 0.05", expression(0.05 <= q ~ "<" ~ 0.10)),
  type = "points",
  pch = 16,
  size = unit(2, "mm"),
  legend_gp = gpar(col = c("black", "grey60"), fill = c("black", "grey60"))
)

sp_obs <- bench_long %>%
  filter(study %in% sig_studies_3, feature %in% rownames(mat_eff)) %>%
  group_by(study, feature) %>%
  summarise(
    taxa_sparsity_pct = {
      v <- taxa_sparsity_pct[is.finite(taxa_sparsity_pct)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )
sp_df <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  study = sig_studies_3,
  feature = rownames(mat_eff)
) %>%
  left_join(sp_obs, by = c("study", "feature")) %>%
  mutate(taxa_sparsity_pct = ifelse(is.na(taxa_sparsity_pct), 100, taxa_sparsity_pct))
col_fun_sp <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 50, 100), c("white", "grey70", "black"))
ht_list <- NULL

for (k in seq_along(sig_studies_3)) {
  st <- sig_studies_3[k]
  cols_st <- grep(paste0("^", st, "__"), colnames(mat_eff), value = TRUE)

  mat_eff_st <- mat_eff[, cols_st, drop = FALSE]
  mat_q_st <- mat_q[, cols_st, drop = FALSE]
  mat_nlq_st <- mat_nlq[, cols_st, drop = FALSE]

  gamma_labels <- paste0("ALDEx3 \u03B3=", sub("^.*__", "", cols_st))

  ht_lfc <- Heatmap(
    mat_eff_st,
    name = if (k == 1) "LFC" else paste0("LFC_", k),
    col = col_fun_lfc,
    na_col = "grey92",
    row_order = row_order,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    show_row_names = FALSE,
    row_names_side = "right",
    show_column_names = TRUE,
    column_labels = gamma_labels,
    column_names_rot = 45,
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.4),
    border = FALSE,
    column_title = st,
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "LFC",
      at = c(-lim, 0, lim),
      labels = c(sprintf("%.2f", -lim), "0", sprintf("%.2f", lim))
    ),
    show_heatmap_legend = (k == 1),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      qv <- mat_q_st[i, j]

      # Show dots for q < 0.10, with color by band
      if (is.finite(qv) && !is.na(qv) && qv < q_show_max) {
        nlq <- mat_nlq_st[i, j]
        if (is.finite(nlq) && !is.na(nlq)) {
          dot_fill <- if (qv < alpha) "black" else "grey60"
          grid.circle(
            x, y,
            r = unit(scale_radius_mm(nlq), "mm"),
            gp = gpar(fill = dot_fill, col = NA)
          )
        }
      }
    }
  )

  sp_vec <- sp_df %>%
    filter(study == st) %>%
    select(feature, taxa_sparsity_pct) %>%
    distinct()

  sp_vals <- sp_vec$taxa_sparsity_pct[match(rownames(mat_eff), sp_vec$feature)]
  sp_vals[is.na(sp_vals)] <- 100

  mat_sp_st <- matrix(sp_vals, ncol = 1)
  rownames(mat_sp_st) <- rownames(mat_eff)
  colnames(mat_sp_st) <- "Sparsity"

  ht_sp <- Heatmap(
    mat_sp_st,
    name = if (k == 1) "Sparsity (%)" else paste0("Sparsity (%)_", k),
    col = col_fun_sp,
    na_col = "grey92",
    row_order = row_order,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    show_row_names = (k == length(sig_studies_3)),
    row_names_side = "right",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    show_column_names = TRUE,
    column_names_rot = 45,
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.4),
    border = FALSE,
    width = unit(10, "mm"),
    show_heatmap_legend = (k == 1),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Sparsity (%)",
      at = c(0, 50, 100),
      labels = c("0", "50", "100")
    ),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      v <- mat_sp_st[i, j]
      if (is.finite(v) && !is.na(v)) {
        txt <- sprintf("%.0f", v)
        txt_col <- if (v >= 70) "white" else "black"
        grid.text(txt, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, col = txt_col))
      }
    }
  )

  if (is.null(ht_list)) {
    ht_list <- ht_lfc + ht_sp
  } else {
    ht_list <- ht_list + ht_lfc + ht_sp
  }
}

pdf("Aldex3hits_heatmap_WGS.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
draw(
  ht_list,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_list = list(dot_legend, sig_legend)
)
dev.off()

keep_gammas <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0)

  filter(study %in% sig_studies_3) %>%
  filter(str_detect(method, "^aldex3_mem_")) %>%
  mutate(
    gamma = case_when(
      method == "aldex3_mem_0p1" ~ 0.1,
      method == "aldex3_mem_0p3" ~ 0.3,
      method == "aldex3_mem_0p5" ~ 0.5,
      method == "aldex3_mem_1" ~ 1.0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(gamma %in% keep_gammas) %>%
  group_by(study, feature, gamma) %>%
  summarise(
    LFC = {
      v <- estimate[is.finite(estimate)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    q = {
      v <- q_value[is.finite(q_value)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else min(v, na.rm = TRUE)

    .groups = "drop"
  )

feature_universe <- collapsed %>%
  distinct(feature) %>%
  pull(feature)

grid_all <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  study = sig_studies_3,
  feature = feature_universe,
  gamma = keep_gammas
) %>%
  left_join(collapsed, by = c("study", "feature", "gamma")) %>%
  mutate(
    study = factor(study, levels = sig_studies_3),
    gamma = factor(gamma, levels = keep_gammas),
    sgn = case_when(
      is.na(LFC) ~ NA_integer_,
      LFC > 0 ~ 1L,
      LFC < 0 ~ -1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  )

thresholds <- tibble(
  thr = c(0.10, 0.05),
  thr_label = c("q < 0.10", "q < 0.05")
)

feat_thr <- thresholds %>%
  tidyr::crossing(grid_all %>% select(study, feature, gamma, q, sgn)) %>%
  mutate(hit = is.finite(q) & !is.na(q) & (q < thr)) %>%
  group_by(thr_label, thr, feature, gamma) %>%
  summarise(
    k_hit_num = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
    sign_group = {
      if (k_hit_num <= 1) {
        "one-study hit"
      } else {
        vals <- sgn[hit & !is.na(sgn) & sgn != 0L]
        if (length(vals) >= 2 && length(unique(vals)) == 1) {
          if (unique(vals) == 1L) "both positive" else "both negative"
        } else if (length(vals) >= 2 && length(unique(vals)) > 1) {
          "mixed sign"
        } else {
          "one-study hit"
        }
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    k_hit = factor(
      k_hit_num,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("hit in 1 study", "hit in 2 studies")
    ),
    thr_label = factor(thr_label, levels = c("q < 0.10", "q < 0.05")),
    gamma = factor(gamma, levels = keep_gammas),
    sign_group = factor(
      sign_group,
      levels = c("both positive", "both negative", "mixed sign", "one-study hit")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(k_hit_num %in% c(1, 2))

print(
  thresholds %>% filter(thr_label == "q < 0.10") %>%
    tidyr::crossing(grid_all %>% select(study, feature, gamma, q, sgn)) %>%
    mutate(hit = is.finite(q) & !is.na(q) & (q < 0.10)) %>%
    group_by(feature, gamma) %>%
    summarise(
      hit_studies = paste(study[hit], collapse = ","),
      signs = paste(sgn[hit], collapse = ","),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(str_count(hit_studies, ",") == 1) %>%
    arrange(gamma, feature)
)

method_keep <- "aldex3_mem_0p3"
alpha <- 0.05
q_show_max <- 0.10
B_perm <- 2000
min_members <- 5
topK_trait <- 25

out_dir <- "wgs_enrich_plots"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

stopifnot(exists("out"))

if (!all(c("study", "method", "feature", "estimate", "q_value") %in% names(bench_long))) {
  stop("bench_long must contain: study, method, feature, estimate, q_value")
}
if (!all(c("Phylum", "Family", "Genus") %in% names(gtdb_tax))) {
  stop("taxonomy must contain columns: Phylum, Family, Genus (Domain/Class/Order optional)")
}

clean_rank <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>", "Unassigned")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

pick_first_non_na <- function(v) {
  v <- clean_rank(v)
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if (length(v) == 0) NA_character_ else v[1]
}

set_perm_test <- function(members, stat, B = 2000, min_members = 5) {
  members <- intersect(members, names(stat))
  m <- length(members)
  if (m < min_members) {
    return(tibble::tibble(n = m, mean_LFC = NA_real_, p_two = NA_real_))
  }
  obs <- mean(stat[members], na.rm = TRUE)
  u <- names(stat)
  sim <- replicate(B, mean(stat[sample(u, m, replace = FALSE)], na.rm = TRUE))
  p_hi <- mean(sim >= obs)
  p_lo <- mean(sim <= obs)
  p_two <- min(1, 2 * min(p_hi, p_lo))
  tibble::tibble(n = m, mean_LFC = obs, p_two = p_two)
}

tax_map_genus <- gtdb_tax %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Genus  = clean_rank(Genus),
    Family = clean_rank(Family),
    Phylum = clean_rank(Phylum),
    Domain = if ("Domain" %in% names(gtdb_tax)) clean_rank(Domain) else NA_character_,
    Class  = if ("Class" %in% names(gtdb_tax)) clean_rank(Class) else NA_character_,
    Order  = if ("Order" %in% names(gtdb_tax)) clean_rank(Order) else NA_character_
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genus)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genus) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Phylum  = pick_first_non_na(Phylum),
    Family  = pick_first_non_na(Family),
    Domain  = pick_first_non_na(Domain),
    Class   = pick_first_non_na(Class),
    Order   = pick_first_non_na(Order),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

study_rank <- bench_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(method == method_keep) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_sig = sum(is.finite(q_value) & (q_value < alpha), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_sig), study) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_sig > 0)
sig_studies_3 <- head(study_rank$study, 3)

trait_all <- list()
for (study_id in sig_studies_3) {
  if (is.null(out[[study_id]]) || is.null(out[[study_id]]$counts)) next

  da_tbl <- bench_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(study == study_id, method == method_keep) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      LFC = {
        v <- estimate[is.finite(estimate)]
        if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else stats::median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      q = {
        v <- q_value[is.finite(q_value)]
        if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else min(v, na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      feature = as.character(feature),
      LFC = as.numeric(LFC),
      q = as.numeric(q)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(LFC), is.finite(q))

  if (nrow(da_tbl) < 5) next
  Y <- as.matrix(out[[study_id]]$counts)
  storage.mode(Y) <- "numeric"
  keep_taxa <- intersect(da_tbl$feature, rownames(Y))
  if (length(keep_taxa) < 5) next
  Yg <- Y[keep_taxa, , drop = FALSE]
  bad_tokens <- c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "null", "<NA>", "Unassigned")

  keep_taxa <- keep_taxa[!is.na(keep_taxa)]
  keep_taxa <- trimws(keep_taxa)
  keep_taxa <- keep_taxa[!(keep_taxa %in% bad_tokens)]
  keep_taxa <- keep_taxa[!grepl("^Unassigned", keep_taxa)] # optional if you have Unassigned_*

  tax_tab <- tibble::tibble(feature = keep_taxa) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Genus = feature) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tax_map_genus, by = "Genus") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      feature = feature,
      Kingdom = Domain,
      Phylum  = Phylum,
      Class   = Class,
      Order   = Order,
      Family  = Family,
      Genus   = Genus
    ) %>%
    # IMPORTANT: do NOT clean `feature`
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus), clean_rank)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(feature), nzchar(feature)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(feature, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("feature") %>%
    as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  samp_ids <- colnames(Yg)
  samp_tab <- data.frame(sampleid = samp_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  rownames(samp_tab) <- samp_ids

  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(microeco))

  # FAPROTAX via microeco
  mt <- microeco::microtable$new(
    otu_table    = as.data.frame(Yg),
    tax_table    = tax_tab,
    sample_table = samp_tab
  )
  mt$tidy_dataset()
  tf <- microeco::trans_func$new(mt)
  tf$cal_func(prok_database = "FAPROTAX")
  func_bin <- tf$res_func
  if (is.null(func_bin) || nrow(func_bin) == 0 || ncol(func_bin) == 0) next
  func_bin <- as.matrix(func_bin)
  rownames(func_bin) <- rownames(tf$res_func)
  colnames(func_bin) <- colnames(tf$res_func)
  common <- intersect(rownames(func_bin), da_tbl$feature)
  if (length(common) < 5) next
  func_bin <- func_bin[common, , drop = FALSE]
  stat_raw <- da_tbl$LFC
  names(stat_raw) <- da_tbl$feature
  stat_raw <- stat_raw[common]
  stat_raw <- stat_raw[is.finite(stat_raw)]
  if (length(stat_raw) < 5) next

  # --- score (signed rank) ---
  r <- rank(abs(stat_raw), ties.method = "average")
  score_rank <- sign(stat_raw) * r
  names(score_rank) <- names(stat_raw)

  # --- abundance weight from Yg (mean relative abundance, log1p, scaled) ---
  Yg2 <- Yg[names(stat_raw), , drop = FALSE]
  lib_size <- colSums(Yg2)
  rel <- sweep(Yg2, 2, lib_size, "/")
  w <- log1p(rowMeans(rel, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (all(!is.finite(w)) || max(w, na.rm = TRUE) <= 0) next
  w <- w / max(w, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(w) <- rownames(Yg2)

  stat_use <- score_rank * w
  stat_use <- stat_use[is.finite(stat_use)]
  if (length(stat_use) < 5) next
  func_sets <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(func_bin)), function(j) {
    rownames(func_bin)[is.finite(func_bin[, j]) & (func_bin[, j] > 0)]
  })
  names(func_sets) <- colnames(func_bin)

  func_sets <- lapply(func_sets, function(m) intersect(m, names(stat_use)))

  set_sizes <- vapply(func_sets, length, integer(1))
  max_frac <- 0.80
  keep_trait <- set_sizes >= min_members & set_sizes <= floor(max_frac * length(stat_use))
  func_sets <- func_sets[keep_trait]
  if (length(func_sets) == 0) next
  trait_enrich <- purrr::imap_dfr(func_sets, function(members, trait_name) {
    res <- set_perm_test(members, stat_use, B = B_perm, min_members = min_members)
    mm <- intersect(members, names(stat_raw))
    res$mean_LFC_raw <- if (length(mm) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(stat_raw[mm], na.rm = TRUE)

    res$trait <- trait_name
    res
  }) %>%
    dplyr::rename(mean_score = mean_LFC) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      q = stats::p.adjust(p_two, method = "fdr"),
      study = study_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(mean_score), is.finite(mean_LFC_raw), is.finite(q))

  if (nrow(trait_enrich) == 0) next
  trait_all[[study_id]] <- trait_enrich
}

trait_all_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(trait_all)
if (nrow(trait_all_df) == 0) stop("No FAPROTAX enrichment results produced for the selected studies.")

df_top <- trait_all_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(q, dplyr::desc(abs(mean_score)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = topK_trait) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

trait_order <- df_top %>%
  dplyr::group_by(trait) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    best_q = min(q, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs = max(abs(mean_score), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(best_q, dplyr::desc(max_abs)) %>%

# ---------- helpers ----------
clean_rank <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "^d__|^p__|^c__|^o__|^f__|^g__", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "^Domain__|^Phylum__|^Class__|^Order__|^Family__|^Genus__", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[x == "" | is.na(x)] <- NA_character_
  x
}

clean_genus <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace(x, "^Genus__", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace(x, "^g__", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  trimws(x)
}

pick_first_non_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else x[1]
}

# Canonical join key: makes genus strings line up across different naming styles
canon_genus_key <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  # remove common prefixes
  x <- stringr::str_replace(x, "^Genus__", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace(x, "^g__", "")

  # normalize separators
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "[/\\-]", " ")

  # drop GTDB-like suffix tokens at the end: " A 368345"
  x <- stringr::str_replace(x, " [A-Z] [0-9]+$", "")

  # sensu stricto variants: "sensu stricto 1" -> "sensu stricto"
  x <- stringr::str_replace(x, "(sensu stricto) [0-9]+$", "\\1")

  x <- stringr::str_squish(x)
  x[x == "" | is.na(x)] <- NA_character_
  x
}

canon_rank_key <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "^d__|^p__|^c__|^o__|^f__|^g__", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "^Domain__|^Phylum__|^Class__|^Order__|^Family__|^Genus__", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
  x <- stringr::str_replace(x, " [A-Z] [0-9]+$", "")
  x <- stringr::str_squish(x)
  x[x == "" | is.na(x)] <- NA_character_
  x
}

  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Genus_key)) %>%
  group_by(Genus_key) %>%
  summarise(
    Genus_display = pick_first_non_na(Genus_clean),
    med_LFC = {
      v <- LFC[is.finite(LFC)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else median(v)
    },
    best_q = {
      v <- q[is.finite(q)]
      if (length(v) == 0) NA_real_ else min(v)
    },
    n_studies = sum(is.finite(LFC)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    best_q = ifelse(is.na(best_q) | !is.finite(best_q), 1, best_q),
    stat = sign(med_LFC) * (-log10(best_q))
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(stat))

# ---------- 2) choose taxa_keep: all q<0.05 first, then fill with q<0.10 ----------
taxon_rank <- lfc_tbl %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  summarise(
    best_q  = suppressWarnings(min(q[is.finite(q)], na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_abs = suppressWarnings(max(abs(LFC[is.finite(LFC)]), na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    best_q  = ifelse(is.infinite(best_q), NA_real_, best_q),
    max_abs = ifelse(is.infinite(max_abs), NA_real_, max_abs),
    any05   = is.finite(best_q) & (best_q < q_black),
    any10   = is.finite(best_q) & (best_q < q_grey)
  )

sig05 <- taxon_rank %>%
  filter(any05) %>%
  arrange(best_q, desc(max_abs)) %>%
  pull(feature)

if (length(sig05) > topN) {
  taxa_keep <- sig05[seq_len(topN)]
} else {
  remaining <- taxon_rank %>%
    filter(!feature %in% sig05) %>%
    arrange(desc(any10), best_q, desc(max_abs)) %>%
    pull(feature)
  need <- topN - length(sig05)
  taxa_keep <- c(sig05, head(remaining, need))
}

  u <- sort(unique(vals))
  cols <- viridis::viridis(length(u))
  names(cols) <- u
  cols

phy_full <- tree
if (is.null(phy_full$edge.length)) phy_full$edge.length <- rep(1, nrow(phy_full$edge))
if (!("Feature ID" %in% names(gtdb_tax))) stop("gtdb_tax must contain column: `Feature ID`")

tip_genus_map <- gtdb_tax %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    tip = as.character(.data[["Feature ID"]]),
    genus_key = canon_genus_key(.data[["Genus"]])
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(tip), !is.na(genus_key),
    genus_key %in% g_plot_key
  )

tips_needed <- intersect(tip_genus_map$tip, phy_full$tip.label)

if (length(tips_needed) < 3) {
  row_order_full <- rownames(mat_lfc)
  row_dend <- as.dendrogram(hclust(dist(mat_imp), method = "complete"))
} else {
  phy_tree <- ape::keep.tip(phy_full, tips_needed)
  depth <- ape::node.depth.edgelength(phy_tree)
  tip_id <- setNames(seq_along(phy_tree$tip.label), phy_tree$tip.label)

  tips_by_genus <- split(tip_genus_map$tip, tip_genus_map$genus_key)

  rep_tip <- vapply(intersect(names(tips_by_genus), g_plot_key), function(gk) {
    tips <- intersect(as.character(tips_by_genus[[gk]]), phy_tree$tip.label)
    if (length(tips) == 0) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }
    if (length(tips) == 1) {
      return(tips)
    }

    idx <- unname(tip_id[tips])
    m <- ape::getMRCA(phy_tree, idx)
    if (is.null(m) || length(m) == 0 || is.na(m)) {
      return(tips[1])
    }

    d <- depth[idx] - depth[m]
    tips[which.min(d)]
  }, character(1))

  rep_tip <- rep_tip[!is.na(rep_tip)]
  g_used <- names(rep_tip)

  if (length(rep_tip) < 3) {
    row_order_full <- rownames(mat_lfc)
    row_dend <- as.dendrogram(hclust(dist(mat_imp), method = "complete"))
  } else {
    genus_tree <- ape::keep.tip(phy_tree, unname(rep_tip))
    genus_tree$tip.label <- g_used[match(genus_tree$tip.label, rep_tip)]
    genus_tree <- ape::ladderize(genus_tree, right = FALSE)
    rows <- rownames(mat_lfc)
    row_to_key <- setNames(canon_genus_key(clean_genus(rows)), rows)
    phy_keys <- genus_tree$tip.label
    row_order_phy <- names(row_to_key)[match(phy_keys, row_to_key)]
    row_order_phy <- row_order_phy[!is.na(row_order_phy)]
    row_order_full <- c(row_order_phy, setdiff(rows, row_order_phy))
    genus_tree_u <- ape::compute.brlen(genus_tree, method = "Grafen")
    genus_tree_u <- ape::ladderize(genus_tree_u, right = FALSE)
    hc_phy <- ape::as.hclust.phylo(genus_tree_u)
    row_dend <- as.dendrogram(hc_phy)
  }
}

# ---------- 8) Calculate diversity metrics & B/F ratio per study ----------
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(vegan))

mean_within_dist <- function(D, idx) {
  if (length(idx) < 3) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(idx)))
  }
  out <- numeric(length(idx))
  for (k in seq_along(idx)) {
    i <- idx[k]
    others <- setdiff(idx, i)
    out[k] <- mean(D[i, others], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  out
}

eps <- 1e-8

std_meta_cols <- function(meta) {
  nm <- names(meta)

  sid <- intersect(nm, c("sampleid", "SampleID", "sample_id", "SampleId"))
  st <- intersect(nm, c("Status", "status", "group", "Group", "dx", "Dx"))


  if (length(sid) == 0) stop("metadata is missing a sample id column (expected sampleid/SampleID/sample_id).")
  if (length(st) == 0) stop("metadata is missing a status column (expected status/Status/group/dx).")

  meta$sampleid <- meta[[sid[1]]]
  meta$status <- meta[[st[1]]]
  meta
}

metrics_by_study <- list()
for (study_name in all_studies) {
  if (!study_name %in% names(out)) next

  Y <- out[[study_name]]$counts
  meta <- out[[study_name]]$metadata
  if (is.null(Y) || is.null(meta)) next

  Y <- as.matrix(Y)
  storage.mode(Y) <- "numeric"

  if (is.null(Y) || is.null(meta)) next
  meta <- std_meta_cols(meta)
  common <- intersect(colnames(Y), meta$sampleid)
  if (length(common) < 4) next

  meta_work <- meta[match(common, meta$sampleid), , drop = FALSE]
  grp_raw <- tolower(trimws(as.character(meta_work$status)))
  grp_mapped <- dplyr::case_when(
    grp_raw %in% c("autism", "asd") ~ "autism",
    grp_raw %in% c("control", "ctrl", "ctl", "healthy", "hc", "neurotypical", "td", "typical") ~ "control",
    grp_raw %in% c("case", "patient") ~ "autism", # optional, only if correct for your data
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  idxA <- which(grp_mapped == "autism")
  idxC <- which(grp_mapped == "control")
  if (length(idxA) < 2 || length(idxC) < 2) next

  # ---------------- Alpha: Shannon per sample, autism vs control ----------------
  shannon <- vegan::diversity(t(Y[, common, drop = FALSE]), index = "shannon")
  alpha_A <- shannon[idxA]
  alpha_C <- shannon[idxC]

  alpha_delta <- median(alpha_A, na.rm = TRUE) - median(alpha_C, na.rm = TRUE)
  alpha_p <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(alpha_A, alpha_C)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  # ---------------- Beta: within-group Bray-Curtis "heterogeneity" --------------
  lib <- colSums(Y[, common, drop = FALSE])
  if (any(lib > 0)) {
    Y_rel <- sweep(Y[, common, drop = FALSE], 2, lib, "/")
    Y_rel[!is.finite(Y_rel)] <- 0

    bc <- vegan::vegdist(t(Y_rel), method = "bray")
    D <- as.matrix(bc)

    # effect size: difference in median pairwise within-group distances
    get_within_vals <- function(idx) {
      if (length(idx) < 2) {
        return(numeric(0))
      }
      sub <- D[idx, idx, drop = FALSE]
      sub[upper.tri(sub, diag = FALSE)]
    }

    within_A <- get_within_vals(idxA)
    within_C <- get_within_vals(idxC)

    beta_delta <- median(within_A, na.rm = TRUE) - median(within_C, na.rm = TRUE)

    # test: compare per-sample mean within-group distance (directional)
    mwA <- mean_within_dist(D, idxA)
    mwC <- mean_within_dist(D, idxC)
    beta_p <- tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(mwA, mwC)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
  } else {
    beta_delta <- NA_real_
    beta_p <- NA_real_
  }

  # ---------------- BF ratio: per-sample relative abundance ratio ---------------
  phylum_mat <- out[[study_name]]$counts_by_rank$Phylum
  if (!is.null(phylum_mat)) {
    phylum_mat <- as.matrix(phylum_mat)
    storage.mode(phylum_mat) <- "numeric"

    common_p <- intersect(colnames(phylum_mat), meta$sampleid)
    common_p <- intersect(common_p, common)
    meta_p <- meta[match(common_p, meta$sampleid), , drop = FALSE]
    grp_p <- as.character(meta_p$status)
    grp_p2 <- tolower(trimws(grp_p))
    grp_mapped_p <- dplyr::case_when(
      grp_p2 %in% c("autism", "asd") ~ "autism",
      grp_p2 %in% c("control", "ctrl", "ctl", "healthy", "hc", "neurotypical", "td", "typical") ~ "control",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
    idxA_p <- which(grp_mapped_p == "autism")
    idxC_p <- which(grp_mapped_p == "control")

    if (length(idxA_p) >= 2 && length(idxC_p) >= 2) {
      rn_raw <- rownames(phylum_mat)
      rn_clean <- canon_rank_key(rn_raw)
      rn_clean <- tolower(rn_clean)
      rn_clean <- sub(" [a-z]$", "", rn_clean)
      bact_rows <- which(grepl("^bacteroid(ota|etes)?$", rn_clean) | grepl("^bacteroid", rn_clean))
      firm_rows <- which(grepl("^firmicutes$", rn_clean) | grepl("^bacillota$", rn_clean) | grepl("^firmicutes", rn_clean))

      lib_p <- colSums(phylum_mat[, common_p, drop = FALSE])
      lib_p[!is.finite(lib_p)] <- 0

      bact <- if (length(bact_rows) > 0) colSums(phylum_mat[bact_rows, common_p, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) else rep(0, length(common_p))
      firm <- if (length(firm_rows) > 0) colSums(phylum_mat[firm_rows, common_p, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) else rep(0, length(common_p))

      bact_rel <- (bact + eps) / (lib_p + eps)
      firm_rel <- (firm + eps) / (lib_p + eps)

      BF <- (bact_rel + eps) / (firm_rel + eps)
      logBF <- log(BF)

      bf_A <- logBF[idxA_p]
      bf_C <- logBF[idxC_p]

      bf_delta <- median(bf_A, na.rm = TRUE) - median(bf_C, na.rm = TRUE)
      bf_p <- tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(bf_A, bf_C)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    } else {
      bf_delta <- NA_real_
      bf_p <- NA_real_
    }
  } else {
    bf_delta <- NA_real_
    bf_p <- NA_real_
  }

  metrics_by_study[[study_name]] <- tibble(
    study = study_name,
    n_autism = length(idxA),
    n_control = length(idxC),
    alpha_delta = alpha_delta,
    alpha_p = alpha_p,
    beta_delta = beta_delta,
    beta_p = beta_p,
    bf_delta = bf_delta,
    bf_p = bf_p
  )
}

div_df <- bind_rows(metrics_by_study) %>%
  mutate(
    alpha_q = p.adjust(alpha_p, method = "BH"),
    beta_q = p.adjust(beta_p, method = "BH"),
    bf_q = p.adjust(bf_p, method = "BH"),
    alpha_dir = ifelse(!is.finite(alpha_delta), NA_character_,
      ifelse(alpha_q < 0.05 & alpha_delta > 0, "increased",
        ifelse(alpha_q < 0.05 & alpha_delta < 0, "decreased", "no_change")
      )
    ),
    beta_dir = ifelse(!is.finite(beta_delta), NA_character_,
      ifelse(beta_q < 0.05 & beta_delta > 0, "increased",
        ifelse(beta_q < 0.05 & beta_delta < 0, "decreased", "no_change")
      )
    ),
    bf_dir = ifelse(!is.finite(bf_delta), NA_character_,
      ifelse(bf_q < 0.05 & bf_delta > 0, "increased",
        ifelse(bf_q < 0.05 & bf_delta < 0, "decreased", "no_change")
      )
    )
  )

# Color scales for diversity metrics (grayscale: white -> black)
make_diverging_colfun <- function(m, top = NULL, neg = "#B22222", pos = "#2B6CB0") {
  v <- as.numeric(m[is.finite(m)])
  if (length(v) == 0) {
    return(circlize::colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c(neg, "white", pos)))
  }

  if (is.null(top)) {
    vmax <- max(abs(v), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    vmax <- top
  }
  if (!is.finite(vmax) || is.na(vmax) || vmax <= 0) vmax <- 1

  circlize::colorRamp2(c(-vmax, 0, vmax), c(neg, "white", pos))
}

min_studies_avail <- 10
max_med_sparsity <- 80
min_overlap <- 30
mat_all <- lfc_tbl %>%
  mutate(LFC = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(LFC))) %>%
  select(feature, study, LFC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = LFC) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(mat_all) <- mat_all$feature
mat_all$feature <- NULL
mat_all <- as.matrix(mat_all)
mat_all <- mat_all[, all_studies, drop = FALSE]
cor_mat <- matrix(NA_real_,
  nrow = length(all_studies), ncol = length(all_studies),
  dimnames = list(all_studies, all_studies)
)
overlap_mat <- matrix(0L,
  nrow = length(all_studies), ncol = length(all_studies),
  dimnames = list(all_studies, all_studies)
)

for (i in seq_along(all_studies)) {
  for (j in seq_along(all_studies)) {
    a <- mat_all[, i]
    b <- mat_all[, j]
    ok <- is.finite(a) & is.finite(b)
    overlap_mat[i, j] <- sum(ok)

    if (overlap_mat[i, j] >= min_overlap) {
      cor_mat[i, j] <- suppressWarnings(cor(a[ok], b[ok], method = "spearman"))
    }
  }
}

cor_for_cluster <- cor_mat
cor_for_cluster[is.na(cor_for_cluster)] <- 0
hc_cor <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_for_cluster), method = "average")
ht_cor <- Heatmap(
  cor_mat,
  name = "Spearman\ncorr",
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#b2182b", "white", "#2166ac")),
  na_col = "grey92",
  cluster_rows = hc_cor,
  cluster_columns = hc_cor,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 45
)

pdf("study_pair_spearman_corr_heatmap_min60_WGS.pdf", width = 9, height = 8)
draw(ht_cor, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()

sign_sim <- matrix(NA_real_,
  nrow = length(all_studies), ncol = length(all_studies),
  dimnames = list(all_studies, all_studies)
)
overlap_sign <- matrix(0L,
  nrow = length(all_studies), ncol = length(all_studies),
  dimnames = list(all_studies, all_studies)
)

for (i in seq_along(all_studies)) {
  for (j in seq_along(all_studies)) {
    a <- mat_all[, i]
    b <- mat_all[, j]

    ok <- is.finite(a) & is.finite(b)
    sa <- sign(a[ok])
    sb <- sign(b[ok])

    keep <- (sa != 0) & (sb != 0)
    overlap_sign[i, j] <- sum(keep)

    if (overlap_sign[i, j] >= min_overlap) {
      agree <- mean(sa[keep] == sb[keep])
      sign_sim[i, j] <- 2 * agree - 1
    }
  }
}

sim_for_cluster <- sign_sim
sim_for_cluster[is.na(sim_for_cluster)] <- 0
hc_sign <- hclust(as.dist(1 - sim_for_cluster), method = "average")

ht_sign <- Heatmap(
  sign_sim,
  name = "Sign\nsimilarity",
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#b2182b", "white", "#2166ac")),
  na_col = "grey92",
  cluster_rows = hc_sign,
  cluster_columns = hc_sign,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 45
)

pdf("study_pair_sign_similarity_heatmap_min60_WGS.pdf", width = 9, height = 8)
draw(ht_sign, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()

flip_mat <- matrix(NA_real_,
  nrow = length(all_studies), ncol = length(all_studies),
  dimnames = list(all_studies, all_studies)
)
for (i in seq_along(all_studies)) {
  for (j in seq_along(all_studies)) {
    a <- mat_all[, i]
    b <- mat_all[, j]
    ok <- is.finite(a) & is.finite(b) & (a != 0) & (b != 0)
    if (sum(ok) >= min_overlap) {
      flip_mat[i, j] <- mean((a[ok] * b[ok]) < 0)
    }
  }
}
ht_flip <- Heatmap(
  flip_mat,
  name = "sign flip\nfraction",
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "grey60", "black")),
  na_col = "grey92",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 45
)
pdf("study_pair_sign_flip_fraction_heatmap_WGS.pdf", width = 9, height = 8)
draw(ht_flip, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()

```{r amp vs meta (genus)}
amp_path <- "amplicon_bench_long.rds"
meta_path <- "meta_bench_long.rds"
if (!exists("amp_bench_long")) amp_bench_long <- readRDS(amp_path)
if (!exists("meta_bench_long")) meta_bench_long <- readRDS(meta_path)

alpha <- 0.1

bench_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  amp_bench_long %>% mutate(dataset = "amplicon"),
  meta_bench_long %>% mutate(dataset = "metagenome")
)

req_cols <- c("study", "method", "feature", "q_value")
missing_cols <- setdiff(req_cols, colnames(bench_all))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("bench_all is missing columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

is_aldex_g03 <- bench_all$method %in% c("aldex3_mem_0.3", "aldex3_mem_0p3")
effect_col <- "estimate"
if (!effect_col %in% colnames(bench_all)) {
  stop("effect_col not found in bench_all: ", effect_col)
}
bench_g03_sig <- bench_all %>%
  filter(method %in% c("aldex3_mem_0.3", "aldex3_mem_0p3")) %>%
  filter(is.finite(q_value)) %>%
  mutate(study_id = paste(dataset, study, sep = "::")) %>%
  group_by(study_id, feature) %>%
  summarise(
    q_min   = min(q_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    effect  = median(.data[[effect_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(effect) & effect != 0) %>%
  filter(q_min < alpha) %>%
  mutate(
    sign = ifelse(effect > 0, "POS", "NEG"),
    feature_signed = paste(feature, sign, sep = "__")
  ) %>%
  distinct(study_id, feature_signed)

taxa_sets <- bench_g03_sig %>%
  group_by(study_id) %>%
  summarise(
    taxa = list(sort(unique(feature_signed))),
    n_taxa = lengths(taxa),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(taxa_sets %>% dplyr::select(study_id, n_taxa))

study_ids <- taxa_sets$study_id
if (length(study_ids) != 4) {
  stop("Expected 4 studies with >=1 significant taxa at gamma=0.3; found ", length(study_ids))
}
venn_list <- setNames(taxa_sets$taxa, taxa_sets$study_id)
print(sapply(venn_list, length))

if (requireNamespace("ggVennDiagram", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(ggVennDiagram)
  p <- ggVennDiagram::ggVennDiagram(venn_list, label_alpha = 0) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("Overlap of significant taxa with same sign (ALDEx3 gamma=0.3, q<", alpha, ")"),
    )
  print(p)
} else if (requireNamespace("VennDiagram", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(VennDiagram)
  grid::grid.newpage()
  g <- VennDiagram::venn.diagram(
    x = venn_list,
    filename = NULL,
    main = paste0("Overlap of significant taxa with same sign (ALDEx3 gamma=0.3, q<", alpha, ")")
  )
  grid::grid.draw(g)
} else {
  stop('Install one of: install.packages("ggVennDiagram") or install.packages("VennDiagram")')
}
```
